chapters.title: Chapter 355: SS 3
chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 3: Theo's Escapade (1)
Hello. It's Theo.
This is already the third time I'm greeting you all.
How have you been getting along?
I truly hope you've been well during this time.
When people I know are happy, it makes me happy too.
How have I been, you ask?
Well...
I was doing really well until lunchtime today.
Why ‘until lunchtime today’? Well, that's because...
"My honey bee! Look at this little one! Isn't he really handsome when you look at him again? I've never seen such a straight nose bridge!"
"Oh, my rose... to praise another man with those cherry-like lips of yours. Just how much are you planning to torment me?"
Just like when I first met you all, I've been kidnapped again.
This time the situation is a bit serious.
At least last time it was just ordinary bandits, right?
"My honey bee! Look at this child's soul! Such a luscious soul! It's absolutely enchanting!"
"My rose, to gaze at another man with those crystal-beautiful eyes. My heart feels like it's being torn apart, but I'll endure it."
You can tell from their conversation alone, can't you? This time I've been captured by dark mages.
"How delighted would they be if we offered this child as a sacrifice?"
"They would surely be delighted! They would bestow even greater blessings upon us!"
They're even planning to use me as a sacrifice.
Why did I end up in this situation, you ask?
To explain that, I'd have to go back two hours.
* * *
"Uncle!"
Two hours ago, I ran down to the basement where my uncle was.
That's because Mom had imposed that terrifying punishment of house arrest on me again.
"The Sword Saint has sent word. He says it's certain that they possess the remnant thoughts of an archdemon."
"Another troublesome thing has appeared. That's already the third time this year."
"It seems you should go check it out as soon as possible. The situation doesn't look good."
But Uncle wasn't alone in the basement. He was there with a knight wearing black armor.
"Oh? Isn't that young Master Theo?"
The knight greeted me as soon as he saw me. I bowed politely in return.
You should greet him too, everyone. This is Sir Dominico.
He's one of the undead who serves Uncle.
He's incredibly strong, though not quite as much as Uncle.
"Theo? What's the matter?"
"Uncle! Please listen to me!"
I explained everything that had just happened to Uncle.
"Mom put me under house arrest because last time I got captured by those bandit guys and interfered with your work!"
"What? Just for something like that?"
That's Uncle for you. He always takes my side.
"Exactly!"
"Sister is being too harsh. I told her it was fine."
"This time I was going to ask you to take me to the Snow Flower Festival in the Schnivalen Kingdom, but Mom forbade that too!"
"Ah, that festival? It's beautiful enough that you should definitely see it at least once."
As Uncle said, the Snow Flower Festival of the Schnivalen Kingdom is so magnificent it's designated as a national treasure.
A performance troupe consisting of over a hundred dancers, musicians, and mages holds a parade, and it's supposed to be incredibly majestic and beautiful.
I couldn't go last year because something came up, and I was determined to go this year, but now I'm under house arrest.
Mom is really too much.
"Can't you secretly take me to the festival?"
"No."
But contrary to my expectations, Uncle flatly refused my request.
"Why not?"
"I told you before, didn't I? I have no intention of interfering with your mother's educational policies."
"It's not that you're scared of Mom, is it?"
"That's part of it too. You know how terrifying Sister gets when she's angry."
Uncle shuddered slightly as if the mere thought was horrifying.
But I'm not the type to back down so easily.
I looked up at Uncle with a face that seemed about to burst into tears.
But Uncle just snorted and said this:
"That doesn't work anymore. Stop acting."
Damn.
The problem is that Uncle knows me too well, just as I know Uncle too well.
"Besides, I have things to do from now on. I need to go out for a bit."
"Where are you going?"
Uncle closed his mouth. He does that when it's difficult to explain. I quickly said:
"I understand. If Uncle is busy, there's nothing I can do about it."
"Thanks for understanding."
Uncle reached out and patted my head. I also rubbed my head against Uncle's palm.
"Instead, I'll buy you some snacks you like on the way back."
"Really? Can I look forward to it?"
"Of course. Well then, see you later."
After saying that, Uncle opened a dimensional portal and disappeared.
Uncle's powers are always fascinating to see.
The only person who would take my side, Uncle, had left like this.
But I'm not the type to give up so easily.
I whirled around to face Sir Dominico.
Sir Dominico startled and then spoke in a firm voice:
"No."
"I haven't said anything yet."
"Weren't you going to ask me to take you to the Schnivalen Kingdom?"
His intuition is really sharp.
Oh, how can Sir Dominico take me to the Schnivalen Kingdom, you ask?
Since Sir Dominico is Uncle's subordinate, he can borrow some of his powers.
That's why he sometimes leaves to carry out missions Uncle has given him.
"A lowly being like myself cannot go against my lord's decision. Absolutely not."
Saying this, Sir Dominico looked at me with eyes as solid as bedrock.
Hmm, he really is like a loyal knight straight out of a fairy tale.
"You granted my request last time."
"That time, young Master Theo deceived me by saying it was lord's errand! Do you know how much I was scolded by my lord after that!"
Sir Dominico shouted in a resentful voice.
Seeing this reaction, it seems he has absolutely no intention of granting my request.
But I don't intend to back down so easily either.
I really want to see the Snow Flower Festival with my own eyes.
I have no choice. I'll have to use my secret weapon.
"I know I'm making an unreasonable request..."
I slightly lowered my head and drooped my shoulders.
I made my expression as gloomy as possible too.
"Y-young Master Theo?"
When my face darkened, Sir Dominico became restless.
Seeing his reaction, this method seems like it will work.
"Do you remember when Hazel came to visit last time?"
"You mean the young lady of the Marquis Ryan Bloom family. I remember."
"At that time, Hazel bragged to me terribly. She said that last year she went to play in the Schnivalen Kingdom with Sir Michael and saw the Snow Flower Festival, and it was incredibly beautiful."
As soon as I mentioned Marquis Michael, Sir Dominico's eyes changed.
"She bragged about such a thing?"
Ah, the reason Sir Dominico is getting so excited is because the two of them are rivals.
The two of them often spar, and until now their win rate has been exactly fifty-fifty.
But recently he lost twice in a row to Sir Michael, so his pride seems quite hurt.
"Do you know if that was all? How delicious the food in the Schnivalen Kingdom was. How enchanting the music was. She went on and on in front of me for over an hour!"
"For over an hour!"
Oh, this isn't a lie.
Hazel always comes to me and rattles off all sorts of brags.
She's really a childish girl, isn't she?
Not only childish, but she has a really nasty personality and is spiteful too!
Aside from having a somewhat pretty and cute face, there's nothing redeeming about her!
"To think such a thing happened... this cannot be tolerated."
Flames rose in Sir Dominico's eyes.
That's just a metaphor, of course. Even if he's undead, he doesn't have that kind of ability.
"The House of Haksen cannot fall behind the likes of the Marquis Ryan Bloom family!"
"That's right!"
"I will take you there! Just trust in me!"
Alright, success!
The problem with being too good-natured is this.
* * *
And so, thanks to the dimensional portal Sir Dominico opened for me, I was able to safely arrive in a major city of the Schnivalen Kingdom.
"You must absolutely stay only within the city. Do you understand?"
"Yes, I'll keep that in mind."
"And you mustn't follow any suspicious people!"
"Of course not."
As soon as we arrived in the city, Sir Dominico went on and on with all sorts of nagging.
It was annoying, but I endured it and listened.
Sir Dominico had reason to be anxious.
"I'd like to stay with you if I could, but if the fact that I've been away for a long time reaches my lord's ears, everything will be discovered."
For this reason, Sir Dominico had to return to the castle.
Since he's trusted by Uncle, he has an enormous amount of work to do.
He has to train soldiers, deal with envoys from various countries, and also...
"My lord should return in about 2 hours."
Ah, so that means I only have 2 hours to play here.
I need to enjoy everything I can within that time.
"If anything happens, you must absolutely call for my lord."
Uncle comes running no matter where I am, as long as I call his name.
But Sir Dominico doesn't have that ability.
"You mustn't refuse to call him just because you're scared of getting scolded! Young Master Theo's safety comes first, second, and third!"
"Of course."
Though I'll definitely think about it as much as possible.
Since Uncle will scold me terribly if he comes!
"And also..."
After that, Sir Dominico gave me a few more lectures before leaving.
Phew, I got tired from listening to all that nagging. Anyway, from now on it's my free time.
"Wow, so this is the Schnivalen Kingdom."
I looked around the streets with a face full of wonder.
Everything from the architectural style of the buildings to people's clothing was completely different from our country.
"Come on, snow-red fruit picked this morning for just 1 silver!"
"Just try one chicken skewer! It's brushed with a secret sauce passed down through our family for generations, so it's very tender and delicious!"
The street vendors were enthusiastically hawking their wares with bright faces.
As expected, with the festival approaching, everyone's faces are bright.
"Miss, could I have one chicken skewer please?"
I held out my carefully saved allowance and asked. At my words, the chicken skewer lady blushed and waved her hands.
"Oh my, calling an auntie 'miss.' What a handsome boy with good eye for people too."
The lady giggled and gave me two chicken skewers.
I held the chicken skewers in both hands and walked down the street, munching on them.
"What time does the Snow Flower Festival start?"
I was walking down the main road with that curiosity when suddenly someone burst out from the entrance of an alley.
I ended up bumping into that person because of it.
What's more, the sauce from the chicken skewers I was holding got on the stranger's coat.
"You little brat..."
A woman with snow-white hair looked down at the sauce on her clothes with a very displeased face.
"Where the hell are you looking while walking around? Should I gouge your eyes out?"
Wouldn't the person who suddenly jumped out also be at fault if we're being fair? Just as I was about to protest like that:
As soon as she confirmed my face, the woman's expression melted away.
"Oh my? Oh my? Oh my my?"
The woman kept exclaiming and then shouted toward the alley:
"My honey bee~ Come over here! Quickly!"
"My rose, if you call, I must run to you wherever you are."
At the woman's cry, a man walked out from the alley entrance.
"My honey bee, look at this boy. Isn't he really handsome?"
"My rose, are you planning to make me die wrapped in flames of jealousy? But he really is a boy whose future is frightening to imagine."
The two people circled around me, constantly exclaiming.
"And look at this brightly shining soul! I've never seen such a soul in my life!"
"He can't compare to your brilliance, but it's still an amazing level!"
"Uh, I'll be going now."
I tried to slip away from the two people.
They obviously seem like people with something wrong in their heads, right? It's best not to get involved with people like this.
Besides, I don't have time since I need to enjoy the Snow Flower Festival...
Click.
Huh?
When I came to my senses, there was a shackle around my neck.
I looked up at the two people with a surprised face. They both smiled brightly and said to me:
"Oh my, where are you trying to go?"
"We'd be sad if you left like this."
People who suddenly put shackles on someone's neck can't be normal.
This was a situation where I should immediately call Uncle, but I asked with a glimmer of hope:
Maybe it's a culture of the Schnivalen Kingdom to welcome guests like this?
"Um... what are you planning to do with me?"
"Oh my, you were curious about that? You don't need to be scared."
"That's right, that's right. We're not savages who commit terrible crimes against children."
Phew, that's a relief. My glimmer of hope was right...
"You're going to be offered as a sacrifice!"
"Isn't it absolutely fantastic?"
Oh, dear God.

chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]

Side Story Chapter 4: Theo's Escapade (2)
And so I was dragged to a small warehouse on the outskirts of the city.
Of course, I went along obediently. How could a kid like me possibly beat two adults?
Especially when both of them were dark mages.
"My honey bee! I never expected to find such excellent material right after entering the city! I'm so happy!"
"My Rose, seeing you so happy makes my heart overflow with joy too."
The two of them hugged each other tightly and spun around in circles in the center of the warehouse.
Watching them, they both looked ridiculous.
My mom and dad are pretty excessive with their affection too, but these two are even worse.
Anyway, this has become quite troublesome.
To think I'd get caught by dark mages right after arriving in the city.
Well, it's not exactly surprising.
Despite my uncle's and the Empire's efforts to capture many dark mages, there are still plenty left.
Plus, my uncle once told me that dark mages have become even more secretive to avoid him, so you never know when or where you might encounter them.
My uncle doesn't overprotect me for nothing.
You ask why I went out on my own when I knew this?
Um...
Hmm...
Let me deal with this situation first before I answer that.
I need to handle urgent matters first, don't I?
"If we sacrifice this child, that person will bestow blessings upon us!"
"Just imagining it is ecstatic! Let's paint this world red with blood together!"
Just like dark mages, everything they say is creepy.
Of course, if I called my uncle, everything would be resolved right now, but...
If I did that, my uncle would scold me terribly...
My uncle always shows me his gentle side, but he absolutely never forgives dangerous behavior.
And it wouldn't just be me getting scolded.
Dominico would get reprimanded too.
Isn't there a way to resolve this without calling my uncle?
While I was deep in thought, suddenly the two of them started looking serious.
"But honey bee, will we be able to safely sacrifice that child?"
"R-right. We've never done it before."
"What if the ritual fails? What if he dies before we can sacrifice him!"
"D-don't think such ominous thoughts. We can do this."
The two of them held hands tightly and trembled.
Watching from the side, it's rather absurd. What kind of dark mages are this incompetent?
Are they even real dark mages? Maybe they're just pretending to be dark mages.
Seeing such incompetence, I started to feel courage welling up.
Maybe I could persuade these two to let me go?
Then I wouldn't have to call my uncle, and I could enjoy the festival!
"Excuse me."
As soon as I made my decision, I called out to them.
They stopped trembling and looked at me.
"Sacrifice, what is it? Are you uncomfortable somewhere?"
"Then tell us quickly. We'll accommodate you as much as possible until we sacrifice you."
They've already decided to call me ‘sacrifice,’ I see.
I was a bit angry, but I held it in and asked them.
"My name is Theodore. What should I call you two? Should I call you Rose and Honey Bee?"
My mom taught me this.
To become friendly with others, you should exchange names first.
At my question, both of them snorted simultaneously.
"Look at this cheeky brat. Rose and Honey Bee are pet names only we can call each other."
"Watch your tongue, kid. Our pet names aren't light enough for just anyone to use."
Saying this, they rubbed noses with each other.
Ugh.
It's disgusting, but I held it in.
After all, I need to get friendly with these two.
"Then could you tell me your names?"
"Look at this impudent brat. Only my darling can know my real name!"
"How dare you try to interfere between us. Do you think I'd tolerate such horrible behavior?"
Wow, this really isn't easy.
The urge to just call my uncle grew stronger, but I held it in.
I really wanted to see the festival.
"But if you really want to call me something, I'll allow you to call me Rose."
"Since my darling allowed it, I should too. I'm Honey Bee."
"Understood. Ms. Rose, Ms. Honey Bee. How about letting me go instead of doing this?"
"Why should we?"
The two of them tilted their heads in the same direction and asked.
I decided to try appealing to their emotions first, like I did with my family members.
"Look at my age. Isn't it too pitiful to die at such a young age?"
"Everyone dies eventually."
"There's just a difference in timing."
They spoke in cold tones.
I didn't give up and spoke again.
"Think about the feelings of the family I'd leave behind after I die. How heartbroken they'd be."
"They're not my family."
"Why should we care about your family?"
I thought they were incompetent dark mages, but their mental state is already corrupted.
Well, if they had normal thinking, they wouldn't have thought to take a child like me as a sacrifice.
"Stop the useless talk and quietly wait your turn."
"If you stay quiet, we'll make it as painless as possible."
It seems like nothing I say will get through to them.
Then there's only one method left.
I put on a very serious expression and said to them.
"If you don't let me go, a very scary person will come."
"A s-scary person?"
"W-we're not afraid of anyone who comes."
Contrary to their words, the two hugged each other and trembled.
No, if you're dark mages, why are you so scared? Are you really fake?
Anyway, I put on an even more serious expression and said.
"Damien Haksen will come."
As soon as I spoke, heavy silence fell.
"Damien Haksen? You don't mean the Damien Haksen I know?"
"That's right."
"The Savior of the Continent? The Greatest of All Time?"
"You know him well."
"The Mad Butcher? The Nightmare of Dark Mages? The Great Demon Slayer?"
"Uh... I'm hearing those titles for the first time."
"Why would that person come to save you?"
"Because I'm Damien Haksen's nephew."
Silence fell again. This time it was a bit longer than before.
Soon, the two started laughing, clutching their bellies.
"Pff, pfft! He says he's Damien Haksen's nephew!"
"Damien... Damien Haksen's nephew got caught by us? Kehehehe!"
Even so, is there any need to mock me so openly?
My face is burning up. But if I show it here, I'll be even more embarrassed.
I suppressed my embarrassment and said to them.
"It's true. Look inside my coat. You'll find a ring with the Haksen family crest."
As if to verify my words, he approached and put his hand into my inner pocket.
He pulled out the ring, and the two of them examined it for a while.
"This is supposed to be the Haksen family crest? Honey Bee, can you tell?"
"Well... I'm not sure."
Oh no, they don't know our family's emblem.
No matter how incompetent they are, how can they not know the Haksen family crest? This has never happened in my life.
I never expected my secret weapon to be blocked for such an absurd reason.
"Sacrifice, don't you have more convincing evidence than this?"
"If you really are Damien Haksen's nephew, you'd have more solid proof."
"Damien Haksen freely travels between dimensions and can cut through the sky with a single sword."
"He treats dragon legions like pets and commands tens of thousands of elves like slaves, right?"
"If you're the blood relative of such a person, you must have some amazing ability. Show us."
What nonsense are they talking about? My uncle is amazing, not me.
Well, if they could make proper deductions, they wouldn't be doing dark magic.
"If I had such abilities, I wouldn't have been caught like this."
"Hmm."
"If you really can't believe it, take that ring and ask other people. They'll all recognize it."
"Hmm."
The longer my explanation went on, the deeper their suspicious looks became.
No, this is really unfair. I've never lied, yet I'm being treated like a liar.
"My Honey Bee? I think this child is lying to us."
"My Rose. We shouldn't have listened seriously. There's no way Damien Haksen's nephew would be wandering around a place like this."
"No, it's really true..."
I was so frustrated that I protested in a resentful voice without realizing it.
Then suddenly, the woman pointed her index finger straight at me.
"Wait! Be quiet!"
"My Rose! Did you receive a revelation?"
Rose nodded her head rapidly up and down and pulled something from her chest.
Uh... what is that?
Something the size of my fist... a gem?
It looks like a gem, but it's strange somehow. It looks more like flesh than a mineral.
Most suspicious of all, it's emitting some kind of blackish smoke.
"Ahh... ahhh..."
Rose lifted the black mass high with an ecstatic expression.
I don't know what she's doing, but I can tell it's not normal.
Black veins started to stand out on her skin not covered by clothes.
"I... I understand... I understand... I'll accept... I'll accept it... I'll follow... I'll follow those words exactly..."
Rose kept muttering incomprehensible words, then put the black mass back into her inner pocket.
Then she looked at Honey Bee and said this.
"My Honey Bee, that person praised us. He said we found the perfect sacrifice!"
"My Rose! Is that really true? I knew that person would be pleased too!"
The two of them jumped up and down while holding hands.
It gives me goosebumps. I wish they'd do their lovey-dovey stuff where I can't see it.
"But to properly use this child, we need other sacrifices!"
"M-more sacrifices? C-can we do it well? Won't it be too difficult?"
"No need to worry! We just need to kill them! Then that person will absorb their souls!"
"Is that really true? I'm confident in killing! What a relief, Rose!"
Somehow their conversation is taking an ominous turn.
But I'm not particularly worried.
In a city this large, skilled knights should be on standby at all times.
Amateur dark mages who haven't even made sacrifices before couldn't possibly beat the knights of a major city.
...That's what I thought.
"Honey Bee, are you ready?"
"Of course, Rose. Let's start right away."
Suddenly Rose split the black mass into two pieces and handed half to Honey Bee.
And then they both swallowed the masses whole!
"Ah... ahh!"
"Urgh... uhhh!"
The two started suffering in agony, embracing each other's shoulders.
No, to swallow something so suspicious. Did they not receive proper home education as children?
Well, if they had proper parents, they wouldn't have become dark mages.
"Uh, uhhh..."
"Urgh, ahhh..."
Black smoke began pouring out of their agonized bodies.
"Dark magic?"
Since my uncle had shown me a few times, I could quickly identify what the black smoke was.
But something's strange. The amount of dark magic power the two are emitting keeps increasing.
In the blink of an eye, the area around them was filled with dark magic power.
And it wasn't enough, so it started pushing against the warehouse's outer walls.
Huh, wait? This is a bit strange.
Weren't these two wandering dark mages?
Then how do they have such enormous dark magic power?
"Kyaaaah!"
"Graaah!"
Then the two finally couldn't endure the pain and screamed.
The dark magic power responded and surged.
At the same time, the building's outer walls exploded and were destroyed.
In the blink of an eye, the warehouse flew away and everything became bright.
At the same time, I could hear the screams of people outside.
"Kyaaaah!"
"Th-the warehouse exploded!"
"D-dark magic! It's dark mages!"
Unlike the commotion outside, the two looked very peaceful.
"Phew, now I can breathe a bit."
"My Rose, you endured well."
They even encouraged each other with very refreshed expressions.
"Um, excuse me... what did you just consume?"
I asked in a trembling voice. I wasn't asking out of curiosity, but out of fear.
"You were curious about that? We temporarily contained that great person in our bodies."
"Th-that great person?"
"You wouldn't understand even if I told you. Someone very remarkable who was once called a Great Demon. We contained that person's thought-form in our bodies."
"Thanks to that, we can handle such enormous power."
Huh?
Huh?
Great Demon? A Great Demon's thought-form?
"U-Uncle!"
I instinctively called my uncle's name.
"This is terrible! H-hurry! Please come quickly!"
I desperately called for my uncle. Seeing me like this, the two just laughed.
"Uncle? That Damien Haksen?"
"Our sacrifice is calling for Damien Haksen? I'm trembling with fear."
"Sacrifice, we told you that lie won't work on us..."
Swoosh.
With a sound like cutting through water, the air split open.
"Huh?"
"What?"
The two looked at the black line with confused faces.
Soon, as my uncle appeared by tearing through the air, both their mouths gaped wide open.
"What?"
My uncle was equally surprised.
He looked back and forth between me and the two of them.
"These fucking bastards..."
Soon he glared with a face radiating cold fury.
"What were you trying to do to my nephew?"
It was just a short sentence, but both their faces turned completely pale.
Those two must feel it instinctively too. What kind of being is standing before them.
Still, it's fortunate for them.
Since my uncle hasn't lost his reason, their chances of survival have increased even a little bit...
"Stop!"
"Move and we'll kill this brat!"
Suddenly the two pressed blades to my throat and shouted.
Huh? They shouldn't do this.
If they do this...
"Grrr..."
...my uncle will lose his reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: SS 5
chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 5: Theo's Escapade (3)
When the black-clad man tore through the void and emerged, Rose and Honey Bee felt bewildered.
What the hell is that? Could dimensional portals really be opened that easily?
Naturally, opening and closing dimensional portals was something only particularly exceptional beings among the Grand Mages could accomplish.
Even then, it required many materials and lengthy preparation time.
Yet this man crossed through dimensional portals as easily as opening an ordinary door.
'What the hell is his identity?'
'Was there really such a mage in the world?'
At that moment, the black-clad man's gaze turned toward the two of them.
The instant they met his eyes, which seemed to contain molten rubies, both felt goosebumps rise across their entire bodies.
Chills and terror flowed down their spines before spreading throughout their entire bodies.
There wasn't a single part from head to toe that wasn't trembling.
Powerful?
Such words were inadequate.
They couldn't see the end of it.
They couldn't even dare to gauge it.
'Wh-what the hell is this?' 'Wh-where did such a monster appear from?'
In their terrible confusion, the two suddenly found their answer.
The words of the boy they had kidnapped to use as a sacrifice came to mind.
Damien Haksen.
The transcendent being who had saved the world over ten years ago.
The absolute being who had single-handedly slaughtered five Great Demons.
The despair of dark mages.
'N-no way...'
'That brat was really Damien Haksen's nephew...?'
To dark mages, the name Damien Haksen was synonymous with death.
Damien Haksen despised dark mages and never forgave even third-rate dark mages.
In fact, the number of dark mages worldwide had reached near extinction levels due to Damien Haksen.
'I-I want to live.'
'I-I don't want to die.'
But they couldn't just quietly die like this.
Even mindless insects struggle to survive—that was the law of the world.
But their opponent was Damien Haksen.
With their abilities, they could never win.
They had to find another way.
Perhaps because they had been lovers for so long.
Even without exchanging words, the two were in agreement.
"Stop!"
"Move and we'll kill this brat!"
The two almost simultaneously pressed blades to the boy's neck and shouted.
***
The moment he saw this, calm disappeared from Damien Haksen's eyes.
His face, which had at least retained some humanity, transformed like a beast.
'...'
'...'
Seeing this sight, both realized immediately.
They had doused themselves in oil and leaped into a fire pit.
Grrrowl.
The moment Damien Haksen lost his clam, the entire world burst into flames.
It wasn't actual fire rising up.
It was just the extremely enraged Damien Haksen unleashing his killing intent.
But to the two, it made no difference.
Their lungs burned as if drinking fire.
Their skin felt like it was sizzling on a hot iron plate.
It seemed like the fluid in their eyes would evaporate.
If they relaxed even slightly, their hearts would stop and they would die.
'Ugh, ughhh...'
'Guh, guhhhh...'
In this moment, the two felt like they had become ants.
Yes, ants.
Insignificant creatures too small to properly see the world.
Pitiful insects that couldn't properly recognize humans even when they were right in front of them.
But what if those ants could recognize the existence of humans?
What if they learned that beings tens of thousands of times larger and more powerful than themselves existed?
What if those powerful beings were aware of them?
Wouldn't those ants go insane?
'Huh, huhhhh... huhhhhhh...'
'Hah, hahhhh... huhhhh...'
Eventually, the two had to use dark magic to protect their bodies in order to overcome their fear.
It was the first time they had used dark magic not to kill someone, but to survive.
But even so, nothing much changed.
Their hearts were still beating as if they would burst, and their bodies were crying out in pain from the rapidly rising blood pressure.
I don't want to die.
In their fear of death, the two prayed sincerely.
And someone responded to their sincerity.
<Foolish children.>
A familiar voice was heard from deep within their chests.
It was a voice the two had relied on countless times.
<Why do you fear that thing? Why do you think of death when faced with such a trivial being?>
Their opponent was Damien Haksen. He wasn't a being that could be called ‘such a trivial thing.’
However, the two gradually felt their hearts becoming at ease.
That's right. The great one was with them.
A Great Demon.
A powerful being that had once nearly pronounced the world's doom was with them.
Though it was merely a thoughtform, its greatness had not diminished.
The more powerful a being's thoughtform, the clearer sense of self it possessed.
<Do not forget. I am always by your side.>
At the benevolent voice, the two shed tears.
The fear that had been strangling their entire bodies melted away like snow. Their bodies no longer trembled.
"My Honey Bee, did you hear?"
"My Rose, of course I did. They have bestowed a revelation upon us!"
The two looked at each other with bright smiles.
"Honey Bee, there's nothing more to fear. They are with us."
"Rose, there's only one thing we need to do."
Rose pulled out a staff from subspace.
Honey Bee also drew his longsword.
"Damien Haksen! Prepare yourself!"
"We'll avenge them here!"
Tremendous power flowed from him.
Massive dark magic swirled around them.
When Rose raised her staff, thousands of magic circles were drawn in the night sky.
When Honey Bee gripped his longsword, a dense aura blade shot up.
The two had been chosen by the great one.
They had transcended the realms of Great Mage and sword master.
All that remained was to kill Damien Haksen with this tremendous power...
KRAAAAAAH!
With a beast-like roar, Damien Haksen suddenly kicked Honey Bee.
In that moment, Honey Bee's form disappeared.
Rose looked at Damien Haksen with a bewildered expression.
"...Huh?"
Rose couldn't understand what had just happened at all.
She hadn't seen Damien Haksen move or kick Honey Bee.
"Ho-Honey Bee? Where did you go, leaving me alone..."
Then, something dropped from the sky with a thud.
Blood and flesh stained the ground in a long line.
Seeing this, Rose suddenly came to her senses.
Her mind cleared as if she had entered ice water.
'Wh-what was I just thinking? H-how dare I think of killing Damien Haksen?'
Now that she had returned to her right mind, she realized how ridiculous her thoughts had been.
Grrrowl.
Damien Haksen slowly turned his head to look at Rose.
Breath seething with rage was streaming from deep in his throat.
"Um, excuse me..."
“Grrr.”
"Y-your nephew is safe. W-we didn't do anything to him..."
“KRAAAAAH!”
Damien Haksen mercilessly kicked Rose. Rose's body shot high into the sky.
A moment later, red rain fell to the ground.
"Oh dear."
Theo, who had been watching the scene from the side, smacked his forehead with his palm.
"That's what happens when you provoke Uncle."
***
Only after kicking the two did Damien Haksen regain his reason.
Damn bastards... I killed them too nicely.
Theo looked at Damien with an incredulous expression.
As if to say, ‘You call that killing them nicely?’
Damien, unconcerned by his nephew's gaze, extended his palm into the air.
Then black wind began to gather.
The black wind clumped together in one place and became a black mass.
<KYAAAAAAH! AAAAAAAAH!>
Surprisingly, the black mass was screaming.
Damien twisted one corner of his mouth and spoke to the black mass.
"Iota, I never expected to find a fragment of you in a place like this."
<Damien! Damien Haksen! How dare you kill Theta...! I'll kill you! I'll kill you!>
"You think a mere thoughtform can accomplish what even the main body couldn't? Well, I suppose a thoughtform can't think properly anyway."
The more powerful a being, the clearer thoughtform it leaves behind.
What about a thoughtform left by a Great Demon-level being?
Not only was it intelligent enough to be mistaken for being alive, but it possessed tremendous power.
Enough to be difficult to handle unless you were Damien Haksen.
But even so, a thoughtform was still just a thoughtform.
It didn't have proper thinking patterns.
Just like how Iota's thoughtform was blindly trying to kill Damien Haksen.
What a nuisance. Disappear already.
Damien clenched his fist and annihilated the thoughtform.
Iota's thoughtform disappeared with a scream.
"Uncle!"
Theo ran toward Damien with his arms spread wide.
Damien smiled brightly and embraced Theo...
This little brat dared to disobey his mother?
...or rather, punched him in the forehead with his fist.
Theo tearfully grabbed his forehead.
"That hurts!"
"When you do wrong, you have to be punished."
"Ow! It hurts!"
Theo protested, but Damien Haksen hit him one more time.
Only after being hit three times did Theo shut his mouth.
“So why weren't you at home? Why did you run away?”
"...I wanted to see the Snow Flower Festival."
“You disobeyed your mother just for that reason?”
"You don't know how much Hazel made fun of me for not seeing the Snow Flower Festival!" Hazel? That little brat from the Ryan Bloom Marquis family?
Theo nodded repeatedly with tears welling up in his eyes.
“Even so, you shouldn't disobey your mother. I'm going to tell her about today.”
"Can't you let it slide if I promise I won't do it again?"
“Didn't you say the same thing when you were caught by bandits last time?”
"This time it's for real! I absolutely won't break my promise!"
Theo jumped up and down as he shouted.
But Damien was firm.
"When you do wrong, you have to be punished. There are no exceptions."
"Waaah..."
Theo drooped his shoulders and sniffled.
Damien glanced at such a Theo and then casually said,
“...Instead, let's go back a bit later.”
"Huh?"
“You said you wanted to see the festival or whatever. Even if you get scolded, you can still see the festival.”
At those words, Theo's mouth spread into a wide grin.
"I love you, Uncle!"
“Don't give me that sweet talk.”
"I mean it!"
Damien chuckled and waved his hand through the air.
Mana enveloped Damien's body.
He returned from being a giant with gray skin to human form.
He hadn't actually become human.
He had just disguised himself with magic.
It was to blend naturally into the festival.
“Is there anything you want to eat?”
"Chicken skewers!"
“Anything else?”
"I like anything as long as I'm eating it with Uncle!"
Theo stuck close to Damien's side.
The two clasped hands and began strolling through the streets.
Behind them, pure white snow flowers were falling.

chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 6: Hazel Ryan Bloom (1)
Hello. It's Theo. Nice to see you again.
How have you been while we were apart?
I got in huge trouble with Mom because of the Schnivalen Kingdom incident and was banned from going outside for two whole months.
But I wasn't too upset about it.
I got to see the Snow Flower Festival like I wanted! And with Uncle too!
Anyway, today is finally the day my house arrest gets lifted! Getting to go outside for the first time in two months!
It's been so long since my heart raced with excitement like this!
Today is going to be such a fun day!
"To think these high nobles would have such lax security! Thanks to that, our job went smoothly!"
...I was sure it would be a fun day.
But now I've been kidnapped and taken to a cave.
I'm not alone though.
There are other kids around my age here too.
None of them are from ordinary backgrounds.
They're all from pretty famous families.
"Finally, the foundation to rule this country has been laid! Everyone rejoice! Our great undertaking has been carried out successfully!"
The bald old man threw his head back and laughed loudly.
"Kahahaha!"
"Uhahahaha!"
It wasn't just the old man.
The people who seemed to be on his side all laughed the same way.
Looking at them, they don't seem like ordinary kidnappers.
The way they brought us here, and they're all wearing matching uniforms.
"Sob, sniff."
"Mommy... Daddy..."
Unlike the cheerful kidnappers, the children were sniffling and crying.
Well, even if they're from noble families, they're all young, so it makes sense they'd be scared.
Am I okay, you ask?
I guess I'm fine since this isn't my first or second time dealing with something like this.
Are you asking if I got into this mess again by disobeying Mom and going out?
No. This time it really wasn't like that.
Then why did I end up caught by these weird people?
Well, here's how it happened...
* * *
The day my house arrest was lifted.
I ran to Uncle first.
I wanted to tell Uncle the good news before anyone else.
"Uncle, my house arrest is lifted!"
But Uncle was nowhere to be seen.
I looked around the basement for quite a while.
"Young Master Theo, you've arrived."
Then, a shadow rose from the ground and transformed into Mr. Dominico.
I immediately grabbed the man and asked where Uncle was.
"Mr. Dominico, where's Uncle?"
"The master entered seclusion at dawn today."
"Seclusion?"
I cried out in surprise.
Usually, knights going into seclusion isn't particularly surprising.
They do it often for training.
But Uncle's case is a bit different.
He's so strong that he doesn't need to train.
There's only one reason why Uncle would go into seclusion.
"Did he find a way to become human again?"
"Yes, it seems he's found a new path."
My lips curved into a smile.
I grinned widely and asked Mr. Dominico again.
"Do you think he'll succeed this time?"
"I'm not sure. After all, he's continued to fail until now..."
This isn't Uncle's first time going into seclusion. But they all ended in failure.
It's amazing, isn't it? That there are things even Uncle can't do.
"If Uncle has gone into seclusion... I won't be able to see him for a while."
Originally, seclusion means locking yourself in a room where no one can reach you.
But in Uncle's case, he goes further and creates another dimension to confine himself.
So he becomes completely cut off from the world.
"He could have at least shown his face before going..."
"He suddenly entered seclusion at dawn, so it couldn't be helped. He said sleep is very important at a young age and didn't want to wake you."
"Tch, I'm not a little kid anymore!"
I protested, clenching my fists. Mr. Dominico smiled silently.
Somehow that made me even more annoyed.
"The master had a message for Young Master Theo."
"Really? What is it? What did he say?"
I waited for Mr. Dominico's words, full of anticipation.
"As you know, once you enter seclusion, you can't receive outside contact. Even if an emergency happens, I won't be able to come save you. I've prepared safety measures, but the best thing is for you not to cause trouble. So stay put until I come out."
"...That's it? Didn't he say anything about going somewhere fun after seclusion ends?"
"No, he didn't."
Tch.
I silently kicked at the ground with my toe.
I'm already annoyed that I can't see Uncle for a while, and he only left nagging behind.
But I understand Uncle's worry.
I have caused quite a few... just a few accidents before.
"Alright. I'll stay put like Uncle said."
Mr. Dominico looked at me with suspicious eyes.
How unfair. No matter how many accidents I've caused, to not trust me this much.
"I'll trust Young Master Theo's promise..."
Suddenly, Mr. Dominico's expression changed. He looked at me and said:
"Young Master Theo, you have a visitor."
"A visitor?"
I felt something strange.
Most visitors to our family come to see Uncle or my other uncle.
"Young Lady Hazel from the Ryan Bloom family has come."
At those words, I immediately ran to the reception room.
In the reception room sat a girl with roll-shaped hair, legs crossed.
The girl saw me, put down her teacup, and lifted the corners of her mouth.
"Theodore Haksen, how can you keep a guest waiting like this?"
I can tell what expression I'm making right now without anyone having to tell me.
I must be making a very displeased expression.
I spoke through gritted teeth as if I'd met my mortal enemy.
"Hazel Ryan Bloom...!"
* * *
"To call a guest's name so carelessly, you need to learn etiquette from the beginning."
The girl, Hazel, said while flicking her hair with one hand.
How can every single action be so annoying?
"But I'll generously forgive you. Outstanding people are naturally more understanding..."
"I told you not to be rude."
The man sitting next to Hazel flicked her forehead with his knuckle.
It must have hurt quite a bit because Hazel grabbed her head and whimpered.
"Dad! Why are you hitting me!"
"Didn't you promise Dad? That you'd be polite when you came to the Haksen Duchy."
"But he came late first!"
"'He'? You should call him Big Brother Theo."
"No way! Why should he be my big brother! He was only born two months earlier!"
Hazel raised her voice in protest.
The man clicked his tongue briefly.
Let me introduce him.
That's Hazel's father and the Head of Ryan Bloom, family Marquis Michael Ryan Bloom.
He's someone who's had a long relationship with Uncle.
I heard he even traveled to the Empire with Uncle once.
That's really enviable.
I want to go play in the Empire with Uncle too!
"Young Master Theo, it's good to see you again."
Mr. Michael bowed his head briefly in front of me.
I waved my hands and said:
"I told you to speak comfortably."
"I can't treat my elder brother's family member carelessly."
Mr. Michael really respects Uncle.
That's why he acts so formally.
"Geez, don't use honorifics with him..."
Hazel glared at me as if she was very displeased.
But what can she do about it? When Mr. Michael has decided to act this way.
"But where is my elder brother?"
"Oh, about that..."
"The master has entered seclusion."
Mr. Dominico, who had appeared behind me, answered instead.
As soon as he saw Mr. Dominico, Mr. Michael frowned and asked again.
"My elder brother has entered seclusion?"
"That's right. I, who the master 'trusts' most among his subordinates, was allowed to deliver this news."
Is it my imagination? It seems like he put extra emphasis on the word 'trusts'.
"Ugh, just because you're by his side doesn't mean you earn his trust..."
"No matter what you babble, it doesn't matter. The fact that I carry out the master's orders most often doesn't change."
The two men glared at each other with frightening eyes.
Why don't they get along, you ask?
I've seen it firsthand, and Uncle was the decisive cause.
Both men have pride in their close relationship with Uncle, so they often clash.
Then one day, both of them came and asked Uncle directly:
"If an urgent situation arises, which of us two would you entrust it to?"
"Dominico."
I don't think Uncle seriously considered his answer.
I was watching from the side, and he was fiddling with something he was researching and answered carelessly.
But Mr. Michael seemed to be greatly shocked by those words.
He suddenly staggered.
"Then which of us two do you think is more excellent!"
Then he suddenly straightened up and asked this.
Uncle answered carelessly again.
"Michael."
This time Mr. Dominico swayed.
That's how the long-standing feud between the two began...!
Well, but now isn't the time to worry about those two.
I also have an opponent I need to settle things with.
I sat across from Hazel and asked:
"What business brings you to our family?"
"You should be grateful I came to visit. Do you know how many nobles beg just to see me once?"
Hazel said, lifting her chin slightly.
Mr. Michael is a tremendous powerhouse called a Grandmaster.
Thanks to that, the Ryan Bloom Marquis family enjoys tremendous influence.
Besides, Hazel is quite popular too.
She's famous for her doll-like appearance, and there are countless nobles who want to arrange engagements with her in advance.
Though I absolutely cannot acknowledge it.
What's pretty about this wicked girl? Our aunts are much prettier.
Especially Aunt Athena once received a marriage proposal from the king.
She rejected it on the spot though.
No, that's not what's important right now.
"You should speak properly. Ryan Bloom can freely enter and exit our family because of Uncle and Mr. Michael's connections."
While they might have dozens of people a day, we have hundreds coming from across the continent.
Normally, even the Ryan Bloom Marquis family would have to wait a long time to enter our family.
But because Mr. Michael is Uncle's acquaintance, they can ignore all those complicated procedures.
"Ugh."
Unable to find words for my point, Hazel closed her mouth.
This wicked girl is always like this.
She tries to beat me in everything. She wants to prove that she's superior to me.
Hazel loves her father too much. She thinks her father is the best.
But that father acts like he'd give up his liver and gallbladder when he stands before Uncle, so she can't stand it.
So she wants to beat at least me to feel superior.
"...I was joking. There's no way I'd come to see you for that reason."
"It didn't sound like a joke."
"Our family is preparing a social gathering this time. Only nobles under 15 like you and me can participate."
"Sounds like you're changing the subject."
At my point, Hazel's face turned bright red.
"...It's a gathering for friendship among young nobles like us. I'd appreciate it if you participated too."
To completely ignore it so cleanly after being hit right on target.
She's definitely not a girl to underestimate.
"You'll come, right?"
Hazel asked with an expectant face.
Just from her eyes, I can clearly see her intentions.
She's probably planning to beat me in front of a gathering full of peer nobles.
She's always done that.
It might be fun to accept the challenge, but wise people don't go to dangerous places.
"I appreciate the invitation, but it'll be hard for me to participate."
"Don't tell me you're scared of crowds? You're not a coward."
This girl.
I was irritated but held it in. It would hurt my pride to fall for Hazel's provocation.
"It's not that. I just got my house arrest lifted today. I need to be careful for a while, and I don't think Mom would allow me to participate in a social gathering."
At the mention of house arrest, Hazel's expression became blank.
She seems angry that her carefully made plans have come to nothing.
"...Do you think you can avoid my trap with that excuse?"
Now she's even boldly admitting it's a trap.
Hazel is definitely stupid.
"Follow me. I'll get permission right away."
Huh? Get permission?
There's no way she has that kind of power.
I followed Hazel in bewilderment.
And I immediately found out what plan Hazel had.
"Mother, is this spot cool?"
"Oh my, such small hands but so skillful."
As soon as we arrived at Mom's room, Hazel stuck to her like a leech and started massaging her shoulders.
Oh no, Mom.
You usually dote on Hazel a bit too much, but I didn't expect you to fall for it this easily.
"I want to go to a social gathering with Theo. Could you give permission?"
"A social gathering?"
Mom's expression hardened slightly.
As expected, she doesn't like me leaving the house right after my house arrest is lifted.
"I'll ask like this. Please? Theo and I really want to go."
Hazel kneaded Mom's shoulders firmly.
Mom giggled and eventually gave in to Hazel's request.
"Since you're asking so earnestly, I can't refuse. You two have fun."
"Really? Thank you!"
Hazel hugged Mom tightly.
And from behind Mom's back, she looked at me with a triumphant expression.
Wow.
Her skill at buttering up my mom is extraordinary.
I admit it.
This time, I lost to Hazel.

chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 7: Hazel Ryan Bloom (2)
And so I ended up attending the social gathering hosted by the Ryan Bloom Marquis family.
I don't like that I fell for Hazel's scheme, but I have to admit I'm excited about going out after such a long time.
Besides, this is my first time at a gathering with so many children my age. So of course I'd be looking forward to it.
"Hazel, you must take good care of Young master Theo."
"Young master Theo, please enjoy yourself and have fun."
Oh, those two didn't come along.
Uncle Michael said he wouldn't go since it was just kids playing around, and Uncle Dominico had too much work to do.
How long did we travel by carriage? Suddenly Hazel stuck her head out the window and shouted.
"Theo! Quick, open the window and look! Over there!"
I did as Hazel said.
Then I saw a large mansion built on green fields.
That must be the Ryan Bloom family's villa where the social gathering is being held.
"How is it? Pretty, right?"
Hazel asked me with a confident expression.
It was as if she was saying, "This is your first time seeing a villa like this, isn't it?"
I got a bit annoyed.
I couldn't just let this nasty girl get the better of me.
"It's pretty."
"Take a good look while you have the chance. You can't see mansions like this anywhere else..."
"It's not as good as the villa Uncle built on top of the World Tree, though."
"World Tree...?"
It must have been unexpected because Hazel's expression went blank.
I lifted my chin slightly and said.
"Yeah, Uncle built it himself. It's built up really high so you can see everywhere from there."
"Don't lie. The World Tree is the elves' treasure. How could anyone build a villa there?"
"Did you forget who my uncle is?"
At my retort, Hazel clamped her mouth shut.
Then she turned her head away sharply.
She seems pretty upset.
I didn't show it, but I was secretly pleased.
***
A little later, we two arrived at the mansion.
All the servants working at the mansion came outside and bowed.
They're all very well-disciplined.
"Where are the guests?"
"They're gathered in the reception room."
The head maid answered Hazel's question.
Hazel immediately grabbed my hand and pulled me along.
"Come on. We need to greet the guests."
I was led by Hazel toward the reception room.
The closer we got, the louder the bustling sounds became.
There must be quite a lot of guests who arrived before us.
Hazel forcefully opened the reception room door.
This drew everyone's attention to us.
"Miss Hazel?"
"Lady Hazel!"
The reaction was absolutely enthusiastic.
The guests who had been scattered around the reception room having conversations all rushed over and surrounded Hazel.
"You've become even more beautiful since we last saw you!"
"Lady Rabel, you're the one whose skin is practically glowing."
"The mansion is so pretty, I was completely surprised!"
"Thank you for the kind words. I'll give you a personal tour later."
Wow, amazing.
To handle all those people so calmly like that.
I heard that Hazel was incredibly famous in high society, and it seems that was really true.
"M-Miss Hazel! It's an honor to meet you like this!"
"Do you perhaps remember me? We met once in the capital..."
It wasn't just the girls.
The male nobles were also desperately trying to strike up conversations with Hazel.
"Of course I remember. You were with your younger brother, right?"
"Ah... I never thought you'd remember!"
When Hazel responded to the conversation, a smile full of happiness appeared on his face.
He seems incredibly happy just to have exchanged a word with Hazel.
Hazel really is popular indeed.
Well, she may be nasty, but she is pretty.
I'll give her that much.
Then, our eyes suddenly met.
Hazel raised one corner of her mouth in a smirk.
That damn girl...
What's the reason she's making that expression while looking at me?
Isn't she showing off her popularity? To feel superior even in this situation, she's really annoying.
"But Lady Hazel, who is that person?"
Then, one of the young noble ladies asked while looking at me.
"Oh, I was late introducing him. You'll all be meeting him for the first time. This is Theodore Haksen..."
At that moment, the reception room suddenly became quiet as if cold water had been poured on it.
The change was so sudden that even Hazel was flustered and closed her mouth.
"Haksen? The Haksen Ducal family?"
"That's the family where Damien Haksen is!"
"A boy our age from the Haksen Ducal family... that can only be Damien Haksen's nephew!"
"Damien Haksen's nephew is here?"
People immediately rushed toward me.
They surrounded me and bombarded me with all kinds of questions.
"Y-Young master Theodore! Are you really Lord Damien Haksen's nephew?"
"Is it true that Lord Damien Haksen can do anything with just one sword?"
"They say even the Imperial Supreme Sword can't move in front of Lord Damien Haksen!"
Aaaah.
I unconsciously stepped backward.
This was the first time in my life I'd received such excessive attention.
I looked at Hazel with pleading eyes, not knowing what to do.
"...Grrr."
But Hazel was trembling so much she didn't even notice my gaze.
I guess she didn't expect people to be this enthusiastic about me.
But not all the nobles had swarmed me yet.
The young male nobles who had been seeking Hazel's attention were still there.
"...Everyone seems very curious about Lord Damien Haksen. Shall we step aside for a moment?"
Hazel asked the young male nobles with a forced smile.
At that moment, the young male nobles all rushed toward me at once.
"I-I've always admired Lord Damien Haksen!"
"P-please, if it's alright, tell us about Lord Damien Haksen!"
The young male nobles questioned me even more enthusiastically than before.
"Th-this..."
Left alone, Hazel glared at me with tears welling up in her eyes.
Hmm.
It's satisfying, but I feel a bit wronged.
Honestly, I didn't do anything wrong, did I?
***
The questioning continued after that.
"Is it true that Lord Damien Haksen has millions of undead legions under his command?"
"That can't be true."
"Then the rumor about dwarves working as undead is also false?"
"Oh, that one's true."
No, rather than continued, it would be more accurate to say it never ended.
People asked all sorts of questions as if they were determined to satisfy all their curiosity with this opportunity.
Actually, the Haksen Ducal family rarely engages in external activities despite its fame.
It's because of Uncle's policy.
He said that since the entire continent's attention is already focused on the Haksen Ducal family because of him, frequent external activities wouldn't be beneficial.
The person who saved me from the barrage of questions was none other than Hazel.
Clap!
Hazel drew people's attention with applause and then said this:
"Doesn't everyone feel stuffy just staying inside?"
A servant who had arrived in the reception room was holding out a bow made of ash wood.
Hazel picked up the bow and said to the people.
"How about we warm up our bodies in preparation for tomorrow's hunt? It would also be fun to compete in archery skills, don't you think?"
It must have been a really good suggestion.
People nodded their heads, forgetting about questioning me.
"That sounds great!"
"I'm in favor too."
The young male nobles shouted with faces full of competitive spirit.
Being at the age when their blood runs hot, they probably couldn't just pass by the word ‘competition.’
The young ladies looked at the young male nobles with excited faces.
"Then please come downstairs when you're ready."
Saying that, Hazel went downstairs first.
She didn't forget to glare at me on the way down.
***
"10 points!"
When the arrow hit the center of the target, a servant raised a flag and shouted.
"Wow."
"Woooow."
People all exclaimed in admiration at the sight.
Hazel smiled briefly and lowered her bow.
"Lady Hazel, you're amazing!"
"You've hit the center for the fourth time already!"
Surprisingly, the winner of the archery competition didn't come from among the young male nobles.
Hazel won overwhelmingly with superior skills.
"My condition just happened to be a bit better today."
Hazel was being modest like that, but her eyes weren't modest at all.
They were full of satisfaction.
What was I doing, you ask?
Oh, I was...
"Ugh, ughhh!"
"Young master Theo! That's it! Pull just a little harder!"
Embarrassingly, I couldn't even draw the bowstring.
So now I'm receiving one-on-one instruction from another noble.
In the end, I had to lower the bow again without being able to fully draw the string.
"Ah, you almost had it."
The young noble who was teaching me said regretfully.
I could only make an awkward expression.
"You taught me so earnestly, but I'm not keeping up."
"Not at all! Young master Theodore, you did well. It's just that I'm lacking..."
"I see things aren't going well?"
Then, I heard a voice I didn't want to hear.
When I turned my head, I saw Hazel with a faint sneer.
"You should have practiced hard usually. Like me."
This damn girl.
She's trying to beat me with all these people watching?
The problem is that it's a valid point, so I have nothing to say.
But I couldn't just admit defeat.
I wiped the sweat from my forehead and said.
"I should have worked hard usually like you said."
"It's not too late now. If you work hard following my example..."
"I don't need to practice archery. Uncle catches everything for me if I just ask."
At that moment, exclamations burst out from among the nobles.
"What do you mean Lord Damien Haksen catches everything for you?"
"Well, exactly that. He catches them with magic or his sword."
"H-hunting prey with a sword? By throwing it? Does he throw it to hit them?"
"He just swings it casually and the prey appears right in front of us."
"W-wooooow!"
As soon as I mentioned Uncle, the atmosphere changed instantly.
Hazel glared at me with a disgusted expression.
It was as if she was saying she definitely wouldn't let me off next time.
It's a bit underhanded, but what can I do? She's the one who picked the fight first.
"How noisy. Are nobles these days always this talkative?"
Then, I heard an unfamiliar voice.
I reflexively looked in the direction of the sound.
Then I saw a bald man in a purple robe.
Maybe it was because of his skinny body and hooked nose.
Somehow it felt like I was looking at a large bald eagle rather than a person.
The problem is how that person got here.
This is the Ryan Bloom Marquis family's territory.
There's no way such a suspicious-looking person could have entered.
Hazel must have had the same thought as me. She immediately shouted toward the air.
"An intruder has appeared!"
Knights immediately burst out from the forest.
The knights blocked the man's path and drew their swords to point at him.
As expected of the Ryan Bloom Marquis family's knights.
Swift and precise.
But even seeing the knights, the bald man wasn't scared at all.
"Quite excellent guard dogs, but..."
Instead, he twisted his lips and raised the back of his hand.
On the back of his sickly white hand, a black pattern was floating.
"They're nothing compared to the power bestowed by the Lord of Hell."
Right after the monster said that, darkness covered everything before my eyes.
And when the darkness lifted, the children and I had been kidnapped to a cave where an altar was set up.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: SS 8
chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 8: The Twilight Cult (1)
Now you get it, right? This time it's really not my fault!
I didn't do anything wrong but got kidnapped!
...Thinking about it this way makes me feel really wronged.
I got mom's permission to go out and play, but trouble happened again.
I was lamenting my fate when something grabbed my arm tightly.
When I looked down, Hazel was clinging to my arm.
When did this girl come over to my side again?
I tried to pull my arm away because it was uncomfortable, but Hazel hugged my arm even tighter.
And then she muttered in a voice that sounded like she was about to cry.
"Daddy..."
Hmm.
Even though I dislike Hazel, I can't act coldly after hearing something like that.
I decided to quietly let her have one arm.
"You all must be curious about our identity."
Then the bald man spoke to us.
I looked around.
Everyone seemed terrified rather than curious.
"We are called the Twilight Cult."
The bald man revealed his affiliation with a very proud expression.
...The Twilight Cult?
What's that? I know about the Church.
"...Have you all perhaps never heard of us?"
When we remained quiet, the bald man asked with a shocked expression.
Naturally, no answer came.
"Ahem, well then, don't you have any questions? About our Twilight Cult's doctrine or purpose?"
He seemed itching to explain what the Twilight Cult was.
He looked so pitiful that I raised my hand high.
"What is the Twilight Cult?"
"An excellent question!"
The bald man shouted with delight. He seemed incredibly happy that I asked.
"We are a cult that serves the great lord of hell, ruler of bitter cold, Demon Marquis Bethpoll. We are Bethpoll's faithful servants."
Demons!
I've heard about them from uncle!
Long ago, they were idiots who were defeated by humanity and driven to hell!
And there are morons who worship such idiots, called demon worshippers!
It's really amazing to meet these morons in person.
"So you used demonic power to kidnap us?"
"Smart child. You got it exactly right."
Oh, so that's how it was.
That's why we were kidnapped without the knights having any chance to stop it.
Uncle said demons are idiots who don't know their place but are quite strong.
Strong enough to be difficult for humans to handle.
But no matter how I think about it, it's strange.
Uncle captures demon worshippers on sight just like dark mages.
That's why I heard demon worshippers hide their identities like dark mages.
But why did this person cause such a major incident?
"You seem curious about our purpose."
The bald man asked with a grin.
I never asked, but I decided to keep my mouth shut.
The man seemed to want to talk.
"Our purpose is to offer ecstasy, joy, and satisfaction to Lord Bethpoll!"
...What is he talking about?
Seeing my incomprehensible expression, the bald man explained again.
"...We plan to dominate this country and make Lord Bethpoll descend to earth."
Ah, now I understand a bit.
Wait, make a demon descend?
Uncle told me that for a demon to descend, many sacrifices are needed.
So these people mean to use our kingdom's people as sacrifices to make a demon descend.
They're much worse people than I thought.
"But what does dominating the kingdom have to do with kidnapping us?"
"You're heirs of high-ranking families, aren't you? We plan to use you to ultimately control your families."
So they waited for an opportunity to capture us all.
But no matter how I think about it, it's strange.
Why did they choose the Apple Kingdom of all places?
The Apple Kingdom has my uncle.
No matter how much these people are morons who worship idiots, they can't not know what kind of existence uncle is.
"Excuse me."
"Do you have another question? Ask anything. I'll tell you everything."
He's been really kind from the start.
It's hard to believe he's a moron who worships demons.
"You should just let us go."
"Haha, do you trust your families? It's useless. This place is protected by Lord Bethpoll's power. No one can find it."
"Our uncle can find us."
"Who is your uncle that you speak so confidently?"
"Damien Haksen."
The bald man asked me with his brow deeply furrowed.
"...Damien Haksen? That crazy transcendent?"
"Yes, that's right."
"That bastard is your uncle?"
"That's right."
A long silence followed this conversation.
Well, there's no one who wouldn't be surprised hearing uncle's name...
"Kahaha! What luck! We even captured Damien Haksen's nephew!"
"Cult leader! Heaven seems to be helping us!"
"You fool! It's not heaven but hell that's helping us!"
The Twilight Cult members were greatly pleased rather than afraid.
Huh? This isn't the reaction I expected.
"Little one, I know what you're thinking. You thought we'd tremble at hearing Damien Haksen's name and let you go, right?"
"Yes, but..."
"Too bad. Damien Haksen's name doesn't work on us."
What, what did he say?
This time it was my turn to be surprised.
I stared at the bald man with wide eyes.
Could they have obtained information that uncle went into seclusion?
That's right.
That must be it.
They found out uncle was away and attacked the Apple Kingdom in the meantime.
Despite appearances, they're thorough morons!
"Because we know all too well that Damien Haksen is a fraud."
A fraud?
What kind of nonsense is this?
"The great lord Bethpoll told us the truth. That all of Damien Haksen's achievements are fake!"
"Slaying demon kings, saving the world, it's all just rumors spread by the Empire!"
"It's all part of the Empire's conspiracy to terrify dark mages and demon worshippers!"
"It never made sense to begin with. A mere human killing five demon kings."
Wow.
Wooow.
I'm so dumbfounded I can't speak.
I don't know where to start refuting this.
"You're saying Damien Haksen is a liar?"
"Th-that can't be!"
The problem is these morons' attitude is so confident that some nobles are starting to believe them.
"Still, Damien Haksen's nephew would be very useful! I'll give you special treatment."
The bald man grabbed my wrist while laughing loudly.
"You'd better follow quietly. Otherwise, you'll face terrible consequences!"
"Th-Theo!"
Hazel hugged my arm even tighter, as if she wouldn't let me be taken away.
But there's no way she can stop the bald man like this.
Actually, even if Hazel didn't step forward, I wouldn't be dragged away.
Why?
Because uncle installed a safety device in advance.
Swoosh.
An unexpected sound came.
At the same time, bright red blood dripped to the ground.
"..."
The bald man didn't immediately realize what had happened.
Only after a moment did he realize his wrist had been pierced by a blade.
"Ahhhhh!"
The bald man grabbed his wrist and stepped back.
He glared at me with a pained expression and shouted.
"You, you bastard! What is that!"
An iron sword was sticking out of my shadow.
Soon after, a skeleton in armor walked out of the shadow.
Seeing the skeleton, the bald man's face contorted completely.
"A skeleton? How dare a mere skeleton wound my body?"
The bald man pointed at the skeleton man and screamed.
"What are you all doing! Destroy that lowly skeleton immediately!"
As soon as the order was given, the Twilight Cult followers moved.
They changed their legs to be like wolves and reached the skeleton in the blink of an eye.
"How dare you lay hands on the cult leader!"
"We'll turn you to powder!"
The cult members' arms swelled up like logs.
The members swung those huge arms as lightly as tree branches.
It was a dangerous sight, but the skeleton didn't retreat.
Instead, he swung the iron sword in his hand.
"You stupid skeleton!"
"Our flesh is imbued with Lord Bethpoll's holy power!"
"Do you think you can cut through that!"
What happened next is hard for me to describe.
All I could see were flashes of light several times.
Then the Twilight Cult followers' bodies were cut into small pieces and scattered to the floor.
The bald man muttered with a shocked expression.
"How could a mere skeleton cut through Lord Bethpoll's power?"
"It's annoying how you keep calling me 'mere skeleton.'"
"A-a skeleton is even talking?"
"You're spouting nonsense."
The skeleton said while shouldering his longsword.
"Did you really think an undead of Damien Haksen would be ordinary?"
Who is this person?
He's an undead who serves uncle like Mr. Dominico.
He was originally Mr. Dominico's soldier, but after some incident, he decided to pledge loyalty to uncle.
Besides Mr. Jackson, there are many skeleton men.
They're all grateful people who protect Spring Castle and our family.
"Young master Theo, do you recognize who I am?"
"You're Mr. Jackson."
"Hah, as expected, only Young master Theo can distinguish between us."
Mr. Jackson laughed as if very pleased.
Because other people can't distinguish between the skeleton men well.
"Im-impossible... A fraud like Damien Haksen couldn't be commanding such undead!"
"Shut up and stick out your neck and wait. You have to pay the price for touching Young master Theo."
Mr. Jackson pretended to spit in his palm and walked toward the bald man.
Then one corner of the bald man's mouth lifted.
"You seem to have some skill, but... it won't work on us who serve Lord Bethpoll."
The bald man raised both arms. Then the remaining followers threw off their robes.
"Everyone, release the power you received from Lord Bethpoll!"
As soon as he finished speaking, terrifying dark magic power burst from the followers.
It didn't stop there and their bodies began to mutate.
"Ughhh!"
"Graahhh!"
Their skin turned black, sharp horns grew from their foreheads, and thick claws sprouted from their hands.
They looked like demons. Maybe not 'like' but actual demons?
"Do you think you can stop us who have received Lord Bethpoll's favor?"
The bald man spoke while letting out a laugh mixed with ecstasy.
"To face us, you'd need to bring at least a Sword Master..."
Then magic power burst from Mr. Jackson's iron sword.
The magic power wove together to create a sharp blade.
Seeing this, the bald man's eyes widened as if they might pop out.
"...A-aurablade? A mere skeleton is using an aurablade?"
Amazing, right?
Other kingdoms might have one Sword Master at most, but our family has very many.
All the skeleton men are Sword Masters.
I once asked uncle curiously how all the skeleton men were Sword Masters.
"They say people can do anything if they're prepared to die."
"Ah, I've heard that too!"
"But those guys don't die, right? So I worked them to death."
That was his answer.
No wonder the skeleton men have seizures when uncle suggests training.
"D-don't be scared, everyone! All charge together! Ignore the skeleton and take those brats behind him as hostages!"
But perhaps because he's the leader after all.
The bald man quickly came to his senses and gave tactical orders.
Well, even a Sword Master can't handle multiple opponents with one hand.
But no chance. There's more than one skeleton man hiding in my shadow.
Skeleton men poured out of my shadow.
The newly appeared skeleton men also held weapons covered with aurablades.
"..."
The bald man's face hardened pale.
The Twilight Cult followers behind him also flinched.
But the skeleton men weren't the type to go easy on them.
"These bastards dare to touch Young master Theo?"
"What are you all doing? Sweep them all away!"
With rough shouts, the skeleton men all charged at once.
Naturally, the battle ended quickly.
When the skeleton men swung their swords a few times, all the followers fell to the ground bleeding.
"Th-this can't be... To the great Twilight Cult followers... by mere undead of Damien Haksen...!"
Seeing this, the bald man entered denial of reality.
That's what happens when you believe demons.
"I-I can't accept this! Something is wrong here!"
Suddenly the bald man pulled out something like a large crystal from his pocket.
The moment the crystal was revealed, all the skeleton men flinched.
"What the hell is this crazy bastard carrying?"
"Stop him! We can't let him break that!"
The skeleton men rushed urgently.
But before the skeleton men could stop him, the bald man gripped the crystal tightly.
With a clear sound, the crystal shattered completely.
The incident happened right after.
An invisible force pushed all the skeleton men away.
Even the skeleton men who had reached the realm of Sword Master were blown backward without being able to use their strength properly.
"Damn! He already broke it!"
"This crazy bastard finally did it!"
Unlike the panicked skeleton men, the bald man was laughing in ecstasy.
"Uhahahaha! That person is descending! Though it's an avatar, there's no doubt about that person's power!"
A door made of bricks appeared in the empty air.
Soon the door shattered and a giant burst out.
No, it wasn't human.
Only the muscular body was human, but the head was that of a goat.
"Who dares oppress my precious servants!"
When the demon opened his mouth, the entire cave resonated thunderously.
I felt it as soon as I saw him.
This won't do. No one can stop this. Only uncle can.
"Our great lord!"
"Yes, my servant. Tell me. Who dared oppress you!"
"Th-those bastards!"
The bald man pointed at the skeleton men.
Then Bethpoll's presence became even stronger.
"Pretty strong for skeletons! But such strength is useless before me!"
Bethpoll walked stride by stride toward the skeleton men.
The skeleton men raised their weapons with determined eyes.
"How dare you try to oppose me! I'll turn you to powder immediately!"
That must have really touched Bethpoll's nerves.
His already muscular body swelled even larger.
That's when it happened.
Suddenly Bethpoll was startled and looked at me.
"Th-this familiar scent... You! What's your relationship with Damien Haksen!"
"Um... I'm his nephew."
As soon as he heard my answer, Bethpoll's body shrank like a deflated balloon.
Bethpoll asked again with trembling eyes.
"D-don't lie. There's no way Damien Haksen's nephew would be here!"
"It's true. My name is Theodore Haksen."
"...!"
Hearing my answer, Bethpoll covered his face with his palms and muttered quietly.
"I'm fucked."
