chapters.title: Chapter 361: SS 9
chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 9: The Twilight Cult (2)
The goat-headed demon clutched his head with both hands and muttered.
"Shit, of all people, they had to mess with Damien Haksen's bloodline."
Not only that, but he screamed at the bald man.
"You crazy human bastard! What the hell were you thinking pulling this stunt? No, it's your freedom to do whatever, but why drag me into this!"
The bald man, who had suddenly been cursed at by the demon he served, looked extremely wronged.
"We... we only thought Lord Bethpoll would be pleased if we offered this country to you."
"Offer this country? Why the hell did you think of something so pointless!"
"We were going to sacrifice this country's people to bring Lord Bethpoll's true body down to earth..."
"This bastard has really lost his mind! Did I ever say even the first letter of 'descent'? I didn't! So why are you acting on your own and causing chaos!"
"Well, descending to earth has always been the common goal of all demons since ancient times. So naturally, we thought Lord Bethpoll would want that too..."
"That was back in the old days! Nobody wants that now! I guarantee you, there isn't a single demon who wants to go to earth! Why would anyone want to come to a place where there's a monster like Damien Haksen!"
When Bethpoll showed disgust, the bald man looked even more confused.
"Lord Bethpoll, why exactly do you fear Damien Haksen? You told us in the Twilight Cult that Damien Haksen was a fraud and not scary at all!"
"Of course that was a lie."
"A... a lie? But why would you do such a thing..."
"So you would offer human souls to me."
The bald man's face went blank.
Bethpoll clicked his tongue disdainfully and continued.
"Damien Haksen's infamy is so great that demon worshippers have dried up completely. But I wanted to eat human souls. So what was I supposed to do? I had to create a force that would follow me, even if it meant lying."
Now I understand.
Why the Twilight Cult members believed so firmly that Uncle was a fraud.
And why the demon told such lies.
"You... you lied to use us? You piece of trash!"
At this point, even the bald man couldn't hold back and cursed at the demon.
But Bethpoll didn't even blink and said this:
"It's your fault for believing a demon."
How can he be so shameless? A demon is truly a demon.
"Listen, Damien Haksen's nephew. Everything that happened today has nothing to do with me. It's all what those bastards did on their own."
"Bethpoll! Are you trying to pin all the blame on us!"
"I'll kill all those bastards with my own hands, so won't you forget about this incident? I'll even give you a treasure I cherish as a bonus."
At Bethpoll's words, the bald man screamed desperately.
"Do you think we'll just quietly let you get away with this!"
"Your arrogance pierces the heavens. A mere human, at that."
Bethpoll lifted one corner of his mouth and mocked the bald man.
"You would abandon us so easily after we devoted ourselves to you?"
"Shut up. I need to survive too."
While the two were bickering, it happened.
Swoosh.
Suddenly, the air split open and Uncle appeared!
Huh? How did Uncle get here? When you enter seclusion, you should be cut off from the outside world.
Seeing Uncle's face, I felt both joy and regret at the same time.
Because Uncle's body was exactly the same as before he entered seclusion.
It meant he had failed to return to being human again this time.
"Kyaaaaak!"
Before I could dwell on my regret, Bethpoll's scream reached my ears.
"He... he appeared! He appeared! It's... it's Damien Haksen!"
At Uncle's appearance, Bethpoll screamed like a child.
Uncle looked at Bethpoll and frowned even more.
"I crossed dimensions to check something out and... it's a demon? How dare filth from hell come up to earth without fear?"
"That... that's not it! No, that's not what happened!"
"What do you mean it's not? You bastards who don't know your place still think earth is your playground..."
Uncle gritted his teeth and walked toward Bethpoll.
Then he made eye contact with me.
I waved both arms and greeted Uncle.
"Uncle!"
"...Theo?"
Uncle looked at me with a dazed expression, then slowly turned to look at the demon.
"...This fucking bastard dared to touch my nephew?"
Ah.
At this rate, Uncle is going to lose his reason.
It would be troublesome if Uncle's transformation into a beast is seen by so many people.
"Lord Damien!"
At that moment, Bethpoll slammed his head to the ground.
He hit it so hard that the ground shattered and the cave shook.
Thanks to that, Uncle regained his reason just before losing it.
"Please don't misunderstand! I didn't do anything! My followers did this on their own! I just happened to be summoned as an avatar!"
Huh? Where is this demon lying?
I quickly shouted to Uncle.
"Uncle! That demon called you a fraud!"
"D-Damien Haksen's nephew! What are you saying!"
"That's not all! He said all of Uncle's reputation was lies and that he could win, so he gathered followers!"
"Lord Damien Haksen! Let me explain! That's not..."
"And he ate human souls from his followers! He's a really bad guy!"
The demon looked at Uncle while sweating profusely.
Sure enough, Uncle was glaring at the demon with very cold eyes.
"You called me a fraud?"
"That... that's..."
"You said you were stronger than me?"
"No, that's not it."
"You ate human souls?"
"Please just listen to what I'm saying..."
"I left hell alone because I was busy with earthly affairs... and bastards like this appear and muddy the waters."
Uncle tilted his head back and let out a long sigh.
I've watched Uncle for a long time, so I know.
That's what he does when he's really pissed off.
"I was thinking of disciplining you demon bastards someday anyway... I'll have to visit soon."
"Lord Damien! Please forgive me! If you spare my life, I'll serve you like a dog for the rest of my life!"
"A dog?"
Uncle reached out to the side.
Then a sword emerged from thin air.
"I don't need bastards like you."
"Uwaaaaak!"
Bethpoll opened a dimensional portal and threw his body through it.
But Uncle's sword was faster.
Uncle swung his sword and cut down Bethpoll.
A long wound crossed Bethpoll's body.
"Ah... ahhh... ahhhhak!"
The wound became a hole that sucked in Bethpoll's body.
Bethpoll screamed as he was sucked into the hole.
Uncle made the sword disappear and dusted off his hands.
Then he glared at the bald man.
"Hiiiek!"
The bald man collapsed on the spot.
Yellow liquid even soaked his pants.
"I... we were just... just deceived! It's all because that demon lied to us..."
"And you offered human souls to a demon. Vermin who sold out their own kind must receive appropriate punishment."
Uncle snapped his fingers.
Then black wind swirled from somewhere.
"Kiiiiiak!"
"Hihihik!"
No, this wasn't black wind but evil spirits.
Uncle isn't just an excellent swordsman but also a dark mage.
Ironic, isn't it? A person who hates dark mages being a dark mage himself.
But Uncle has never used dark magic to toy with the dead.
However, he doesn't hesitate to use dark magic when giving victims' grudges release like this.
"Uwaaaak! What is this!"
"Save me! Ahhhhak!"
The evil spirits surrounded the bald man and the Twilight Cult members.
Toward the screaming cultists, Uncle said in a cold voice.
"Those are the vengeful spirits of humans killed by you. You will pay the price directly to your victims."
The evil spirits grew thicker and thicker. So thick that the cultists couldn't be seen.
"Uwaaaak!"
"Ahhhhak!"
And when the spirits disappeared, there was nothing left in that spot.
Only red bloodstains remained.
"The situation is roughly cleaned up... Theo?"
Uncle looked at me.
Uh oh, he's really angry.
"Why are you here when you just got out of house arrest? Don't tell me you snuck out again without telling Mom?"
"No! I got Mom's permission to come!"
Uncle looked at me with an expression that said he didn't believe me at all.
Wow, this is so unfair.
"Skeleton uncles! Please say something!"
"Master, that's correct. There was permission from Madam."
"We guarantee it!"
Only after the skeleton uncles stepped forward did Uncle believe what I said.
I let out a sigh of relief.
"But what were you guys doing when I assigned you to protect Theo?"
"Well, even we can't beat a marquis-level demon."
"That bastard earlier was just an avatar, not the main body. And you outnumbered him."
"That... that may be true, but still a marquis-level demon..."
"This won't do. When we return to the main house, I'll have to retrain you from the beginning."
At Uncle's words, all the skeleton uncles' faces turned pale.
How can you tell with skeletons, you ask?
Actually, I just said that because it seemed like they would.
"But Theo, how did you end up captured by these bastards?"
"Well, you see."
I explained the whole story to Uncle.
After hearing my explanation, Uncle was greatly enraged.
"...Demon worshippers dare to run wild like this? I really need to beat down those demon bastards once. I'll make sure they can never pull this kind of shit again."
Uncle, who had been ruminating on his anger, looked at the noble children.
When they received Uncle's gaze, the children flinched.
"You all went through hardships. But you endured well."
At Uncle's praise, the children's expressions brightened after being terrified the whole time.
One of them approached Uncle and asked carefully.
"D-D-Da-Damien, Damien H-H-Haksen sir."
"You don't need to be so nervous. Speak comfortably."
Did Uncle's words break the ice?
The children swarmed over and surrounded Uncle.
"You're as cool as the rumors say!"
"I never thought I'd see Lord Damien's skills in person!"
"I've always admired you!"
Kids will be kids, I suppose.
They're so happy to have their idol in front of them, they don't know what to do.
Uncle didn't find them annoying and accepted it all.
Surprising, right?
Uncle used to find kids bothersome.
They say he's changed a lot because of me.
"I wanted to play with Uncle too."
Sigh.
It's disappointing, but it can't be helped.
I'll have to yield just for today.
Anyway, I can play with Uncle when I get home!
But didn't those guys earlier fall for the Twilight Cult's lies and think Uncle was a fraud?
Thinking about it makes me a bit angry.
While I was thinking that, something grabbed my wrist.
Looking to see who it was, it's Hazel.
"What's wrong?"
Even at my question, Hazel didn't answer.
She just kept her head down and looked at my feet.
"That... that is..."
"Are you hurt somewhere?"
"That's not it..."
Hazel hesitated and finally managed to say one thing.
"Th-thank you for today. I lived thanks to you."
"You don't need to thank me. Uncle solved everything."
"Still, you were the only one who stayed calm among all of us. You even fought the cultists."
"Well, that's just..."
It's because I'm used to being kidnapped, but I didn't bother to say that.
There's no need to reveal my weakness to Hazel.
"You were really cool. Big brother Theo."
After saying that, Hazel covered her face with both hands and ran toward where the kids were.
What? Big brother Theo?
What did that wicked girl just say?
I'm not joking, goosebumps spread all over my body.
It seems Hazel has found a new way to torment me.
I shuddered while rubbing my goosebump-covered forearms.
She's truly not a girl to be taken lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 362: SS 10
chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 10: Damien Haksen's Women (1)
Hello. This is Theo.
I'd like to give you a greeting, but I'm not really in a situation for that.
Because I've been kidnapped right now.
Why was I kidnapped ‘again’? Well, that's the thing.
My life seems to be inseparably tied to kidnapping.
But this kidnapping is very different from all the previous ones.
First of all, my life isn't in danger.
My safety is guaranteed.
However, I'm violently thinking that it would be better to have my life threatened instead.
What do I mean?
"Young Master Theo, we're not asking these questions for personal reasons. All of this can be said to be God's will."
"I don't know if it's God's will, but it's definitely a question that could change the continental power structure."
"Sisters, don't pressure Theo too much. Theo, would you like some chocolate? It was made by the Empire's famous chef."
The people who kidnapped me are my future aunts...
"Theo, I'll ask again."
"You're the only one who can answer us."
"Which of the three of us do you think Damien will choose?"
My aunts asked me with faces full of expectation.
Under the overwhelming pressure, I ended up closing my eyes tightly.
* * *
There are four publicly known ‘women of Damien Haksen.’
Agnes, one of the Five Great Saints of the Church.
Athena Hopper, the Second Mercenary King of the Fafnir Mercenary Group.
Rachel Lichteawer, the Sword Empress of the Empire.
The crazy Veronica Sánchez.
The last one sounds strange? That's right, Aunt Veronica isn't a bad person, but people just misunderstand her for no reason.
Although Aunt Veronica does love killing people a bit too much, she's never actually killed anyone.
That explanation sounds weird?
It's fine. When you meet Aunt Veronica later, you'll understand what I mean.
Anyway, people call these four women ‘Damien Haksen's women’ and pay tremendous attention to them.
It's related to my uncle, and the three aunts have incredible backgrounds.
The Church, the Fafnir Mercenary King, the Empire.
The three of them hold important positions in these massive organizations.
With a little exaggeration, if just one of the three moves, the entire continent would fall into enormous chaos.
On top of that, all three of them are incredibly beautiful.
They're pretty, strong, and have terrifying backgrounds.
Of course they'd be popular.
But people don't know that there's someone troubled by these three women.
"Young Master Theo, why aren't you saying anything?"
"Just relax and tell us. There's nothing to be afraid of."
"Sisters, Theo looks burdened. Come on, speak comfortably."
This is burdensome.
So burdensome that I feel like the food I ate yesterday morning might come back up.
I'd like to meet their expectations if I could, but I haven't heard anything from my uncle about this.
Every time I ask, he avoids the topic.
He probably finds it burdensome too.
I know this, so I've never pressed him for details.
That's why I can't answer the three women's questions.
But if I say this honestly, wouldn't the three of them be disappointed?
"Um..."
"Yes, go ahead and tell us."
"So..."
The problem is I can't think of anything to say to appropriately dodge this.
I had no choice but to tell the truth.
"It seems like Uncle still hasn't made up his mind. He says returning to being human comes first."
As I expected, deep disappointment appeared on all three aunts' faces.
I'm sorry to the three of them, but I felt slightly relieved.
At least I could be freed from this burdensome situation...
"Then Theo, couldn't you persuade him for us?"
Aunt Athena asked me.
Persuade? What are you talking about?
"You could persuade Damien to choose one of us three!"
"Huh? You're joking, right?"
I asked back in surprise.
Then Aunt Athena said with a very serious face:
"No, I'm not."
Ah, no...
No matter how much Uncle likes me, interfering in marriage matters is a bit...
Even I would hate it if Uncle interfered in my love life...
He's already been persistently asking me what kind of relationship I have with Hazel lately, which has been quite annoying.
But for me to act the same way toward Uncle...
I looked at Aunt Agnes with desperate eyes.
Believing that the always rational Aunt Agnes would take my side.
"I would also like to ask you. If it's your words, Lord Damien might listen."
...My expectations were beautifully betrayed.
I was already anxious because it seemed like the two of them were running out of patience recently.
Today was the day they finally exploded!
"Sisters, if you suddenly ask such a favor, won't Theo be troubled?"
Then Aunt Rachel stopped the two of them.
I looked at Aunt Rachel with the face of someone who had met a savior.
"So we should have him guide us on exactly how to bring it up and how to persuade him."
"Oh, that's a good idea."
"As expected, Your Agnes is different."
Correction.
Aunt Rachel wasn't taking my side.
She made things even more difficult for me!
Drip.
I felt cold sweat flowing down my neckline.
How should I handle this? What should I say to get out of this situation?
If these three women were bad people trying to kill me, I could at least call for Uncle.
Ah!
I suddenly remembered that I had made plans to go out with Aunt Veronica at lunchtime!
I glanced at the clock on the wall.
Just a little longer and it would be time for our appointment.
If I don't show up even after the appointed time, Aunt Veronica won't just sit still.
In other words, if I just hold out a little longer, Aunt Veronica will find me, and I can use that opportunity to escape!
The problem is how to kill time until then.
I hastily brought up any topic.
"But what do you three like so much about Uncle?"
It was a hastily asked question, but I've actually been curious about this for a while.
Of course, there's no one as handsome, cool, strong, and dignified as Uncle.
I guarantee that no one more wonderful than Uncle exists.
But the three aunts are also incredibly beautiful and popular.
Yet the three of them have been waiting for Uncle's choice for over 10 years.
"..."
My goodness.
All three of them blushed and looked away busily.
I wondered if these were really the same confident, assertive aunts I knew.
"Ahem, Young Master Theo asks quite a difficult question."
Surprisingly, Aunt Agnes was the first to speak.
"The answer to Young Master Theo's question is... because I've never seen anyone as devout as Damien Haksen."
Huh? Uncle is devout?
I guess I wasn't the only one who found this absurd.
Aunt Athena and Aunt Rachel had the same reaction.
"Come on, no matter what, saying Damien is devout is..."
"Sister Agnes, that doesn't make sense."
"You, you two, what blasphemous words are those!"
Aunt Agnes scolded the two of them with her face turning red.
I'm sorry to Aunt Agnes, but I agree with the other two.
"God? Where does such a thing exist? I'm the reincarnation of a god."
...I've often heard Uncle say things like that.
"Do you know how many devout words Damien leaves every time he visits the Church? Our Church has even published a collection of Damien Haksen's sayings!"
Ah, I've heard about that from Uncle too.
"I need to maintain a reasonably friendly relationship with the Church. So every time I go, I say a few nice-sounding things and leave."
...That's what he said.
"In the first place, if God hadn't helped him, how could Lord Damien Haksen have overcome such adversity! Lord Damien Haksen must surely be grateful to God!"
I haven't heard this from Uncle, but somehow I think I know what he would answer.
"If it were Damien, he'd probably say it's just because he's great."
"I think the same as Sister Athena. He has a bit of an annoying side."
The two of them said what I would have said.
Aunt Agnes clenched both fists and trembled.
"Sister Agnes, then is there no other reason? You just like him because Damien is devout?"
"Then what other reason would be necessary..."
"Hmm, then Sister likes God, not Damien Haksen as a 'human.'"
Aunt Rachel made a strange expression while saying this.
"...What does that mean?"
"Nothing, no meaning at all."
"Don't lie."
"I really mean it."
Contrary to her words, Aunt Rachel was making an openly mocking expression.
Even as a third party, I could see it was a really infuriating look.
"It's just that I seem to like Damien for purer reasons. I just like Damien."
"Th-there are other reasons too!"
"Hey, you don't need to force yourself to make up reasons."
"M-make up! I would never do such a thing."
"Then let's hear it."
Aunt Rachel said triumphantly with a laugh.
She's probably thinking that whatever reason is given, she can just accuse it of being made up on the spot.
Aunt Rachel has a more cunning side unlike the other two.
"That, that is..."
Aunt Agnes couldn't easily open her mouth. The longer the silence went on, the deeper Aunt Rachel's smile became.
"It seems like there isn't one."
"The f-forearm..."
"What?"
"The f-forearm muscles are g-good."
For a moment, a question mark seemed to appear on Aunt Rachel's face.
Actually, Aunt Athena and I had the same reaction.
"Forearm muscles?"
"When he holds a sword, the prominent forearm muscles that stand out pierce right into my heart. Every time he wears thin clothes and his chest outline subtly shows through, I can't stand it."
What can't you stand?
"The collarbone line that continues from the neckline is also excellent. Especially when he sweats, the sweat drops that form on his collarbone..."
The longer she spoke, the more rigid our three faces became.
Because of her white hair and skin, Aunt Agnes still looks like a young girl just from her appearance.
Maybe that's why it's even more shocking...
"...I like Damien for the same reasons."
After pouring out her storm of words, Aunt Agnes looked at the three of us.
"...Why are you all making such faces?"
"Um... well... it's nothing."
"What do you mean nothing!"
"No, it's nothing. Anyway, I understand well that Sister Agnes's feelings are genuine."
"What do you mean you understand well!"
Aunt Rachel slightly turned her head away.
Aunt Agnes looked at me and Aunt Athena with desperate eyes.
Of course, we two also avoided eye contact.
Seeing our reactions, Aunt Agnes shouted with a face that looked like she was about to cry:
"If you were going to react like this, you shouldn't have asked in the first place!"

chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 11: Damien Haksen's Women (2)
"Agnes, you're surprisingly boy-crazy, aren't you? That's not what I expected from how you look."
Aunt Athena said that with a surprised tone.
It didn't seem like she meant any harm, but from Aunt Agnes's perspective, it must have hit a nerve.
"Boy... crazy...?"
She looked completely shocked and collapsed like chocolate melting in the heat.
"W-well, then why don't you give up on Damien!"
Aunt Agnes shot Aunt Athena a glare and asked.
Aunt Athena crossed her arms and spat out a short reply.
"He's hot."
Hmm.
Was it because the reason was too simple?
Me and the other two aunts made faces like we couldn't believe it.
"Athena, that's way too..."
"Isn't that a superficial reason?"
"What's wrong with liking someone because they're hot?"
Even with the criticism from the two aunts, Aunt Athena didn't care at all.
"The first condition for attraction between men and women is appearance. You like them because they're beautiful. You like them because they're your type. What's weird about that?"
Maybe because Aunt Athena was so confident, the other two aunts couldn't come up with a rebuttal.
"So, if someone hotter than Damien shows up, you'll switch your affections right away, sis?"
That's when Aunt Rachel asked with a meaningful expression.
Her eyes were like a predator that had caught its prey's weakness.
"What are you talking about? Where's there someone hotter than Damien?"
At Aunt Athena's words, the three of us looked dumbfounded.
Oh, I'm not saying Uncle is ugly. He's really handsome.
But the world is a big place, right? You can't be sure there's no one hotter than Uncle.
Just in the empire alone, there's this male actor who's super popular right now. He's so hot that they say a whole cartload of women died from lovesickness over him.
In other words, it's hard to claim Uncle is the hottest guy in the world.
"You guys just haven't seen Damien's truly awesome side."
Aunt Athena said, staring into space.
"A long time ago, I fell into a Dark mage's conspiracy and was about to be crippled and kicked out of the mercenary group. Everyone was tricked by the dark mage and no one took my side."
As she continued, Aunt Athena's expression turned dreamy and hazy.
"But Damien was different. He uncovered the dark mage's plot all by himself and came to rescue me. Thanks to him, I wasn't crippled, wasn't kicked out of the group, and I kept my honor."
Aunt Athena's eyes returned to normal. She looked at us and said,
"You should have seen Damien back then. I've never seen a man that cool. And I probably never will again."
At Aunt Athena's confession, the two aunts naturally became solemn.
"Athena, you..."
"You're surprisingly pure-hearted, huh?"
"What are you suddenly saying?"
In response to Aunt Athena's question, the two aunts scratched their cheeks or averted their eyes as they spoke.
"You said you like Damien because he's hot... but actually, you fell in love because he helped you in a crisis."
"Our Athena sis has a girly side despite her scary image as the second Mercenary King? I'm seeing you in a new light."
As the two sent her warm looks, Aunt Athena's face gradually turned red.
"W-what are you two talking about! I-I told you! I like Damien because he's hot!"
"Yes, we'll go with that."
"What do you mean, like you're just humoring me!"
Aunt Athena glared at the two aunts as if she was about to pounce.
"W-well, what about you? Why do you like Damien!"
Finally unable to hold out, Aunt Athena latched onto Aunt Rachel.
Fair enough, since the other two shared, Aunt Rachel should too.
"Me? Do I really need to say it?"
But Aunt Rachel responded coyly.
Then the two aunts lit up with fire in their eyes and pounced.
"What do you mean? You're going to hear our reasons and skip yours?"
"You think I'd allow that?"
Whoa, now Aunt Agnes and Aunt Athena are on the same side.
"But my story won't be interesting."
"Interesting or not isn't the point!"
"Yeah! Spill it! Don't make us the only embarrassed ones!"
The mood wasn't going to let her off easy. Sensing that, Aunt Rachel looked troubled.
That's when Aunt Rachel's gaze turned to me.
A strange smile appeared on her lips.
Uh oh, this feels ominous.
"But is this really the time for this talk? We gathered to ask Theo to convince Damien for us."
Ah, I didn't expect her to drag me into it.
But there's no way the other two would fall for such an obvious diversion...
"You're right! We don't know when Damien might come looking for Theo, so we can't just sit around leisurely!"
"We forgot the most important thing! This isn't the time!"
The two aunts' gazes turned to me.
W-what do I do? I haven't thought of a way out of this crisis yet.
"Young Master Theo, you remember our request, right?"
"Can you convince Damien to choose one of us?"
"Theo, you're the only one we can trust."
The three aunts inched closer to me.
The terrifying pressure made cold sweat pour down like rain.
But as the old saying goes, even if the sky falls, there's a hole to rise from.
Suddenly, with a loud crash, the door and wall shattered completely, didn't they?
The four of us looked toward the wall in surprise. There was Uncle.
Uncle wasn't alone. He was facing off against a red-haired woman.
"Damien Haksen! Today, I'll cut you down for sure!"
The red-haired woman crossed her twin swords and shouted.
Oh, don't misunderstand, everyone.
She's not an assassin or killer here to murder Uncle.
It's Aunt Veronica, actually.
"You have no idea how brutal the training I've done just for today!"
As you can see, Aunt Veronica's goal is to cut Uncle down.
She says she'd give up everything if she could just do that.
That's why she likes killing people but hasn't killed many so far.
Uncle threatened that if Aunt Veronica killed anyone else, he wouldn't face her anymore.
"Hey, you broke the wall."
"The dwarves will fix it right away anyway!"
Uncle said with a displeased face, but Aunt Veronica didn't care at all.
"Then here I come again!"
Aunt Veronica swung her twin swords at Uncle.
Incredibly fast attacks rained down.
Uncle deflected all of Aunt Veronica's attacks.
And without even looking, with his bare hands.
"Huh? What are you all doing here?"
Uncle asked us while swatting away Aunt Veronica's attacks with the side of his hand.
"Focus on me, not them!"
"Why would I focus on someone like you? Anyway, I told you to give up already."
"I said I won't give up!"
Aunt Veronica yelled even louder and swung her twin swords.
Earlier, I could at least see afterimages, but now even those are gone.
Of course, Uncle was still deflecting without looking.
"Theo, don't be such a baby. All three are busy people. Don't bother them."
W-what?
W-who's bothering whom! I'm the one whose rest time is being interrupted!
"Damien, don't worry about it. We're fine."
"Yeah. Why would we find Theo annoying?"
"Theo's like a cute little brother to us too."
I looked at the aunts with a dumbfounded expression.
The aunts avoided my gaze and pretended not to notice.
"Grr... I'm done! I'm not doing this!"
Finally, Aunt Veronica, who tired out first, threw down her twin swords.
As expected, today Aunt Veronica gave up first again.
"Good enough? I'm out of here."
"Ah, wait!"
"You wanna go again? I'm not in the mood anymore."
"Mother said she has business in the city and wants us to go with her."
"Us?"
"Yeah, me, you, and Mother."
"If it's Mother's request, I can't refuse."
Uncle nodded readily but then made a displeased face.
"But how long are you gonna keep calling my mom 'Mother'?"
"That's my choice. Hurry up. She's leaving soon."
Uncle grumbled as he followed Aunt Veronica.
Once the two left, the aunts looked at each other with subtle expressions.
"...You all saw that, right?"
"...I can't believe Veronica's already won over Mother."
"...This isn't the time for us to be checking each other."
The three aunts looked at each other with determined eyes.
Hmm, it seems like the three have suddenly gotten closer.
I should escape in this gap. I don't want to keep getting dragged around by these three...
"Young Master Theo?"
"Theo?"
"Theo?"
...But there's no way I could slip past their senses.
I got caught the moment I took a step.
"Damien and Veronica seem unusually close."
"It'll be hard for us to catch up alone."
"So you'll keep helping us, right?"
The three smiled brightly as they asked.
I could only swallow dryly and nod.
"O-of course I'll help."
* * *
It was that night.
Maybe because I'd been tormented by the aunts for so long, I ended up having a nightmare.
In the nightmare, I was standing in a field.
But it looked very different from any field I knew.
Corpses were strewn everywhere I looked, and blood flowed like rivers.
Even though it was a dream, it was scary.
I got chills.
I hugged my shoulders and called for Uncle.
"Uncle... where are you? Uncle Damien."
Then, something tapped my shoulder.
I turned my head in shock.
There was a black ghost.
I don't know who it was.
It was made of black smoke, so I couldn't see its face.
The ghost wriggled and pointed somewhere.
I unconsciously looked that way.
And I almost screamed.
Corpses were piled up into a mountain.
I couldn't even guess how many people had died.
But what scared me even more was something else.
Someone was standing at the top of the corpse mountain.
Gray skin, pitch-black armor.
An inhumanly huge build.
I'd definitely seen it somewhere before.
But I couldn't remember. Where had I seen it...
-Watch closely.
The black ghost spoke to me. But I couldn't respond.
I couldn't take my eyes off the black knight.
-That's #$!@#$.
The last word was hard to hear.
-The one you love so much, %$!@!#$.
As if knowing I wouldn't understand, the ghost repeated the same words.
I was about to ask what it was saying when.
-...
The black knight glared at me.
The moment its red eyes turned toward me, chills ran through me like I'd been plunged into ice water.
"Ah, aaaah!"
I screamed and bolted up from bed.
Waking from the nightmare, I gasped for breath.
"W-what dream did I just have?"
Weird. Now that I was awake, I couldn't remember what the dream was about at all.
But the emotions lingered. It was so scary and terrifying.
I quietly got out of bed.
I hugged my pillow tightly and went outside the castle.
Whenever I have a nightmare, I go to Uncle.
Sleeping next to Uncle strangely makes me feel safe.
I passed through the forest and arrived at Uncle's tower.
I went down to the basement and called him.
"Uncle~"
"Huh? Theo, is that you?"
Uncle wasn't sleeping. In fact, he was getting ready to go out.
"Oh, are you heading out?"
"Yeah, I have a quick errand. What's up with you? Did you have another nightmare?"
I just nodded.
Uncle took out a blanket from the corner and spread it on the floor.
"Come here."
"But don't you need to go?"
"I'll go after watching you sleep."
Hehe, this is why I like Uncle.
I quickly lay down on the blanket.
Uncle sat beside me and patted my back.
As expected, being next to Uncle makes me feel secure.
Sleepiness hit me right away as I lay down.
I didn't resist.
In my gradually fading consciousness, I saw something strange.
In the corner of the basement, darkness was staring at me.
Before I could ask Uncle what it was, I fell asleep.

Side Story Chapter 12: Enrollment Briefing (1)
Hello. It's Theo.
This might sound out of nowhere, but lately, I've been deeply contemplating life.
What is life? How should we live? Can I change my life through my own will?
You might ask, what's with this weird talk all of a sudden? Am I going through puberty or something?
No way. The reason I'm pondering like this is none other than...
"Of course Theo should come to the Empire! Why don't you know that the Empire's Academy is the best on the continent!"
"You can't send a faithful child like Theo to such a worldly place. Theo must enter our Church's Theological Seminary."
"I can't stand watching you two old fogeys. Nothing's more important than diverse experiences. Our Fafnir Mercenary Group's Training Camp is the perfect fit for Theo."
The Emperor of the Empire, the former member of the Church's Five Great Elders, the former Mercenary King of the Fafnir Mercenary Group.
Seeing these famous people arguing with each other gives me a headache.
How did it come to this? I was just looking for a school to enroll in.
***
The incident started with a single comment from Mom.
"Theo is old enough to enroll in school now."
It was during breakfast with the whole family gathered, and Mom suddenly said that.
Everyone stopped eating and looked at Mom.
It must have been a completely unexpected remark.
"Hmm, that's right. There are schools. I've forgotten about that until now."
"Our family was small until recently, so we didn't think about sending the kids to school."
Grandpa and Grandma nodded repeatedly as they spoke.
Normally, enrolling in a noble school costs a lot of money.
The admission fee is expensive, and the tuition is no joke either.
So, unless you're from a decent noble family, it's something you can't even dream of.
"Louise, have you decided which school to send him to?"
"I'm still thinking about it. Whether to send him domestically or abroad. If abroad, where to send him. Each has its own pros and cons."
There are educational institutions called schools in the Apple Kingdom too, but there are many in other countries as well.
Of course, their fame varies.
From what I know, the Empire's Academy is the most famous.
After that, the Church's Theological Seminary and the Fafnir Mercenary Group's Training Camp are well-known.
"Sis, that sounds like a good idea. Theo might inherit the dukedom later, so it's good for him to study in advance."
"I've heard you can build various connections there. It'll be a big help when Theo becomes an adult."
Younger Uncle and Aunt readily agreed.
Everyone seems to welcome the idea of me enrolling in school.
But I don't want to go to school. I hate studying so much...
Sitting at a desk for a long time is hard, and memorizing stuff is annoying.
I sneakily tugged at Uncle Damien's sleeve, who was sitting next to me.
Uncle was about to put a piece of cut meat in his mouth but stopped and asked me.
"Theo, what's wrong?"
"Can't you stop them for me?"
"If that's what you want, I can do that."
"Really?"
Uncle is the best, after all.
"But I'd like it if you went to school."
"Why?"
"Life is unpredictable. You might suddenly face a horrific event."
Uncle's tone was very serious.
So serious that it was hard to talk to him.
"That's why people need to prepare. Learn anything, hone your skills. That way, you can overcome whatever comes."
Somehow, Uncle's eyes looked very sad.
I can't be stubborn when Uncle says it like this.
"...I'll go to school."
I decided to quietly give up my stubbornness.
Only then did Uncle smile contentedly and pat my head.
"Good thinking."
It's sad that I have to enroll in school, but seeing Uncle happy makes me feel good too.
Anyway, I wonder which school I'll end up in. Imagining it makes me a bit excited.
But neither I nor my family knew.
What kind of waves it would cause on the continent that Damien Haksen's nephew is enrolling in an academy.
***
The first to obtain the information was the Empire.
"Your Majesty, it's reported that Damien Haksen's nephew is considering enrolling in an educational institution!"
"What? Is that true? Theo is trying to enroll in school?"
The Emperor of the Empire.
Howard Adelardt jumped up from his seat in surprise.
"Then, of course, he should come to our Empire, right? Where else is as excellent as the Empire's Academy!"
The Empire's Academy was renowned as the continent's top educational institution.
With a long history, excellent faculty, and above all, the chance to build deep connections with the Empire's nobles.
That's why nobles from other countries overflowed with desire to enroll in the Academy.
Of course, it wasn't easy for nobles from other countries to enroll in the Academy.
Even if they were royalty.
But if it's Damien Haksen's nephew, the story changes.
The hero of the continent! The existing transcendent being!
If Theo enrolls in the Academy, the relationship with Damien Haksen would become even stronger.
It was an opportunity the Empire couldn't miss.
However, the Emperor wasn't trying to accept Theo for such grand national reasons.
"To have Theo in the Academy... This way, I can meet Damien more often!"
Because the Emperor of the Empire was an ardent supporter of Damien Haksen.
He not only blindly supported every single one of Damien Haksen's actions but also made collecting items related to him a hobby.
There was even a time when he visited Damien Haksen too frequently and got refused meetings.
"This won't do! I need to go to the Haksen Ducal House right away! I can't go empty-handed, so prepare gifts!"
"How shall we compose the delegation? I think sending the Sword Saint would be..."
"What are you talking about!"
The official was startled by the Emperor's roar.
The Emperor said to the official with a displeased face.
"Of course, I have to go myself!"
The Emperor's face, shouting like that, showed unconcealed anticipation.
***
The Church's headquarters.
Two elderly people were sitting in a simple room.
"It's said that Theo is looking into institutions for education."
The old woman with a hunched back spoke.
She looked shabby at a glance, but her clothes were not.
She was wearing white robes that only the Holy Empress could wear.
"Heh heh, Theo is already that age... Children really grow up in the blink of an eye."
The old man smiled contentedly at the Holy Empress's words.
The old man's identity was no small matter.
He was the former member of the Church's Five Great Elders and currently known as the Holy Empress's proxy, Cheongyeum.
"I remember when I first met Theo. He was such a cute and smart kid. He'll adapt well no matter which school he enrolls in."
"Since he's Damien's nephew, he'll handle it well. However, there's a problem."
"A problem?"
Cheongyeum couldn't understand at all.
Who is Theo? None other than Damien Haksen's nephew.
For a problem to arise for such a Theo?
"It's said that the Empire has sent a delegation to enroll Theo in the Academy."
"Is that true?"
"It's certain. And the Emperor himself has stepped forward."
Cheongyeum's eyes widened.
As if he couldn't hold back, he clenched his fist tightly.
"Howard Adelardt... Not missing an opportunity, truly like an old tiger."
Damien Haksen currently held an enormous position on the continent.
His single word, a single action could shake the continent.
If they could embrace Damien Haksen's nephew, they could maintain an even closer relationship with Damien.
If the already powerful Empire gets Damien Haksen on its back as well?
No one would be able to stop the Empire's might, for sure.
However, Cheongyeum wasn't averse to the Emperor's approach for such reasons.
"Agnes is already struggling because that young brat, the Sword Empress, is wagging her tail at Damien Haksen. I can't just watch this!"
Agnes, who currently occupies one of the Five Great Elders, was Cheongyeum's disciple.
That's why Cheongyeum was keenly aware of the conflict between Agnes, the 2nd Mercenary King, and the Sword Empress.
"I can't bear to see Agnes crying!"
"I feel the same."
The Holy Empress was the same.
The two were close, but since they were devoted to the god, they couldn't form a marital bond.
Thus, the two secretly regarded Agnes as their own child.
In this world, what parent would just stand by and watch their child cry?
"Your Holiness, send me. I'll go and persuade Theo!"
"Indeed, you must get Theo to enroll in our Theological Seminary."
The Empire's Academy was the most famous educational institution on the continent.
But the Church's Theological Seminary was not lacking at all.
It was just avoided by nobles because it's a religious school, but in history and quality, it matched the Academy.
"This is an order as the Holy Empress. Make sure to enroll Theo in the Theological Seminary."
"I accept the command."
Cheongyeum knelt and replied.
***
Fafnir Mercenary Corps.
This place, called the continent's top, strongest, largest mercenary corps, was also buzzing with talk about Theo.
"What? The Empire and the Holy Theocracy are moving to enroll Damien Haksen's nephew?"
In a large tent where dozens of people were seated, a young boy shouted as if he couldn't believe it.
Contrary to his youthful appearance, the boy was sitting in the highest seat.
Around him were plenty of scantily clad women.
The 1st Mercenary King of the Fafnir Mercenary Corps.
Karl Hopper pounded the armrest with his fist and vented his frustration.
"Ha, unbelievable. They're trying to get close to Damien that way?"
"Father, are you just going to watch this?"
The man sitting right next to him asked the Mercenary King. The Mercenary King threw his goblet and shouted.
"Are you crazy! Why would I just watch! We have to join in too!"
"But Father, is it okay for us to interfere?"
"What do you mean? We have a training camp too! Is our training camp just any training camp? We gathered all the smart bastards and set it up!"
The Fafnir Training Camp was called a training camp, but it didn't fall behind compared to average noble schools.
Because they traveled across the continent and recruited scholars with outstanding knowledge as instructors.
Moreover, the combat training was at a level they prided as the best on the continent.
"Compared to the Academy and the Theological Seminary, our mercenary corps' training camp is a bit..."
But no matter how excellent the training camp was, it was true that it paled in comparison to the Academy and the Theological Seminary.
"You idiot."
However, the Mercenary King didn't back down at all.
Instead, he shouted with a voice full of confidence.
"Why is our training camp lacking? Rather, it has a special advantage that the other two places don't have!"
"Huh? What is it?"
"Experience."
At first, the mercenaries gathered in the tent didn't understand what he was saying at all.
"Our Fafnir Mercenary Group travels all over the continent. We see a lot, hear a lot, and experience a lot."
Oh?
Thinking it made quite a bit of sense, the mercenaries nodded.
"Is that all? Where else can you get experiences like wielding weapons yourself, fighting, almost dying? The Academy? The Theological Seminary? You absolutely can't get that in places full of those softies!"
Hmm?
Is that really an advantage?
The mercenaries felt deep doubt but didn't particularly refute it.
They knew well that splashing cold water when the Mercenary King was excited would make things troublesome.
"Then, who should we send to the Haksen Ducal House? Athena is on a mission right now."
Currently, the 2nd Mercenary King was Athena Hopper, but the full authority was held by the Mercenary King.
To be precise, they were in the process of gradually transferring the Mercenary King's powers to Athena.
"I hear the Emperor and Cheongyeum are going themselves?"
"Yes, that's right."
"Then, we need to send someone of matching rank."
Everyone made expressions like 'no way.' And their worries hit the mark exactly.
The Mercenary King grinned and said.
"This body will go personally."

Side Story Chapter 13: Enrollment Briefing (2)
Two days had passed since the decision was made to enroll me in school.
Suddenly, Grandpa called the whole family together.
The cause was three letters that arrived in the morning.
"Everyone, read them."
At Grandpa's words, the family decided to pass the letters around one by one.
Oh, not everyone was gathered.
Uncle Damien was out, so he wasn't there.
When we all finished reading the letters, everyone couldn't help but be flustered.
And for good reason, because the letters were from the Empire, the Church, and the Fafnir Mercenary Group respectively.
I don't need to explain what these three places are.
They were forces so powerful that people say they divide the continent into three parts.
"So, the Empire, the Church, and the Fafnir Mercenary Group are planning to visit to enroll Theo in their educational institutions?"
Mom said it like she could hardly believe it. The other family members felt the same.
"And even the Emperor, the Holy Empress's proxy, and the former Mercenary King are coming personally?"
The family all groaned.
Actually, this wasn't the first time these three had visited the Haksen Ducal House. They'd come several times before.
But that doesn't mean we're used to them. How could we be? They're big shots with enormous influence on the continent.
Even one visiting makes us tense and requires a lot of preparation, but this time all three are coming.
It's natural that the family is getting headaches.
"But is this for real?"
Grandma tilted her head as she spoke.
"All three are incredibly busy people. And they're coming to the family in person to persuade Theo?"
"I agree with Mother. There must be some mistake in the letters."
Little Uncle also agreed with Grandma's opinion.
Not just Little Uncle. The other family members all nodded too.
It makes sense, right?
Even though I'm Uncle Damien's nephew, it doesn't make sense for those three to come just for me.
"Still, just in case, let's prepare in advance."
"Yes."
Grandpa ended the meeting.
Thinking about it now, it was a really excellent decision.
"Sir Haksen, sorry if the sudden visit surprised you."
"May God's grace be with you. It's truly a fine day."
"Whoa, it's been a while since I've been here. How have you been?"
A week later, the three really did visit in person.
* * *
Grandpa was shocked out of his wits, but fortunately, he quickly regained his composure.
"I'll escort all three of you this way."
Grandpa calmly guided the three to the reception room.
Luckily, we'd cleaned the reception room spotless in preparation for their possible arrival.
With the three sitting in the same space, a strange atmosphere flowed.
All three were looking at each other with wary eyes.
"I didn't expect someone who serves God to personally step into such worldly matters."
The one who started the attack first was His Majesty the Emperor.
His Majesty smirked crookedly and mocked Grandpa Cheongyeum.
"Even if you're not active anymore, I wonder if it's okay for a Elder of the church to do this. But since you always act arbitrarily claiming it's God's will whenever you get a chance, it's nothing new."
"I didn't know Your Majesty was so well-versed in the church's affairs."
Grandpa Cheongyeum spoke with a smile.
But I could see it.
The bulging vein on his temple.
"But Your Majesty, managing the Empire's big and small affairs must be tough, so is it okay to be away for so long? If the Empire's people knew, they'd scoff."
This time, a vein popped on His Majesty's forehead.
The two glared at each other while smiling. Whoa, it's really scary.
Huh, but why is Grandpa Mercenary King so quiet?
"You're still as beautiful as ever."
"Oh my, thank you even if it's just flattery."
"Flattery? When I compliment a woman, I only mean it sincerely."
"How can you say this old lady is pretty?"
"I've never seen a grandma with such smooth skin in my life."
Grandpa Mercenary King was fondling Grandma's hand and flirting.
I looked at Grandpa Mercenary King with a dumbfounded expression.
Grandpa Mercenary King looks about my age on the outside.
So, visually, it looks like a kid my age hitting on Grandma.
I knew he was a ladies' man... but even after getting scolded by Uncle last time, he's at it again.
"...Mercenary King, this is very troublesome."
As expected, Grandpa intervened between the two with a face barely suppressing his anger.
"Are you jealous or something?"
"Does it look like I'm not?"
"Calm down. Relax."
Grandma said as she hugged Grandpa tightly.
Grandpa Mercenary King smacked his lips regretfully.
"There's no room to cut in here."
...Was he serious?
This won't do. I need to tell Uncle. If Uncle scolds him, he'll snap out of it.
"Ahem."
At that moment, His Majesty cleared his throat loudly, drawing everyone's attention.
"Shall we get to the main point?"
When His Majesty gestured, one of the officials pulled out a large scroll from his bosom.
"These are the benefits the Empire will provide if Theo enrolls in the Academy."
The family focused on the scroll with surprised faces.
"First, we'll fully waive the admission fee and tuition. We won't charge for any additional costs afterward either. Not only that, we'll open special lectures just for Theo..."
As His Majesty's explanation continued, the family looked at the scroll with pleased expressions.
Especially Mother seemed satisfied. It must have really appealed to her.
"That's all."
When His Majesty's words ended, the official neatly folded the scroll and handed it to Mother.
"I can confidently say there's no place more suitable for Theo than the Empire's Academy."
His Majesty spoke with a voice full of pride.
At that moment, Grandpa Cheongyeum spoke in a solemn tone.
"Madam, you must not be swayed by such materialistic benefits."
"Materialistic? Don't speak carelessly. Then what can the Church provide for Theo?"
His Majesty spoke with a slightly angry face.
But Grandpa Cheongyeum isn't one to be intimidated by that. He spoke with a relaxed expression.
"First, we'll add all the benefits the Empire mentioned."
"What? You just called them materialistic and now you're shamelessly saying that!"
"Tsk tsk, you should listen to people until the end. What I meant is that being materialistic isn't the problem, but being 'only' materialistic is."
His Majesty sent a look of disbelief.
Actually, I feel similar to His Majesty. Isn't that a bit too cheap?
"Madam, material benefits can be offered anywhere. That's why we plan to provide something only the church can offer."
"Something only the church can provide?"
Mom asked with a curious face. Then Grandpa Cheongyeum nodded and said.
"That is... having a one-hour meeting with Her Holiness every day."
Mom and I both tilted our heads.
Because we couldn't understand why that was good.
"As you must feel, Madam, children grow very quickly. Both physically and mentally. Especially at this age, it's a crucial time when their worldview expands."
Then Grandpa Cheongyeum quickly started explaining.
"At this time, the biggest influence is who they meet and what stories they hear. These two things determine the child's character and level of refinement."
Before I knew it, Mom had started fully focusing on Grandpa Cheongyeum's story.
"Her Holiness has strived, agonized, and trained for a long time to become the spiritual pillar of the believers. I guarantee that facing Her Holiness will greatly mature Theo's inner self."
Will that really convince her?
No matter how you package it, it's just a meeting...
"That's really wonderful!"
It worked?
Mom looked very satisfied.
"I've been worried about Theo growing up twisted."
"Heh heh, that's an unnecessary worry."
"Since his uncle is Damien..."
"What's the problem with that?"
"I'm afraid he'll go berserk without holding back if something displeases him..."
"Hmm, that's worth worrying about."
They're having a really rude conversation so casually.
What's wrong with Uncle!
My life goal is to live like Uncle!
"Then, I have no doubt that Madam will choose our Theological Seminary..."
"That's ridiculous."
At that moment, Grandpa Mercenary King snorted and shouted.
"You're both wrong. Tuition waiver, character building... Hanging such trivial conditions."
The two got fired up at Grandpa Mercenary King's words.
"Trivial? Then what condition did you bring?"
"I'm curious how great a thing you can give Theo."
Grandpa Mercenary King shook his index finger left and right as if it was laughable.
With that childlike face doing that, it's really infuriating.
If it's this bad for me, how much worse for His Majesty and Grandpa Cheongyeum?
"Listen, Louise. There's only one thing I can give Theo."
For a moment, Grandpa Mercenary King's expression turned serious.
"Real combat."
The reception room fell silent for a bit.
Everyone looked at Grandpa Mercenary King with faces like, what is he talking about?
"Our Fafnir Mercenary Group's motto is just one: Real combat is the best training! Training without experience is utterly useless!"
Mom made a conflicted expression.
Is he joking right now? She seems to be seriously pondering it.
"I'm not talking about fake combat under adults' protection! I mean real combat accompanied by death! Entrust Theo to me! I'll raise him into a warrior among warriors!"
"Yes, Mercenary King, I think you can leave early."
"W-what? What do you mean all of a sudden."
Grandpa Mercenary King shouted in surprise, but Mother was firm.
"Real combat? Death? I can't entrust Theo to such a horrific place."
"What? Think again. If he survives, Theo will become a powerhouse no one can ignore!"
"I don't need it. Please leave."
Mother's face and voice lowered.
It was so chilly that even Grandpa Mercenary King backed away.
"...W-wait! Ultimately, what's important is Theo's opinion, right?"
But Grandpa Mercenary King was no pushover.
Seeing it was hard to persuade Mom, he immediately latched onto me.
"Theo! Don't you want to become strong like your uncle? Come to our Fafnir Training Camp!"
"This guy's talking crazy! Theo, it's the Empire! Come to the Academy!"
"Theo, trust me. The Theological Seminary is the place for you."
When Grandpa Mercenary King clung to me, the other two approached me too.
Under the three's auras, I couldn't say anything.
Ugh, aaah. What do I do? Which one should I choose?
It was when I was hesitating, unable to answer.
With a clunk, the reception room door opened.
Uncle came in and made a surprised expression.
"Your Majesty? Elder Cheongyeum? Why are you here? What, the Mercenary King is here too."
At Uncle's appearance, the three quickly detached from me and clung to Uncle.
"Damien! It's been a while. How have you been? I told you to stop by the palace whenever you're in the Empire. Why no contact? This makes me sad. I even prepared a grand banquet for you!"
"Ah, yes... I've been a bit busy."
"Damien! I was sad not seeing your face. Good thing we meet like this. Today, I request a spar! It's okay if a limb gets torn off, so go all out!"
"Uh... I'll think about it."
"Hey, why don't you use honorifics only for me? Why ignore only me!"
"Do you have no conscience? If you want to be treated like an elder, act like one."
Uncle roughly dealt with the three and came to me.
"Uncle! Did your errand go well?"
"Yeah, it wrapped up fine. But what's all this?"
I explained the whole story to Uncle. After hearing me, Uncle said casually.
"I think the Academy would be good."
"Why?"
"I go on business trips to the Empire a lot. The dark mages, those sons of bitches, are mainly active in the Empire."
"Really? Then I'll go to the Academy!"
I said it without a moment's hesitation.
Tuition waiver? Meetings with the Holy Empress?
What's the use of all that. If I go to the Empire, I can see Uncle often!
"Mom! I want to go to the Academy!"
"If that's what you want, sure. With Damien there, I can rest easy too."
Mom readily agreed.
Then the three made sour expressions.
Even His Majesty.
"I prepared all this for nothing. I didn't expect the decision to be made so easily."
"Your Majesty, what can we do. For Theo, Damien is the best."
"Damn, at this point, I have to persuade Damien. That guy would understand the importance of real combat."
The three trembled with frustration.
* * *
Even though Theo's destination was decided, the three didn't leave right away.
Using travel fatigue as an excuse, they decided to stay at the ducal house.
Because of that, a grand banquet was held that evening.
It was an event prepared by Duke Haksen solely for these three.
And after the banquet ended, at the training ground where the sunset was setting.
"Urgh, cough, cough."
Cheongyeum was sprawled on the ground, vomiting up everything he'd eaten for dinner.
"Are you alright?"
Damien asked worriedly.
Cheongyeum waved his hand as if to say he was fine.
"I'm totally fine. Rather, I'm grateful. You sparred with full sincerity as I requested, didn't you?"
The spar with former Five Great Elder Cheongyeum ended in Damien's one-sided victory.
Even though they fought with Cheongyeum's specialty, bare-handed combat.
An insurmountable gap already existed between the two.
"I feel it every time, but you get explosively stronger. If you're the moon floating in the sky, I'm no different from a grain of sand on the ground."
"You're being overly complimentary today."
"As you age, you tend to become more sentimental."
Cheongyeum grinned and stood up.
"By the way, you still haven't returned to being human?"
At Cheongyeum's question, Damien hesitated for a moment.
Soon, he slowly nodded.
"You know better than anyone, but you already have more than enough ability to return to human. You've reached the realm called transcendent."
Ten years ago, Damien reached a divine realm.
And now, Damien was much stronger than then. To the point where he himself couldn't gauge how strong he was.
"Yet the reason you keep failing is... only one. You're blocking yourself."
There's a term called heart demon.
Just as the body can fall ill, so can the mind.
A person afflicted with a heart demon becomes greatly weakened, unable to grow and stagnating.
That's exactly Damien's current situation.
"Damien, what is binding you so much?"
Cheongyeum asked with a worried face.
Damien just smiled gloomily.

Side Story Chapter 14: Enrollment Preparation (1)
It was a particularly sunny day.
Louise Haksen was spending a pleasant time with two noblewomen.
"Louise, the new volume of 'Madame de Pompadour's Secret Shadow' is coming out!"
"Is that so? I must contact the capital."
"Louise, have you heard about the dispute between the Alpen Viscountcy and the Griffon Barony? I heard the Viscount's eldest son and the Baron's youngest daughter..."
"Oh, my, my, my!"
Publicly, these two women were vassals belonging to the Haksen Ducal House.
In reality, however, their relationship with Louise was closer to that of friends than vassals.
They had been close ever since the Haksen family was still a Viscountcy.
"Sister, I heard Theo is enrolling in the Empire's Academy? Congratulations."
"Really? After worrying for so long about which school to send him to, you decided on the Academy. A fine choice!"
Both women rejoiced as if it were their own affair.
Louise's expression brightened as well.
"It's all thanks to Damien. Without him, I couldn't have even dreamed of it."
Not just Louise, but the entire family was well aware that the happiness they enjoyed was all thanks to Damien.
The fact that the Haksen family had obtained the rank of Duke, and that they had amassed enormous wealth and fame, were all Damien's accomplishments.
This was precisely why the family shied away from public activities.
They were careful to avoid causing any trouble for Damien.
"Then Theo must be busy preparing for his enrollment in the Academy."
"Yes, he's getting a crash course from Damien. Damien used to work as an instructor at the Academy a long time ago."
At those words, the two women were horrified.
"F-From Damien?"
"Is that... alright?"
People regarded Damien as a noble saint.
After all, he had saved the world without demanding any reward and had silently focused on eradicating dark mages.
But because they were close to Louise, the two women knew better.
They knew that in reality, Damien was far from a saint and possessed a terrifying personality.
For example, he had brought about the downfall of a Count's family overnight for treating the Haksens like nouveau riche.
Or how he had deposed the king of a neighboring country before dawn for harassing Louise.
"If Theo is negatively influenced by Damien..."
"What if he goes to the Academy and starts beating up other kids like Damien...?"
Louise spoke as if there was nothing to worry about.
"There's no need for such worries. I heard from Damien a while ago. He said Theo has no talent for physical skills."
For Damien's nephew to have no talent in physical combat.
It wasn't actually that surprising.
The Haksen family had never been a line of knights.
They couldn't even find any ancestors with talent in that area.
"That's why Damien never taught Theo anything from the start. This time too, he probably just plans to teach him about the Empire's culture and etiquette."
Louise said it casually.
***
"Theo, you have no talent."
In a dark basement.
Damien had Theo sit down and spoke in a serious tone.
"You can't use your body well. On top of that, your aptitude for accepting mana is also lacking."
"Yes, Uncle, you've told me that before."
Theo didn't look particularly hurt.
Lacking talent had never been a problem for him until now.
"That's why, for a long time, I've been creating a training method and swordsmanship just for you."
"Oh, really?"
Theo was overjoyed.
Among the continent's knights, receiving Damien's teachings was considered a great honor to be left to one's family.
But that wasn't why Theo was happy.
"I never thought you'd prepare something like that just for me, Uncle."
He was happy simply because Damien had done something for him.
"But you said I lack talent, didn't you?"
"I did. That's why I made it so that even someone without talent can crush anyone."
"Is that even possible?"
"It wasn't easy. But for your uncle, nothing is impossible."
Damien said in a voice brimming with confidence.
Theo looked at Damien with eyes full of admiration.
"I guarantee you. When this is revealed, everyone will be so shocked they'll fall flat on their backs. These techniques are several steps more advanced than the existing ones."
"But will I have enough time to learn them? I enroll in the Academy in three months."
"Who is your uncle?"
"That would be Damien Hak... ah."
Damien's face grew even more confident.
"I guarantee that in three months, you will be strong enough to look down on everyone at the Academy."
***
"But will Theo be able to adapt well? I hear the Academy's standards are incredibly high."
One of the noblewomen said worriedly.
She was the youngest of the three.
"I heard that even the Empire's nobles often fail to keep up with the classes and flunk out."
At her youngest friend's words, a shadow briefly crossed Louise's face.
"I'm worried about that too. To be honest, Theo isn't very fond of studying."
What parent doesn't know their own child?
Louise was well aware that Theo disliked studying.
Nevertheless, there was a good reason she had pushed for his admission to the Academy.
"Theo doesn't have a single friend. It seems that because he's Damien's nephew, kids his age find it hard to approach him."
Theo's social circle was extremely narrow.
Besides his family and servants, he knew almost no one.
He had recently befriended the daughter of the Lionbloom Marquis, but that only brought the count up to one.
"But at the Academy, there will be many children who can get along with Theo. It's the nobility of the Empire, after all, right?"
The Empire was the most powerful nation on the continent.
As such, the prestige held by the Empire's nobles was immense.
They were even nicknamed the "nobles above nobles."
"I truly hope Theo can make genuine friends at the Academy. Just as I met the two of you."
Louise said, looking at her two friends.
The two friends looked away, embarrassed.
***
"Theo, do you know why I'm sending you to the Academy?"
Theo shook his head from side to side.
"It is to cultivate your ability to distinguish between allies and enemies."
Theo looked at Damien with sparkling eyes.
It was one of Theo's habits to listen intently to anything Damien said.
"It must be essential to have such an ability, then?"
"Indeed. You'll understand when you're older. The world is made up of nothing but allies and enemies."
Damien's eyes glinted menacingly.
"You must learn to discern in advance who will be of help to you and which bastard will bring you harm."
"I see."
"But simply being able to distinguish them isn't enough. There are times when allies turn into enemies. So you must also develop the habit of always being watchful."
"That's scary."
"Do you know what it feels like to be betrayed by someone you know? It's utterly foul. So much so that you want to turn the whole world upside down. You shouldn't have to feel that, right?"
Theo nodded his head repeatedly.
"Let me ask you something here. If you determine someone is an enemy, what should you do?"
"Umm... I'm not sure."
Damien raised his thumb and drew it across his throat.
A gesture to kill.
"If you judge someone to be an enemy, crush them thoroughly. You mustn't leave them half-alive. If you do, you could be the one who gets hurt. I mean, beat them so badly they can't even dare to raise their head in front of you."
"If I judge someone to be an enemy... crush them thoroughly... If I leave them half-alive, I'll die... Beat them so they can't raise their head in front of me..."
Theo repeated Damien's words.
As if trying to engrave them onto his very soul.
"But what if I mistakenly judge an ally to be an enemy?"
"It's very simple. The moment you treat him as an enemy, he becomes one all the same. In fact, since the situation is unjust, there's a high probability he'll hold an even greater grudge against you. Therefore..."
Damien pointed his thumb downward.
"Kill a guy like that even more perfectly."
***
"Will the Empire's nobles just leave Theo alone?"
In the middle of their chat, one of the noblewomen spoke up.
She was the eldest of the three.
"They say the Empire's nobles have an incredible superiority complex. They even ignore and ostracize royalty from other countries."
"Ah, I've heard that too. They say the Empire's nobles treat nobles from outside the Empire like commoners."
Despite her friends' concerns, Louise's expression remained unchanged.
"He's Damien's nephew, who would dare touch him?"
"Sister, you never know. The human heart is so complicated."
"That's right. Besides, the Academy will be full of kids. You know how childish kids can be."
There was some truth to their words.
But Louise's expression remained steadfast.
"Theo will be fine. He's a child who receives so much love, after all."
As Louise said, Theo was a child who was particularly good at winning people over.
Even people who knew nothing about Theo would quickly take a liking to him.
It was probably because of his strikingly handsome appearance, even as a child.
"Besides, who would mess with a kid as sweet as Theo?"
"True, Theo does have a gentle nature."
"Even if someone tried to harm him, they'd stop quickly."
The three noblewomen nodded in agreement.
***
"The nobles of the Empire are all morons who think they're hot stuff."
Damien said in a harsh tone.
"Just because they were lucky enough to be born in the Empire, they think they're superior."
Though his words were filled with raw condemnation, Theo once again listened intently to Damien.
Before he knew it, the Empire's nobles had been branded as obnoxious trash in Theo's mind.
"They might even try to pick a fight with you."
"Even if they know I'm your nephew?"
"They could, even knowing that. Because they're brats."
Damien said without a hint of hesitation.
"If something like that happens, what should you do?"
"Call a teacher to mediate?"
Theo answered immediately.
It was a perfectly model answer, but Damien shook his head.
"A lukewarm method like that cannot solve the fundamental problem."
"The fundamental problem?"
"Why are those guys bothering you?"
"Because I'm your nephew?"
"No. It's because you look like a pushover."
Damien answered firmly.
"Humans are no different from beasts. If you look weak, you get bitten. There's only one way to prevent that beforehand."
Damien clenched his fist.
"You make it so they can't look down on you."
"Ooh, I see."
"Let's go back to the beginning. What did I say to do when someone becomes an enemy?"
"You said to crush them thoroughly."
Damien wore a satisfied expression at Theo's answer.
"You remember very well. That's right. If there's a bastard who looks down on you, classify him as an enemy and shatter him."
"But what if that brings harm to you and the family, Uncle?"
Theo said worriedly.
To be enrolled in the Academy, they must be from families of great power.
Creating friction with such families could cause great damage to his own.
"What's the problem?"
At Theo's question, Damien looked genuinely confused.
"Think about who's behind you."
"That would be you, Uncle... ah."
"Frankly, even if you killed the heir of a family, it wouldn't be a problem at all. Because I'm here."
Damien spouted this outrageous nonsense as if it were nothing.
The problem was that Theo was diligently engraving it into his mind.
"In the first place, if they started a fight with you, their family should be worried about being annihilated. Shouldn't they?"
"You're right, Uncle. Their family should be the ones to be afraid, not me."
Theo said to Damien, his face visibly more at ease.
"Alright, let's do a final check. What are you supposed to do when you get there?"
"Cultivate the insight to distinguish between allies and enemies!"
"And if you identify an enemy?"
"Crush them completely!"
"What if someone looks down on you and discriminates against you?"
"Beat them half to death so they can never disrespect me again!"
Damien spoke with a very satisfied look on his face.
"That's the spirit. Now I can send you to the Empire without worry."
