Side Story Chapter 15: Enrollment Ceremony (2)
Time flowed on, and the day I was to enroll in the Academy finally arrived.
From early in the morning, I prepared to leave the castle amidst the warm farewells of my family.
"We won't be able to see Theo for a while."
"What will we do? We'll miss you so."
Grandpa and Grandma were very sad to see me go.
They were even fiddling with my hands constantly.
"Theo, you can do it, right?"
"Don't let them intimidate you over there."
Younger Uncle and Auntie patted my shoulders and encouraged me.
"Theo..."
Mom and Dad simply hugged me tightly without a word.
It seemed that even though they had decided to send me to the Academy, it still pained their hearts to let me go.
Seeing Mom and Dad like this made my own heart feel heavy.
"It's okay, Mom, Dad. I'll be back for the holidays."
I tried my best to console them.
It seemed to have an effect, as they both smiled quietly.
Finally, Uncle Damien approached me.
He patted my head with his large hand.
"I won't say much. I know you'll do just fine."
His words were packed with meaning.
In preparation for my enrollment, I had learned many things from my uncle.
How to seize the initiative in a fight.
Vital spots to kill a person in one blow.
Submission techniques to easily break bones, and so on.
Right now, I was filled to the brim with confidence.
Confidence that I wouldn't lose a fight to anyone!
Except for Uncle, of course.
"Take Munchi with you. He'll be a great help."
A large wolf emerged from Uncle's shadow.
Munchi rubbed his head against my hand.
"Ahaha, that tickles."
I grabbed Munchi's head with both hands and ruffled his fur all over.
After thoroughly enjoying the petting, Munchi seeped back into my shadow.
"Oh, right. His Majesty said he would send someone to help you adjust to the Academy."
"Really? Then I can worry a little less."
I've traveled to foreign countries many times, but I've never lived in one.
I was quite worried, so hearing that His Majesty had made arrangements was a relief.
The time had finally come to leave for the Empire.
Before heading out the castle gate, I turned to look back at my family one last time.
"Theo, go and learn a lot."
"Take care of yourself."
"You are a member of the Haksen Ducal House. Never forget that."
Receiving everyone's worries and expectations, I was about to set off...
"Don't worry too much. I'll take good care of Theo oppa!"
...when Hazel, who had been waiting outside, came running up and said.
"Hey, hey, I told you to wait outside."
"If we leave just like that, I won't get to see Mother and Father for a long time either. At least let me say my greetings."
Surprisingly, Hazel was also enrolling in the Academy, just like me.
She said that as soon as she heard I was leaving for the Academy, she pestered Marquis Ryan Bloom until he agreed.
From what I know, a Marquis's family from another country can't just enroll in the Academy so easily.
But the Ryan Blooms aren't just any Marquisate.
The family head is a Grandmaster and a longtime loyal retainer of my uncle.
That's probably why it was decided so easily.
Wait, but what did Hazel just say?
"What? Mother? Father?"
Hazel used to call my parents Lady Louise and Lord Ballad.
Since when did she change how she addresses them?
"Hey, why are you calling my mom and dad that?"
"Mother~ Please don't worry too much."
I was so flabbergasted I had to ask, but Hazel was already clinging to my mom.
"I'll take good care of Theo oppa!"
"I'll be at ease with you there. Please look after Theo."
"You can count on me! I'm confident in my ability to provide domestic support."
Domestic support?
What on earth is this audacious girl talking about?
I felt a shiver run down my entire body.
"Theo, let's get going now."
Hazel wrapped her arms around my arm and pulled me toward the carriage.
And just like that, as if swept away by a wave, I departed for the Empire.
"..."
Sitting inside the carriage, I stared out the window with a sullen expression.
Hazel was humming to herself as she peeled an apple.
Her skill was so clumsy that chunks of flesh were stuck to the peel.
"Ah~"
Hazel speared the entire apple with a fork and held it out to me.
I looked at the lumpy apple, now two-thirds its original size, and asked.
"Why do you keep trying to get close to my family? And I told you not to call me Oppa."
It gives me the creeps every time Hazel calls me Oppa.
Besides, wasn't this the same girl who was screaming that she didn't want to call me Oppa just a short while ago?
Why the sudden change in attitude?
Just then, Hazel's face suddenly shot forward. Startled, I leaned back.
"You don't like it?"
Hazel asked, staring intently at me.
It was the first time in my life I'd seen Hazel's face this close.
Without realizing it, my gaze was fixed on her eyelashes.
It was a sudden thought, but she really has a pretty face.
Distracted for a moment, I ended up blurting out nonsense.
"It's not... that I dislike it."
"Then it's settled."
Hazel giggled and personally placed the apple in my mouth.
Feeling bewildered, I took a bite of the apple.
It was crisp and sweet.
* * *
The carriage arrived in the Empire in just one week.
How did we arrive so early when the distance between the two countries is so great, you ask?
The carriage I was riding in was no ordinary object.
It was something made by the dwarfs who work under my uncle.
Why travel by carriage when my uncle is around, you ask?
I specifically asked him for it. Warp gates are convenient, but you don't get the feeling of traveling.
"Oppa! Look over there, it's the Academy!"
Hazel shouted, sticking her head out the window. I did the same.
"Woooow..."
An exclamation of awe escaped my lips without me realizing it.
Uncle had described how big the Academy was, but I never imagined it would be on this scale.
It truly befits its reputation as the continent's greatest educational institution.
After arriving at the Academy, we were guided inside.
The interior of the Academy was far more beautiful and magnificent than the outside.
"Oppa, look at that!"
Hazel was delighted, constantly pointing here and there.
I was just as excited.
But Hazel's joy didn't last long.
"Ah, your seat is over here, right Oppa? They said my seat is over there."
We had to part ways in the auditorium where the entrance ceremony was being held.
Hazel headed to her seat with a gloomy expression.
Phew, I feel bad for Hazel, but thanks to her, I could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
She had been trying to stick to me the entire way here, and it was getting burdensome.
I sat in my designated seat and waited for the ceremony to begin.
Just then, the conversation of the students sitting right in front of me caught my ear.
"Lord Geisel, have you seen this month's issue of 'Monthly Damien Haksen'?"
"You call that a question? I acquired it from the printing house before it was even published and have read it from start to finish ten times."
The red-haired boy said, flicking his hair with his fingertips.
The two students sitting on either side of him gasped in admiration.
"I heard he captured the Grand Dark Mage that appeared in the southern part of the Empire."
"They say it was a monster that commanded an army of tens of thousands as if they were its own limbs."
"The number of enemies means nothing to Lord Damien Haksen."
I found myself concentrating on their conversation.
To be honest, Uncle never tells me what he's been up to.
Something about it being too grim for me to know.
"Just how strong is Lord Damien Haksen? Didn't he cut down even a Grandmaster with a single slash last time?"
"You mean Alchenko Frens? That filthy traitor who reached the supreme state of Grandmaster only to join hands with the dark mages."
The red-haired boy boasted as they talked.
"How could the likes of us possibly fathom Lord Damien's strength? We should simply be grateful. To be alive in the same era as such a great man."
The three of them nodded repeatedly at the red-haired boy's words.
Boundless reverence was pouring from their eyes.
The three continued to chatter about Uncle's achievements.
Since it was all new to me, I had no choice but to focus on their stories.
"Excuse me."
Eventually, I spoke to the three of them.
They stopped talking and turned to look at me.
"What's this 'Bloody Battle of the Genpri River' you were talking about? Can you tell me more about it?"
We're strangers, but since we're sitting here, we must all be freshmen, right?
So I asked without much thought. It's not too much to ask, is it?
"Among Lord Damien Haksen's undead, Sir Dominico is the strongest."
"But I heard Munchi is no slouch either. They say he's a wolf so massive his nose can touch the moon."
"And the mysterious beauty, Miya, is said to wield terrifying abilities as well."
But I was cleanly ignored.
"Um, excuse me..."
I mustered my courage and asked again, but the three didn't even glance my way.
Huh? Why is everyone ignoring me?
"Does everyone know this? I heard Lord Damien Haksen's nephew is enrolling in the Academy."
"What? Really? Lord Damien Haksen's nephew is enrolling?"
"It's certain. I secretly overheard my father speaking with His Majesty."
At the red-haired boy's words, the mouths of the other two slowly fell open.
"A conversation between the Duke and His Majesty... then it must be true?"
The red-haired boy preened.
Overhearing the conversation, I couldn't help but be surprised.
If his father is a Duke... that means this boy belongs to a Ducal family.
The Ducal families of the Empire hold immense power.
It's said that even the Emperor lends an ear to their words.
"If he's Lord Damien Haksen's nephew, he must be someone incredible, right?"
"Of course! Sharing the same blood as Lord Damien, he must be a prodigious genius. Even if he's not on Lord Damien's level."
Ooh, I never thought I'd hear people talking about me.
But the three of them had it completely wrong.
"Lord Damien is incredibly tall. So his nephew must be tall too."
"And he must be incredibly muscular, right? Lord Damien Haksen has a huge build."
"Plus, having been taught by Lord Damien Haksen, he'd have to be muscular."
"His presence must be overwhelming too. Ordinary people might pass out just by getting near him."
Hmm, it seems I need to correct this misunderstanding.
"You've got it all wrong. Damien Haksen's nephew doesn't look like that."
This time, I wasn't ignored.
All three of them turned to look at me.
But it wasn't for a friendly reason.
"Hey, country bumpkin."
The boy sitting to the left of the red-haired boy spoke.
He wore a very unpleasant expression.
"Country bumpkin?"
"I can tell by your clothes. That's not the style that's popular in the Empire. Which means you're from a foreign country."
Oh, an accurate deduction.
"Since you don't seem to know, I'll tell you in advance. In our Empire, nobles from other countries like you aren't recognized. You're considered commoners just pretending to be nobles."
"Uh... I've heard as much."
"Then this will be quick. The three of us are from prestigious families, even within the Empire. That means we're not people that someone like you can casually talk to."
Although only one was speaking, the other two seemed to agree.
Wow, Uncle warned me beforehand, but their superiority complex really is something else.
"If you understand, then shut your mouth. Don't be impertinent."
Instead of arguing, I carefully observed the faces of these three.
Why, you ask?
So I can carry out Uncle's words later.
If I had my way, I'd stomp on these three right now, but there are too many eyes here, aren't there?
Uncle told me not to think about the consequences, but how can a person really do that?
I should make a rational judgment and handle it cleanly.
-Sprouts of infinite potential have gathered in one place.
Just then, a solemn voice echoed.
The entrance ceremony had begun at some point, and a white-haired old man was standing on the stage.
-It seems the heavens too are welcoming your enrollment. To see the sky so clear today...
But it wasn't very interesting. It was incredibly boring.
I passed the time half-listening to the headmaster's speech.
-I shall now introduce the glorious new student who will grace this occasion. Theodore Haksen. Please come up to the stage.
My mind snapped to attention.
I lifted my head and looked at the headmaster.
Chillingly, the headmaster was looking directly at where I was seated.
-Theodore Haksen.
The headmaster called my name once more.
I had no choice but to walk up to the stage.
-Everyone, please give him a warm welcome. This is Theodore Haksen, nephew of the Hero of the Continent and Transcendent of the Age, Damien Haksen.
The moment the headmaster finished speaking, a thunderous applause erupted.
Amidst the wave of sound, I could see them.
The faces of the three boys, frozen in shock and astonishment.

Side Story Chapter 16: Enrollment Ceremony (3)
I don't really remember how the rest of the enrollment ceremony went.
It was my first time standing in front of so many people.
I was so nervous that my mind went completely blank.
When I came to my senses, the ceremony was over, and I was sitting in the headmaster's office.
"You must be hungry. Have some."
The headmaster said, placing refreshments and tea in front of me.
I thanked him and took a bite of a pastry.
Oh? This is really delicious.
It's sweet but not overpowering.
A very refined taste.
As expected of the Empire's desserts.
The headmaster watched me eat with a pleased expression.
"I imagine you were quite surprised to be suddenly called up to the stage."
"To be honest, yes, I was."
I hadn't been told the ceremony would proceed like that.
"I hope you'll understand. With Damien Haksen's nephew enrolling, we couldn't just let it pass quietly. The Academy has its dignity to consider, you see."
I nodded my head.
My uncle isn't just some famous person. And I'm his nephew.
"Rumors of your enrollment were already spreading here and there anyway. It was better to make a public announcement like this. It would have been more bothersome otherwise."
Now that I heard it, it made sense.
Whenever I attended banquets hosted by other families, people would show an excessive amount of interest in me.
It would be one thing if they were just curious.
But the requests they made...
-My son has a talent for swordsmanship, so please recommend him as your uncle's disciple.
-I want to become your uncle's vassal, so please pull some strings for me.
-My family is in a dispute with another, so please resolve it for us.
And so on.
Sometimes, it feels like people see my uncle as some kind of all-purpose tool.
Of course, my family refused them all.
We couldn't possibly bother my already busy uncle, could we?
"I don't know if you heard from your uncle, but I received a great deal of help from Damien Haksen."
"Really?"
My eyes lit up as I looked at the headmaster.
Stories about my uncle were always fun to hear.
"It was when your uncle came to the Academy as an instructor. At the time, I didn't particularly like Damien Haksen. There had never been a knight from another country who became an instructor at the Academy."
The headmaster fiddled with his teacup.
His eyes gazed into the distance, as if reminiscing about the past.
"I didn't know it at the time, but your uncle had entered the Academy in pursuit of a fearsome dark mage named Sla. While I was hell-bent on kicking Damien Haksen out, your uncle was tracking down and eliminating Sla."
The headmaster let out a short sigh, as if he couldn't bear the shame of that time.
"If it weren't for Damien Haksen, we would have lost many students. It's dizzying to even think about it again."
The headmaster took a handkerchief from his pocket and wiped the sweat from his brow.
"I intended to step down from my position as headmaster because of that incident. But I am still holding this position thanks to His Majesty's persuasion."
"As expected, my uncle is so cool."
"He is cool. Incredibly so. I have never met anyone as magnificent as your uncle."
At the headmaster's praise, my shoulders squared up on their own.
My uncle is the best.
"However, his one flaw was that he beat the students a little. No, he beat them quite a lot... yes, he beat them a lot... a whole lot..."
Suddenly, the light vanished from the headmaster's eyes.
He spoke to me with heartfelt sincerity.
"Please, I hope you won't do the same."
"..."
I intentionally didn't answer.
Because I made a promise with my uncle, you see.
Besides, I already have things I need to stomp on.
Three of them, no less!
"The crowd should have dispersed by now."
The headmaster said, looking out the window.
Ah, so the reason he brought me to his office right after the ceremony must have been to prevent people from flocking to me.
"There will be someone waiting outside to help you."
"I heard from my uncle. He said His Majesty sent them personally?"
"You already knew. Then, head back safely."
The headmaster added with a smile.
"Theodore Haksen, I hope you gain much from your time at the Academy."
* * *
I left the headmaster's office and arrived on the first floor.
I stepped out of the building and was looking around for the person who was supposed to help me.
"Hey!"
Someone called out to me loudly.
When I turned my head, I saw the three nobles who had ignored me at the entrance ceremony earlier.
I didn't know two of their names, but the other one... his name was Geisel, right? The one from the Ducal house?
Surely these three couldn't be the helpers His Majesty sent, right?
The three of them strode toward me. Geisel then spoke to me.
"Theodore Haksen! I'd like a moment of your time!"
"Oh, you're not calling me a country bumpkin this time. No, wait, was he the one who called me a country bumpkin?"
At my remark, Geisel's face turned beet red. The other two turned pale.
"...My apologies for my rudeness earlier."
"It didn't seem like just rudeness."
"More importantly, I want to ask you properly. Are you, are you really... truly... Lord Damien's nephew?"
"Uh, yeah. My name is Theodore Haksen."
I stated my name.
They were guys I was going to stomp on soon, but I could at least exchange names, right?
Geisel looked me up and down.
Soon, an expression of disbelief crossed his face.
"How can Damien Haksen's nephew... look so unimpressive?"
He's saying this even after finding out I'm Damien Haksen's nephew?
At this point, even I had to be impressed.
I could now see why my uncle detested the Empire's nobles so much.
"But a renowned mage like the headmaster would not lie. Alright, I've decided."
Geisel spoke to himself and came to his own conclusion.
"Let me introduce myself again. My name is Geisel Huko. I am a direct descendant of the honorable Huko Ducal House."
Geisel's voice overflowed with confidence.
Well, for a direct descendant of a ducal house, that's to be expected.
"The Huko Ducal House has long supported the Empire as a family of knights. The honorable blood of the Huko family flows through my veins."
Geez, he talks a lot.
"Our Huko family does not form connections carelessly. We do not even exchange words with those who are not worthy."
"So?"
"Theodore Haksen, you may rejoice. I shall grant you the opportunity to build a friendship with me."
I was dumbfounded.
Who does he think he is, 'granting' me an 'opportunity' to build a friendship?
What made me even more flabbergasted was the reaction of the other two.
"Kuh, to receive such a glorious opportunity! I'm so envious of you, Theodore Haksen!"
"What are you doing, Theodore Haksen? Aren't you going to thank Lord Geisel!"
All three of them were ridiculous.
"I have a lot to ask you. About how... how Lord Damien usually spends his time."
"I-I want to know Lord Damien Haksen's preferences!"
"I... I like anything. As long as it's a story about Lord Damien Haksen, I love it all!"
The three of them asked me with shining eyes.
As expected, their target was my uncle, not me.
I had already made up my mind, but this made it even clearer.
How I should deal with these guys.
I repeated the words I had learned from my uncle.
"Get lost, you unlucky bastards."
The expressions on the three of them shattered completely.
That was quite a sight to see.
"W-What did you say?"
"Are your ears clogged? Want me to unclog them for you?"
When I spoke threateningly, Geisel looked at me with an expression of sheer disbelief.
"T-Theodore Haksen... H-How can you be so rude..."
"You're the rude ones. You idiots talk like the idiots you are."
"I-Idiot...!"
All three of them were rendered speechless, just trembling.
It must have been a huge shock.
"Someone like you can't possibly be Lord Damien's nephew! You don't have the right to be Lord Damien's nephew!"
"What right do you need to be family? Are you really that stupid?"
"Y-You!"
Geisel's face flushed crimson.
My uncle taught me.
When an opponent reacts like that, they could lunge at any moment, so be prepared.
I subtly glanced over the three of them and made my calculations.
Trip the first one who rushes in, then a left-right combo to the jaw of the second one.
For the last one, a knee to the abdomen followed by an elbow to the back should do it.
That way, I should be able to subdue all three of them cleanly.
After all, these were techniques taught by none other than my uncle, so it's a sure thing...
"Kyaaaaaah!"
"Woooooow!"
Just then, cheers erupted from a distance.
The sound startled both me and the three boys, causing us to lose our focus.
I tried to focus on the three again.
"S-She looked at me! She looked at me!"
"Sister! Take me! I'm right here!"
But the crowd's reaction was so unusual that my curiosity got the better of me.
I looked past the three boys' backs.
They had also turned to look by now.
The source of the sound was surprisingly close.
A woman was walking over from a short distance away.
Even from afar, she was very tall.
Not just tall, but her back was straight, and her walking posture was very stable.
With every step, her golden hair swayed.
It was a particularly deep shade of gold among blondes.
I found my gaze stolen without realizing it. She was really pretty.
So pretty that she was as beautiful as my aunts.
"I-Isn't that Her Highness, the Princess?"
"I-I've never seen her before."
"I saw her once at a banquet..."
"R-Really? As expected of Lord Geisel."
Thanks to their conversation, I was able to figure out the identity of that pretty person.
-The Emperor has a youngest daughter. I heard she's also attending the Academy, so you might get to meet her if you're lucky.
Suddenly, my uncle's words came to mind.
He had said it while I was learning various things in preparation for enrolling in the Academy.
"Huh? I think she's coming this way?"
"M-Maybe she has business in the headmaster's office?"
The three of them whispered while looking at the princess.
But contrary to their expectations, the princess stopped right in front of us.
"You're Geisel of the Huko Ducal House, right?"
The Princess said with a smile as soon as she saw Geisel.
At her words, Geisel's mouth stretched into a goofy grin.
"I-I never knew you would know my name, Your Highness!"
"I saw you at the last imperial banquet."
"I-I never thought you would remember me."
Geisel looked like he was about to cry. Is being called by name that great?
"P-Perhaps you came here to meet me..."
"Ah, that's not it."
The Princess cut him off flatly and looked at me.
Thinking there might be something behind me, I stepped to the side.
But the Princess's gaze followed me.
"Theodore Haksen?"
For a moment, something flashed through my mind.
Huh, did she come to meet me too? Well, I am Damien Haksen's nephew, after all.
"I heard a lot about you from my father. He told me to take good care of you."
Could the helper the Emperor sent be...?
The Princess patted my head and spoke.
"My name is Dorothea Adelard. Feel free to call me Dora-noona."
The Princess said with a smile.
Her smiling face is really pretty, too.
But I had no time to admire her smile.
"T-To be allowed a nickname by Her Highness the Princess...!"
Geisel was seething with rage beside me.
"Theodore Haksen! As I thought, I cannot acknowledge you!"
So what if you can't acknowledge me?

Side Story Chapter 17: Academy (1)
I took a tour of the Academy under the guidance of the Princess.
"That's the East Hall cafeteria. The Academy has one cafeteria for each cardinal direction. You should probably remember their locations."
"The Academy dormitories are largely divided into three types. There's a place for commoners, a place for nobles, and a place for royalty."
"Ah, this is the garden. It's quite famous in the Empire for its beautiful scenery. You should definitely come see it later."
The Princess's explanations were very kind and detailed.
Thanks to her, I was able to get a grasp of the Academy's layout.
I looked around the various parts of the Academy with a fascinated expression.
To think I was actually here, at the place where my uncle once worked as an instructor.
My heart was pounding.
But as time passed, I found it increasingly difficult to concentrate on the Princess's explanations.
"Isn't that Princess Dorothea? Where is she going?"
"Haaah... She's so beautiful, no matter how many times I see her."
"Look at that elegant figure. Just as you'd expect from the imperial bloodline."
Just by walking with the Princess, we drew the gazes and attention of everyone around us.
Seeing how everyone was completely captivated by her, she must be a very popular person.
Then again, being this beautiful and a member of the royal family, there's no way she wouldn't be popular.
"But who's the little kid next to her?"
"How cheeky, occupying the spot right next to the Princess. I haven't even been able to talk to her!"
"That's not what's important right now! That punk is getting a tour of the Academy from the Princess herself!"
Naturally, people's attention also poured onto me. Most of it was not favorable.
"But isn't that kid pretty handsome?"
"More than just pretty handsome, don't you think? Which family did a kid like that pop out from?"
"He'll be something to see when he grows up a little more."
I was walking while listening to the murmuring of the crowd.
"Wait, that boy is him! That guy!"
"Who's that guy?"
"Damien Haksen's nephew!"
Eventually, someone who recognized me popped up.
"Damien Haksen's nephew? No way, was that rumor true?"
"It's certain! My younger brother was enrolling so I attended the ceremony, and I saw the headmaster say it himself!"
"I, I saw it too! It's for real! That kid is Damien Haksen's nephew!"
As soon as my identity was revealed, the crowd's reaction became even more explosive.
"Wow, my god... so that's Damien Haksen's nephew. I've never seen him before."
"Information about Damien Haksen's family is strictly controlled, after all."
As time went on, people began to gather from all directions.
It seemed they had heard I was here and came to find me.
"That's Damien Haksen's nephew? Are you sure? He's too small."
"That's what I'm saying. I saw Damien Haksen from a distance once, and he was a massive, muscular giant."
"But their faces do seem to resemble each other..."
"He's definitely as handsome as Damien Haksen."
Oh, boy.
At this rate, the headmaster's effort to pull me aside was for nothing.
He had called me to his office because he was worried about people flocking to me.
Besides, I wasn't too keen on all the attention either.
Whenever this many people gathered, a problem always seemed to pop up.
"Wait, the Princess and Damien Haksen's nephew are together?"
Just as I feared, the situation I was worried about came to pass.
"Could this be a coincidence? I don't think so."
"I think the same. This is clearly some kind of political message."
"What reason could there be for those two to be together?"
"What if Damien Haksen's nephew and the Princess are engaged?"
What is this ridiculous nonsense.
I was so shocked that my legs got tangled up.
As I was about to take a big fall, the Princess asked in alarm.
"Theo, are you alright?"
"I'm, I'm fine."
Contrary to my words, my expression was not fine at all.
It was because of the wild speculation I was hearing from all around.
"The two of them are engaged...?"
"N-No way! The, the Princess with a noble from another country... Th-That can't be!"
"It depends on the noble. That kid is Damien Haksen's nephew."
"If he's Damien Haksen's nephew, he's more than qualified... more than qualified..."
The crowd's topic of conversation instantly shifted.
A few people tried to dismiss it as nonsense, but it was no use.
Just as no one can stop a bull with its tail on fire.
"Doesn't this mean Damien Haksen and His Majesty will become in-laws?"
"Th-Then what advantage does the Empire gain?"
"What's there to weigh? Just becoming closely related to Damien Haksen would be an astronomical gain!"
I know from experience that people have a habit of interpreting things in whatever way they prefer.
It seems the nobles of the Empire are no different.
I was lamenting the standards of the Imperial nobility.
Just then, a statue erected in the plaza caught my eye.
The statue was in the form of a knight.
The full-body steel armor and the heavy greatsword exuded an intimidating presence, even though I knew they were fake.
I observed the statue carefully. It looked very familiar.
"Your Highness?"
"I told you to call me Dora-noona."
"...Yes, Dora-noona. I have something to ask."
"What are you curious about?"
"Is that by any chance... my uncle?"
I asked, pointing at the statue.
The style of the armor and greatsword was similar to my uncle's.
At my question, the Princess smiled brightly and answered.
"You have a good eye. You're right. The Academy erected that to honor Lord Damien Haksen."
"Woooow, really?"
I looked at the statue again with a surprised expression.
The statue was massive. It seemed to be about ten times my height.
"After Lord Damien Haksen saved the continent, they were built in important facilities across the Empire by order of my father... that is, His Majesty. To commemorate Lord Damien Haksen's achievements."
I gazed at the statue with shining eyes.
I knew very well that my uncle was great, but I rarely had the chance to feel it so tangibly.
"It's huge, right?"
"Yes!"
"In the Empire, Lord Damien Haksen is greatly respected. There isn't a single person who doesn't look up to him."
"Is my uncle that amazing?"
At my question, the Princess nodded.
"Lord Damien Haksen not only saved the continent, but he also had a very large influence on the Empire. Thanks to the knowledge he shared, our swordsmanship and magic developed greatly."
Ah, now that I think about it, my uncle occasionally went on business trips to other families as a consultant.
It seems he must have visited the Empire as well.
"Theo, you should take pride in the fact that Lord Damien Haksen is your uncle."
"I already feel it every day."
I answered while looking up at the statue.
It goes without saying.
My uncle is my greatest source of pride.
The Princess watched me silently for a moment, then smiled and spoke.
"Shall we get going, then? There are still more places to see."
"Yes!"
I answered energetically and was about to follow the Princess.
"Theodore Haksen!"
A familiar voice rang out thunderously.
Me, the Princess, and the people around us all turned our heads in surprise.
"Hazel?"
Unsurprisingly, the person who had shouted was Hazel.
She ran toward me with a face that was clearly furious.
"What do you think you're doing? You've already hit on another girl in the short time we've been apart?"
"H-Hit on? What is this nonsense all of a sudden!"
"You're going to deny it when I've caught you red-handed?"
Hazel spoke with a face full of anger.
Wait a minute, why is she angry?
There's nothing between us, is there?
"Who's that girl? Judging by her clothes, she doesn't seem to be an Imperial noble."
"But she's kind of... cute, isn't she? Which family's daughter is she?"
The crowd showed great interest in Hazel, who had appeared out of nowhere.
From my perspective, this was nothing short of a huge headache.
"Hazel, come here for a second..."
"Hey, you!"
I tried to get away from this spot with Hazel.
But before I could, Hazel stood right in front of the Princess.
"Who are you to be hitting on Theo-oppa!"
"H-Hitting on me?"
The Princess looked at Hazel with a very bewildered expression.
There was a significant height difference between them, so the Princess was looking down, and Hazel was looking up.
"Theo-oppa might be cute and handsome, but don't you dare make a move on him!"
"Uh... um... I understand. But what's your name?"
"It's Hazel Ryan Bloom! You'd better remember it!"
Saying that, Hazel wrapped her arms around my arm.
I was startled and pulled my arm away, but it was already too late.
"D-Did you just see that? That girl just hugged Damien Haksen's nephew!"
"It means they have a serious relationship! D-Don't tell me she's his fiancée?"
Someone put forth the hypothesis that Hazel might be my fiancée.
The problem was that in the heated atmosphere, the hypothesis was accepted as if it were true.
"Damien Haksen's nephew has a fiancée?"
"But he was hitting on the Princess?"
"Th-This is terrible...! I will absolutely not stand by and watch this happen!"
"But what can we do? His opponent is Damien Haksen's nephew."
"How can we stop the nephew of an absolute being that even His Majesty is wary of."
"Kuh... To be unable to protect the Princess. I curse my own powerlessness!"
N-No, what is this all about.
H-Hey, everyone? I'm not that kind of person, you know?
I looked around frantically in a panic. Anyone would do, is there anyone who would listen to my explanation...
"Th-Theodore Haksen...!"
Then our eyes met.
With none other than Geisel Huko.
Geisel Huko was hiding his body behind a nearby tree.
Along with his two cronies.
"How dare you... toying with the pure heart of that noble lady...!"
Geisel's body trembled as he shouted at me.
"I swear on my family's honor, I will not forgive you!"
After declaring his revenge on me, he left the scene.
It seems our relationship has crossed a river of no return.
Though I have a feeling he crossed it all by himself.
Right, this is no time for this. First, I have to stop Hazel.
"Hazel, Hazel."
"Oppa, don't even think about stopping me. I will absolutely not let this matter go."
"This is Her Highness Dorothea Adelard, the Princess of the Empire."
The moment she heard my words, Hazel's body froze solid.
Hazel stiffly turned her head to look back at the Princess.
The Princess smiled brightly and said.
"What Theo said is true."
"Kya, kyaaah!"
Hazel screamed and hid behind me.
She buried her head in my back and shouted urgently.
"To not recognize Your Highness the Princess... I have committed a crime worthy of death!"
"Don't be so scared. I have no intention of reprimanding you."
"B-But!"
"Now, will you come out?"
The Princess coaxed and soothed Hazel, eventually drawing her out.
Oh, she's good at handling people. I wonder if she has a younger sibling.
"Will you tell me your name?"
"I-It's Hazel Ryan Bloom."
"That's a pretty name."
"Isn't it? My dad gave it to me himse... Eek! I must be crazy. I'm sorry for speaking when Your Highness didn't ask!"
"I told you not to be so scared."
The two of them started to get close at a rapid pace.
I couldn't help but admire the Princess's social skills.
Phew, that's a relief. With this, the misunderstanding won't spread any further...
"L-Look at that. After Damien Haksen's nephew said a few words, the two of them reconciled!"
"To be that skilled at handling women at such a young age."
"He's a playboy... a total playboy."
The crowd's misunderstanding, far from being resolved, had entered an even deeper realm.
No, why? Why on earth did this happen?
"Theo!"
Just then, Hazel grabbed my hand. Her expression was very bright.
"Dora-unnie invited us to a meal! You should come too!"
"No, why should I..."
"Hurry up and come on!"
Hazel pulled my hand with all her might.
I didn't even have the energy to resist, so I was quietly dragged along.
As I was being dragged away, I briefly looked back and saw people earnestly whispering amongst themselves.
I don't even want to imagine what kind of terrible rumors are being born right now.

Side Story Chapter 18: Academy (2)
That night, I could not fall asleep easily.
It was not my first time sleeping in an unfamiliar place away from home.
But the Academy was not just an unfamiliar space, but a place where I would be living for the next few years, wasn't it?
I was nervous, and also excited.
I was so looking forward to what my life at the Academy would be like that sleep did not come easily.
On top of that, tomorrow was the first day of the Academy. Just how amazing would the classes at the renowned Academy be?
I tossed and turned for a long time before I barely managed to fall asleep.
However, the next day, upon arriving in the classroom, I had a premonition that my Academy life would not go as I had expected.
"They say he's Damien Haksen's nephew."
"He's smaller than I thought, isn't he? Is he really Damien Haksen's nephew?"
"Don't be fooled by his small size. For all he looks, he's a fearsome playboy."
"A playboy?"
"I heard he hit on the Princess even though he has a fiancée."
"How is he still alive after committing such a crazy act?"
"He's Damien Haksen's nephew. Who would dare lay a hand on him."
The students were whispering about yesterday's events.
"I heard his fiancée even caught him in the act."
"What? Is that for real?"
"And what's more, his fiancée even picked a fight with the Princess."
"My god! Good heavens!"
"But after Damien Haksen's nephew said a few words, the situation didn't escalate and they both decided to let it go quietly."
"N-No way! What woman would just let something like that go!"
"That's why he's so fearsome. He looks innocent on the outside, but he's no ordinary devious bastard."
Among the students, I had been branded as a playboy who toyed with two women, backed by my uncle's authority.
Perhaps because of that, no one came near me.
Looking at the empty seats all around me, I suddenly felt a sense of crisis.
I have to be at the Academy for several years, and I can't spend all that long time alone, can I?
"Um, excuse me..."
"H-Hiiiiek! I, I didn't say anything! I don't know anything!"
"Hello?"
"U-Uwaaah! S-Sorry! I don't know what for, but I'm sorry!"
I mustered up the courage to talk to them, but they all just avoided me and ran away.
I felt incredibly wronged.
I was being misunderstood and even ostracized for something I did not even do.
Haaah, it would have been nice if Hazel was here at a time like this.
As it happened, Hazel had been assigned to a different class.
No, wait, when you think about it, this all happened because of Hazel, didn't it?
I was just starting to resent Hazel.
The classroom door opened and three people came inside.
It was Geisel and his two cronies from yesterday.
"It's Geisel, isn't it? He was in the same class as us?"
"Geisel? Geisel Huko?"
The students' attitude toward Geisel was completely different from their attitude toward me.
A desire to get close to him was radiating from their very expressions.
"Lord Geisel, it has been a while. I am Aldente of the Pista County!"
"I am Roson of the Gurkha County! I pray you will remember me!"
The students scrambled over each other to introduce themselves to Geisel.
The prestige of a ducal house truly is something else.
Seeing them flock to him like that.
Honestly, I am envious. I wish I were that popular, too.
Just then, my eyes met Geisel's.
Geisel smirked, as if my being alone was pathetic.
Wow, that really pisses me off.
To the point where I want to use every single technique my uncle taught me right now.
"Theodore Haksen, did you sleep well yesterday?"
Geisel asked as he approached me. I answered bluntly.
"So-so."
"That's a relief. The dormitory is far too luxurious for a country bumpkin from the Apple Kingdom, so I was worried you might not be able to sleep."
At Geisel's words, his two cronies laughed out loud.
The other students looked our way with bewildered faces.
"Geisel just picked a fight with Damien Haksen's nephew, didn't he?"
"Is there a reason for them to be on bad terms?"
But no one stepped in to stop it.
It seemed they were worried about getting caught in the crossfire.
"If you think you cannot adapt to the dormitory, let me know. I'll get you a room in the servants' quarters. Of course, even that room would be too good for you."
This little bastard.
I was in the middle of getting up in a huff.
"Everyone, sit down."
An adult's voice echoed throughout the classroom.
All the students, including myself, looked toward the door. There, we could see a man with curly, disheveled hair.
"Did you not hear me? I said, sit down."
Geisel and his two cronies immediately sat in the seats behind me.
Because of that, I missed my timing to lunge at Geisel.
The curly-haired man stood before the lectern and spoke to us.
"Nice to meet you. My name is Oliver Fortina. For the next year, I will be your homeroom teacher."
So this man was my homeroom teacher.
My uncle had explained it to me.
At the Academy, there's a position called homeroom teacher who is responsible for a class.
I have had private tutors before, but this was my first time having a homeroom teacher.
I looked at Teacher Oliver with a sense of anticipation.
"For classes, an instructor for each subject will come in and teach you. For your reference, I am in charge of the Basic Swordsmanship course. Class is scheduled for the 4th period today, so we will meet again then."
I thought he looked physically sturdy for some reason, and it turns out he's in charge of Basic Swordsmanship.
I heard from my uncle that becoming a teacher at the Academy is incredibly difficult.
It's only possible if you have skill, fame, and character all combined.
In other words, Teacher Oliver is an exceptionally skilled swordsman.
"And, is Theodore Haksen here?"
At Teacher Oliver's words, I quickly raised my head.
Teacher Oliver looked at my face and spoke.
"So you're Theodore Haksen. It's a real pleasure to meet you."
"It's an honor to meet you too, Teacher."
"Hahat, you have a knack for saying pleasant things."
Teacher Oliver laughed as if he was very pleased.
"A long time ago, your uncle served as a temporary instructor at the Academy."
"Yes, I heard from my uncle!"
"At that time, I was your uncle's student."
"What? Really?"
It seemed I was not the only one who was surprised. The eyes of all the other students went wide as well.
"I only learned for a very short period, but it was incredibly helpful. Based on that experience, I was able to become a teacher at the Academy like this."
Teacher Oliver flexed his forearm, and brawny muscles revealed themselves.
Just by seeing this, I could tell. Just how strong a person Teacher Oliver was.
"To have learned from my uncle, you must be amazing!"
"I am amazing. Of course, I am. Your uncle's teachings were truly like gold."
It was about my uncle, but I felt my own shoulders square up with pride.
But suddenly, the expression vanished from Teacher Oliver's face.
He stared into the void with dead eyes and muttered.
"But it was truly... a truly agonizing time... Your uncle hit us a lot... a whole lot..."
Saying that, Teacher Oliver's body trembled.
"Yes... with that fucking club... he mercilessly hit my head... no matter how much I was hit, It never left any marks... that was the most terrifying part..."
Umm... what on earth did my uncle do at the Academy?
Teacher Oliver quickly regained his expression.
He smiled brightly and spoke to me.
"Anyway, I'm glad that you've become my student.
If you have any difficulties, feel free to tell me anything."
Teacher Oliver patted my shoulder and then left the classroom.
"Theodore Haksen, your Academy life is blooming right from the start. I'm so jealous you have such a good uncle."
Geisel mocked me from behind.
When I turned around, Geisel shrugged his shoulders.
"Don't look at me so scarily. I'm saying it because I'm genuinely jealous."
Who does this guy think I am, a fool?
He's mocking me, asking if it feels good to borrow my uncle's authority.
I decided to swallow my anger for now.
The 1st period was about to start.
* * *
1st period was math.
"Nice to meet you. I am Charlotte Everin, in charge of the mathematics curriculum."
The math teacher, Charlotte Everin, was a woman with a very kind impression.
But I could not help but be nervous.
To be honest, when I was tutored at Spring Castle, math was the subject I struggled with the most.
"From my experience teaching students at the Academy, I've found that many students are afraid of numbers. But there's no need to worry. If you just follow my lessons well, you'll be able to solve any difficult problem with ease."
Fortunately, listening to Teacher Charlotte's words gave me some courage.
Indeed, what ordinary teacher gets to work at the Academy?
They are not just highly skilled, but veterans who have been through all sorts of things.
A class taught by such a veteran must be different in some way, right?
"Alright everyone, shall we open our books to page 8?"
But my expectations were shattered as soon as the class began.
"Here, we must use Jacob's Triangle Formula. That is the only way to accurately calculate the angle."
I could not understand a single thing she was saying.
It was not that Teacher Charlotte seemed to be a bad teacher, though.
All the other students were nodding their heads and moving their pens.
"Good work, everyone. I'll see you all again tomorrow."
By the time the class ended, I was feeling a deep sense of despair.
I had heard the standards at the Academy were high, but I never thought it would be to this extent.
This is completely different from what I learned from my private tutor at Spring Castle!
But I cannot just stay dejected like this.
Math was a subject I was originally bad at, right? So the other classes will be different!
However, as the classes progressed, my confidence gradually broke through the floor and went underground.
2nd period, history class, had too much to memorize.
3rd period, ancient language class, I could not understand a single word.
In the end, by the time the 3rd period was over, I was completely exhausted.
I was slumped over in my chair, leaning against the back, right before the 4th period.
"The classes must have been very difficult for you, huh?"
Geisel whispered to me from behind.
When I looked back, I could see him snickering with his two cronies.
"To think that Lord Damien's nephew can't even keep up with such easy classes."
"Lord Geisel, don't tease him too much. Lord Damien Haksen is the amazing one, not his nephew."
"Still, it is funny. That the nephew of the great Lord Damien Haksen is such a... ahem."
It's a sudden thought, but those three are perfectly in sync.
They know exactly how to get under a person's skin.
"I thought someone on the level of Lord Damien's nephew would be a match for me. It seems I was mistaken."
"Who in the world could possibly be a match for Lord Geisel?"
"Perhaps a direct descendant of another ducal house, or a member of the royal family, but otherwise..."
Was it because I was so angry?
I did not even get worked up anymore.
Instead, I felt a coldness slowly creeping up in my chest.
I was glaring at the three of them with a chilly gaze.
"Did you all listen well in class?"
Teacher Oliver entered the classroom.
"The 4th period Basic Swordsmanship class will not be held in the classroom, but at the outdoor training grounds. Everyone, follow me."
Teacher Oliver went out first, and the students followed him in a crowd.
The outdoor training grounds were very spacious and equipped with various training apparatuses.
But Teacher Oliver did not head for the training apparatus, but for the dueling ring placed in the center.
"Some of you may have noticed, but all the members of our Class 3 are from knight families. This is because it is more efficient to group students with similar inclinations for classes."
Oh, I see.
I actually did not know that. Since I have not been able to talk with the other students.
"It wouldn't be fun to start training right away on the first day. In that spirit, today I plan to check your skills."
Everyone's eyes gleamed.
To have your skills checked. In other words, to determine who is superior and who is inferior, right?
For the students, it was a statement they could not just brush aside.
If, as Teacher Oliver said, they were all from knight families, they would have great pride in their family's swordsmanship.
Me? I'm actually not that interested. I don't really like fighting people in the first place.
"One by one, come up and designate an opponent."
The moment Teacher Oliver finished speaking, someone stepped up onto the dueling ring.
"Isn't that Geisel Huko?"
"To be the first one to step up. As expected of the Huko Ducal House."
"Why is everyone so relaxed? I don't have the confidence to not be utterly humiliated if I fight Geisel!"
I could feel everyone's fear of being chosen by Geisel Huko.
But it was a needless worry.
"Theodore Haksen, come on up."
The opponent Geisel Huko had designated was me.
Geisel Huko added with a blatant sneer.
"Surely Lord Damien's nephew won't run away, will he? If you can't wield a pen, you should at least be able to wield a sword."
I felt the coldness that had been rising in my chest grow even stronger.
Instead of immediately stepping up onto the dueling ring, I looked around. I could feel the countless gazes focused on the two of us.
A place where I could be acknowledged by everyone.
Conversely, a place where I could be ridiculed by everyone.
It's just perfect.
It is a more than perfect stage to put my uncle's advice into practice.
I jumped up onto the dueling ring without a moment's hesitation.

Side Story Chapter 19: Academy (3)
Who is the person you respect the most in the world?
To that question, Geisel Huko had given the same answer since he was a child.
Damien Haksen.
The hero who saved the continent.
The swordsman who severed the heads of the Great Demon Kings.
The living Transcendent, and so on.
There were countless titles that symbolized Damien Haksen.
And every single one of them held a profound meaning.
The Imperial Supreme Sword, the Sword Saint, the Mercenary King, even Great Five Elders, were all but dust compared to Damien Haksen.
How could one not respect such a great being?
Even if one could never become like Damien Haksen, he was more than worthy of being a lifelong goal.
That was why Geisel Huko could never accept it.
‘Theodore Haksen! There is no way someone like you could be Lord Damien’s nephew!’
When he heard the rumor that Damien Haksen's nephew was enrolling in the Academy, Geisel Huko felt his heart pound in his chest.
The nephew of the man he so deeply respected!
Information about Damien Haksen's family was treated as top secret, so he knew nothing about the nephew.
But it was obvious he would be a remarkable person.
He was the nephew of none other than Damien Haksen, after all.
He would surely possess looks and an aura incomparably superior to that of ordinary people.
His skills, too, would be beyond question.
He would have been taught directly by Damien Haksen, of course.
But the nephew of Damien Haksen he met in person was a pathetic being.
His looks were quite, no, exceptionally outstanding, but his physique was too small.
There was not even a trace of training on him.
Just an ordinary boy with a pretty face.
That was the person named Theodore Haksen.
Honestly, if it had been just that, Geisel Huko would have been disappointed and left it at that.
But there was a decisive reason why Geisel Huko could not tolerate Theodore Haksen.
‘How dare a man shamelessly flirt with women without a shred of integrity!’
How could a man approach another woman when he already had a fiancée?
For Geisel, who had been raised since childhood by his father and brothers on the principle of single-minded devotion, it was an even more incomprehensible act.
Even the status of the woman Theodore Haksen had approached was a problem.
‘How dare he… how dare he approach the Princess… to do such an unthinkable thing to that noble lady…!’
Dorothea Adelard.
A woman who every noble man currently enrolled, or planning to enroll, in the Academy could not help but admire, had been sullied.
Therefore, Geisel Huko had absolutely no intention of forgiving Theodore Haksen.
He planned to punish Theodore Haksen in front of everyone and thoroughly humiliate him.
“Theodore Haksen, pick up your weapon.”
Geisel Huko shouted, gripping a practice spear.
* * *
‘As expected of a direct descendant of the Huko Ducal House.’
Oliver Fortina, the homeroom teacher of Class 3, thought to himself as he observed Geisel Huko’s stance.
The Huko Ducal House was a family famous for its spearmanship.
Within the Empire, there was no spear-wielding knight family that could compare to them.
‘They said a dragon was born into the Huko family. I suppose that rumor was true.’
Moreover, Geisel was a prodigy who had properly inherited the Huko family’s bloodline.
A strong body, a brilliant mind, and sharp instincts.
He was literally a person who seemed to be the real-life embodiment of the word “genius.”
Pundits were going around saying that Geisel Huko would become a pillar of the Empire within the next twenty years.
‘Compared to him, Theodore is… not good at all.’
Oliver shook his head as he looked at Theodore, who was holding a practice longsword.
His stance was sloppy, and the hand gripping the hilt lacked strength.
‘It was what I thought when I first saw him, but is he really Lord Damien’s nephew?’
A strong person always exudes a unique aura.
It was hard to explain in exact terms.
But there was something that made one feel they could not be ignored.
Geisel Huko also possessed such an aura.
But Theodore Haksen had nothing of the sort. He was as unthreatening as flowing water.
He just looked like an ordinary child.
‘But I cannot be hasty in my judgment.
If he learned from Teacher Damien, he must have a hidden card up his sleeve.’
The period Oliver had learned from Damien Haksen was very short.
Therefore, he did not know well what kind of ‘person’ Damien Haksen was.
But he knew all too well how frightening and incredible a being he was.
‘Let’s just watch for a bit.’
Oliver crossed his arms and watched the two of them.
The one to take the offensive was Geisel Huko.
“Haaap!”
With a war cry that felt like it would burst his eardrums, he thrust his spear.
Speed, power, technique.
It was a perfect thrust, a harmonious blend of these three elements.
The air could be seen exploding from the tip of the spear.
‘A decent… no, a thrust that even a fairly skilled knight would have difficulty blocking.’
At that moment, Oliver predicted Theodore Haksen’s defeat. But the situation unfolded in a completely different way.
Clang.
Theodore had struck the spearhead with the blade of his longsword.
With a dull sound, the spear was flung upwards. Surprise appeared on Oliver’s face.
“Haaat!”
Geisel immediately righted his spear and thrust it out again.
A torrent of thrusts like rays of light poured out relentlessly.
‘Amazing. To be at this level at such a young age.’
The assessment of him being the prodigy of the Huko family was no exaggeration. He had already far surpassed the level of his age group.
But Theodore Haksen was no pushover either.
He had cleanly parried all of those attacks.
‘What in the world?’
Oliver could not help but be greatly bewildered by the sight.
‘How is he holding on with those thin arms?’
Theodore Haksen’s body was not trained at all.
Even Geisel had clearly defined muscles on the forearm gripping his spear shaft.
But Theodore Haksen’s arms were so thin it looked like one could break them with their bare hands.
Defense is not omnipotent.
When parrying and blocking an enemy's attack, the impact was bound to be transmitted to the body.
The stronger the enemy's attack, the greater the impact transmitted to the body.
Therefore, if the body was weak, one could not block more than a few times before reaching their limit.
‘In the first place, how is he even keeping up with that speed?’
Geisel Huko's thrusts were not only powerful but also frighteningly fast.
That was not all. They were also mixed with feints, making them unorthodox.
And yet, Theodore Haksen was blocking all of those fearsome consecutive attacks.
‘I need to look more closely.’
Oliver focused mana into his eyes. His vision was enhanced, and more things became visible.
‘What is this?’
Only then was Oliver able to solve his own puzzle.
He saw that a current of mana was enveloping Theodore Haksen’s body.
‘What is that?’
Even for Oliver, who had accumulated diverse experiences to the point of becoming a teacher at the Academy, it was a phenomenon he was seeing for the first time.
‘Normally, when you strengthen the body with mana, traces are bound to appear, but…’
Usually, it was just at the level of mana flowing out of the body.
This was the first time he had seen a current like this appear.
‘The traces are appearing strongly… does that mean the body’s enhancement rate is that high?’
It could not be that only his body was being strengthened.
If so, he would not be able to react to the speed.
Body and senses.
He was strengthening both.
To the point where he could fight on equal terms with the prodigy of the Huko Ducal House.
‘Fearsome… but is this all?’
It was certainly a great training method. To the extent that it would be hard to find even in the Empire.
But it had many shortcomings to be considered something made by a Transcendent.
‘If this is all he has, Theodore cannot defeat Geisel.’
Geisel not only had outstanding physical abilities but also possessed highly perfected techniques.
Oliver's prediction came true in a spectacular fashion.
A light gleamed from Geisel’s eyes. At the same time, the spear shaft split apart.
‘He’s even learned an ultimate technique?’
An ultimate technique was a skill meant to surely kill the opponent.
It was powerful but incredibly difficult to learn. To think he had learned it at such a young age.
A dozen phantom spears rained down on Theodore Haksen.
‘That’s dangerous.’
It was a blow too powerful to allow. It was the moment Oliver was about to intervene.
A light gleamed from Theodore’s eyes as well.
Theodore’s movements became drastically faster. All of the split spearheads were flung away.
“What?”
Geisel’s eyes went wide. It was an event worthy of surprise.
Theodore kicked off the ground.
He closed the distance in an instant and thrust the tip of his sword.
The sword tip, having pierced the air, struck Geisel’s solar plexus.
“Keok!”
Geisel flew backward helplessly. He fell to the ground and dry-heaved.
An utterly clean victory.
‘…What was that just now?’
Oliver felt his mind go blank.
Geisel’s technique was fearsome.
For a moment, it had even reached the level of a formal knight.
To break through an ultimate technique, one had to crush it with an ultimate technique of equal rank.
But Theodore had responded by parrying all of them head-on.
‘And there was no wasted movement. It was as if he knew the ultimate technique beforehand.’
To Oliver’s eyes, it looked as if Theodore had moved knowing the future.
‘Could it be that he was hiding his talent?’
That could not be.
As a teacher of the Academy, Oliver's eye was accurate.
Theodore was a child who could by no means be considered a genius.
Even just looking at the duel proved it.
In the beginning, Theodore was unable to counterattack Geisel and focused on defense.
‘Could it be?’
What is the difference between a genius and a dullard?
It was too varied to explain briefly. Brains, physical ability, instinct, and so on.
But the decisive difference in Oliver’s opinion was the ability to read the flow.
A genius reads the enemy’s habits, gaze, and movements to lead the flow.
A dullard lacked such an ability. An attack was just an attack, and a defense was just a defense.
Because they could not read the enemy’s flow, they were bound to be easily defeated by a genius.
Theodore was clearly a dullard.
The proof was that he had allowed Geisel to attack him one-sidedly.
But just now, when he parried the ultimate technique, Theodore displayed a talent that surpassed Geisel.
‘If it’s inconsistent, it’s not talent. In that case…’
Oliver felt a chill run down his spine.
He had realized what Damien Haksen had created.
‘He must have created a training method that bestows talent.’
He could not tell what principle it operated on.
There were surely limiting conditions.
But what was certain was that Theodore, for a brief moment, had surpassed Geisel.
‘With a training method like that, the line between genius and dullard becomes blurred.’
If the existence of this training method became known, there was a high risk it would turn into a major problem for Imperial society.
The reason the Empire was in its current position.
The reason the Empire’s ruling class could enjoy all sorts of rights.
It was all based on skill.
The training method Theodore had learned was not just stepping into a forbidden realm, but completely immersing itself in it.
‘But who on earth could possibly take issue with Damien for this.’
It was a technique that could only be made because it was Damien Haksen, and could only be permitted because it was Damien Haksen.
Just then, Oliver noticed that everyone was looking at him.
Only then did Oliver realize that he had not yet declared the winner of the duel.
“Ahem, the winner is Theodore Haksen.”
Only then did cheers erupt from among the students.
* * *
“Dammit.”
Geisel gasped for breath and spat out a curse.
He had wanted to punish Theodore Haksen spectacularly in front of all the Class 3 students, but he had failed.
Rather, he was the one who had been punished. Theodore Haksen’s skill was far superior to his own.
Just then, Theodore Haksen approached Geisel.
He did not like it, but he had to say what needed to be said. Geisel spoke bluntly.
“…I lost.”
After saying it, he felt somewhat relieved. It was easier to say what came next, too.
“I acknowledge it. You are definitely Lord Damien’s nephew.”
The ultimate technique Geisel had unleashed was his trump card.
It was not a skill he had learned hastily, but one prepared for dangerous situations.
Theodore had blocked such a thing head-on.
It was Geisel’s defeat, with no room for excuses.
“I’m sorry for everything until now. I apologize for my actions.”
In this moment, Geisel let go of all his grudges and acknowledged Theodore Haksen…
“What are you talking about.”
…just as he was about to, Theodore Haksen spoke in a displeased tone.
“W-What?”
“Looks like getting your ass kicked by me finally snapped you to your senses, huh?”
“Th-That’s not it…”
“You started all that petty shit, so I thought you were something special, but you’re not a big deal, are you?”
Geisel’s face went blank.
He did not know it, but Theodore was currently using the exact lessons he had learned from his uncle.
“Don’t mess with me again. Unless you want to be beaten until you’re about to die.”
Leaving those words behind, Theodore Haksen turned and left.
Geisel trembled and then shouted.
“Theodore Haksen! I will definitely pay you back for what happened today!”

chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]

Side Story Chapter 20: Academy (4)
After the 4th period, a break was waiting for me.
We were told to have lunch and then rest well until the afternoon classes began.
Isn't that wonderful?
"Where is everyone thinking of going?"
"I heard there's a cafeteria inside the Academy. They say students and faculty can all use it."
"I heard we're allowed to go to restaurants outside, too."
The students gathered with their own groups of friends and went to eat.
I could only watch them with envy. Because I was alone.
"Lord Geisel! Allow me to escort you!"
"Do you have a restaurant in mind?"
"There is a restaurant outside the Academy that is run by my family."
Geisel was also about to leave the classroom with his two cronies.
But just before crossing the threshold, he stopped and said this to me, didn't he?
"Theodore Haksen, it seems you have no one to have a meal with?"
A slight sneer appeared on Geisel's lips.
I was a little dumbfounded.
To think his spirit was not broken at all after getting beaten so badly during the duel.
That, in its own way, is impressive.
"If you don't have anyone to go with, you can join us..."
"Theo-oppa!"
A familiar voice rang out thunderously.
Wouldn't you know it, Hazel came striding into the room.
And it was not just Hazel. The Princess was with her, too.
"Her, Her Highness the Princess is here!"
"T-To think I would get to see the Princess!"
"Who's that next to her? She's really cute."
The moment the two of them appeared, everyone's gazes were focused on them.
Ignoring all that, Hazel walked right up and wrapped her arm around mine.
"You're hungry, right? The Princess knows a good restaurant. Let's go, quickly."
I went outside with the two of them.
Geisel glared at me as I left and then let out a wail.
What is wrong with that guy now?
* * *
The restaurant the Princess brought us to was in a quiet location.
From the outside, it looked ordinary, but the interior was very lavish.
The clothes the staff were wearing also looked extremely expensive.
As soon as we sat down, food was laid out on the table as if they had been waiting.
Every single dish was delicious.
"I'm glad it suits your tastes."
"It's the best!"
Hazel answered immediately. `1
The Princess looked at Hazel as if she were adorable.
"By the way, Theo. I heard you beat Geisel Huko in the 4th period?"
I could not help but be surprised by the Princess's question.
How could she possibly know what happened during the 4th period?
"Rumors spread quickly at the Academy. Especially rumors about famous people like you."
Ah, I see.
Since it happened at the outdoor dueling grounds, there must have been many witnesses, so the rumor must have spread fast.
"Everyone is showing immense interest in this incident. Geisel Huko is famous for being a genius, you see. And they're saying you defeated him with overwhelming skill."
"Oppa, is that for real? But you're weak, Oppa. How did you win?"
Hazel asked as if she found it fascinating.
This girl says rude things so casually.
But she is right. I had never received any training at all before enrolling in the Academy.
"Before enrolling in the Academy, I learned a training method and swordsmanship from my uncle."
"Really? What did you learn?"
"Um."
It's hard to explain. Because I do not really know what I learned either.
"I don't really know either."
"What do you mean?"
"My uncle said it's a training method that activates the brain to perfectly analyze the enemy. But the explanation was too complicated."
At my explanation, the expressions of the Princess and Hazel changed strangely.
"Isn't that dangerous?"
"Ah, no, it's not. He said it's safe as long as I follow the rules."
"Rules?"
"Don't use it more than three times a day. Train with it every day. Stop if your nose starts bleeding. And..."
With every rule my uncle mentioned, the expressions on the two of them got even worse.
"...Well, if Lord Damien made it, it must be safe."
Hazel said, letting the matter drop.
Actually, I think she just wanted to focus on the meal quickly.
As soon as the conversation ended, she started putting food in her mouth.
"Ah, that's mine!"
"Finders keepers."
The two of us ate as if we were competing with each other.
The Princess watched the two of us as if she found us adorable.
* * *
After the meal was over, I returned to the classroom.
It was to attend the afternoon classes.
The afternoon classes were just as difficult to understand.
I had to endure the pain of my head feeling like it was going to explode.
By the time all the classes were over, I was utterly exhausted.
"Hooo."
I was packing my bag with a sigh. Suddenly, my shadow shot straight up, didn't it?
"U-Uwaaah! What is that!"
Geisel, who witnessed the sight, screamed. At the sound, everyone looked my way.
"The, the shadow is moving?"
"A, a ghost!"
The other students were terrified as well.
But when the shadow transformed into the shape of a wolf, the screaming quickly subsided.
"A, a wolf?"
-Pant, pant pant.
"It looks like a large dog...?"
Munchi rubbed his head against my hand. I patted him all over with both hands.
"What's wrong?"
-Big Master! There's a call!
"From Uncle?"
My face brightened. I immediately asked Munchi to connect me with my uncle.
-Okay!
Munchi scattered back into a shadow and then formed a large mirror.
Soon, the scenery in the mirror changed, and my uncle appeared.
"Uncle!"
-Oh, Theo. Are your classes over? Did I perhaps call too early?
-No! Class just ended!
"That's a relief, then."
My uncle said with a smile.
-So, did you have a good first day at the Academy?
"Um..."
-Judging by your reaction, it seems you had a hard time keeping up with the classes.
"B-But I beat one person in swordsmanship class with the technique I learned from you!"
-Very well done. As expected of my nephew.
I chatted with my uncle with a wide grin.
Then I noticed it. The fact that the other kids had gathered around me.
"Th-Theodore?"
One of them mustered up the courage to speak to me.
"A-Are you by any chance... ta-ta-talking with L-L-Lord Damien Haksen?"
"Uh... yeah?"
At my words, shock appeared on everyone's faces.
"Th-Then perhaps... c-could I... j-j-just once... ha-have a w-word... I mean..."
Aha, so it seems they want to speak with my uncle.
Well, it's not a difficult request. I asked my uncle.
"Uncle, the other kids want to talk to you, is that okay?"
-There's no reason why not.
I turned the mirror toward the other kids.
They scrambled over each other to get to the mirror.
"L-Lord Damien Haksen! It is an honor! And another honor to behold your esteemed face!"
"Uwaaaah! I can't believe I'm actually seeing Lord Damien Haksen!"
"I, I-I have a question! A question!"
The reaction was truly explosive.
Watching the kids go wild over my uncle made my own shoulders square with pride.
"Th-Theodore Haksen... C-Can I also speak with Lord Damien..."
"No."
I cut him off flatly.
What has this guy done to deserve to meet my uncle?
"..."
At that moment, despair appeared on Geisel's face.
It was so deep and dark that even I flinched.
"...But I'll allow it today."
I quickly changed my words.
It felt like he would cause a major incident otherwise.
"Th-Thank you so much!"
Geisel laughed gleefully and ran to the front of the mirror.
And so, the sudden meeting with my uncle ended much later.
* * *
"I should end the communication here. I have some business to finish."
Saying so, Damien Haksen deactivated the magical communication.
The mirror floating in the air vanished without a trace.
"Well then, shall we finish the rest of our conversation."
Saying so, Damien Haksen turned around.
A scene from hell was spread out before him.
Over several dozen people were impaled by chains and fixed in mid-air.
"K-Kill me... please... just kill me already..."
"I was wrong I must have been crazy I won't do it again please just kill me now."
"Damien... Damien Haksen..."
Those impaled by the chains let out horrifying screams.
"Didn't I tell you earlier? To give me the answers I want."
Damien flicked a finger in the air.
Dark mana congealed, and new chains pierced their bodies.
"Kraaaahk! Kaaaaahk!"
"Kill me! Kill me, you son of a bitch!"
"Uheheheng, Mommy! Moommyy!"
The screams grew even louder.
It was a scene as if hell had descended upon the mortal world.
But Damien did not bat an eye.
"You used everyone from adults to children as sacrifices, and yet you whine in pain from this much suffering?"
Damien did not torture his enemies.
The only exceptions were dark mages.
They roamed the outskirts of the Empire, capturing its citizens and using them as sacrifices for dark magic.
Even newborn babies who could barely walk had lost their lives at their hands.
"I will ask again. What are you dark mages thinking, collecting the thought-forms of the Demon Kings?"
Until recently, the dark mages had been in a state of disarray.
They were nothing more than rats hiding to escape the disaster known as Damien.
But suddenly, the dark mages' actions had begun to become organized.
They started collecting the thought-forms of the Demon Kings and gathering sacrifices from all over the Empire.
This was also evidence that a new central figure had emerged.
"Speak. Then I will kill you without pain."
At Damien's question, one of them laughed with a gurgling, phlegmy sound.
"Damien... Haksen... Your time to act all high and mighty... is almost over... Soon... you will... despair... suffer... and submit to us..."
"Submission, you say."
Damien stroked his chin and fell into thought.
Snap.
When Damien snapped his fingers, the chains disappeared.
The man who had been spewing hatred at Damien stared at him with a bewildered face.
"I have this sickness where I can't stand still when I see things like you."
Damien threw something toward the man.
It was a Demon King's thought-form and a longsword.
The man caught the two reflexively.
He plunged the Demon King's thought-form into his chest and infused the longsword with dark mana.
A vivid Aurablade enveloped the longsword. It was not at the level of a Sword Master.
A Grandmaster.
It was the supreme state said to be one step above a Swordmaster.
"Damien Haksen!"
The man let out a roar and swung his longsword.
The Aurablade slashed at Damien's neck.
A sneer appeared on the man's lips.
The Aurablade was a famed sword that could cut through anything.
Only another Aurablade could block it.
No matter how strong Damien was, he could not possibly withstand having his bare skin cut by an Aurablade...
"Pathetic."
But contrary to the man's thoughts, the Aurablade was blocked by Damien's skin and could not advance any further.
"What... this is impossible..."
"Do you understand now? Just how futile a dream you are all chasing."
Damien grabbed the Aurablade with his bare fingers.
With a slight application of force, the Aurablade and the longsword shattered completely.
"The Demon Kings could not do anything to me even when they were whole. Did you really think you could oppose me by gathering mere thought-forms?"
The man looked up at Damien with a dumbfounded face.
Damien once again used dark mana to create chains.
"Well then, let's start again. This time, you will give me the answers I want, even if I have to scrape your brains out."
In the forest shrouded in darkness, screams echoed late into the night.

chapters.content:
