Side Story Chapter 21: Field Trip (1)
After that, I spent my days busy adapting to life at the Academy.
The classes still felt difficult, but I was able to endure thanks to the help of Hazel and the Princess.
“Oppa, the answer to this problem isn’t the Herko region, it’s the Herman region. The fertilizer invented there led to the Empire’s agricultural revolution.”
I did not know this, but Hazel was actually very smart.
Unlike me, she was smart enough to be at the top of her grade. The bloodline of the Ryan Bloom Marquisate is truly superior.
“Theo, this word should be translated as ‘vine,’ not ‘forest.’”
The Princess was also a very big help.
Being in a higher grade than me, she knew a lot, and more importantly, she taught me in a way that was incredibly easy to understand.
After school, I always studied in the library with the two of them.
“Look over there, it’s Theodore Haksen.”
“Next to him are the Princess and the young lady of the Ryan Bloom Marquisate, aren’t they?”
“To think the three of them are always sticking together like that… he’s a fearsome playboy, just like the rumors said.”
“To think he’s already chasing women with such a cute face…”
…Thanks to this, my infamy grew even more, but this was not the time to worry about that.
I had finally enrolled in the Academy, so I could not afford to be held back a year or expelled for poor grades, could I?
If that happened, my parents and my uncle would be very sad.
It was about a month after I had enrolled in the Academy.
“Starting next month, a field trip awaits you.”
When the last period ended, Teacher Oliver spoke to us.
“The Academy actively encourages field trips in order to gain experience that cannot be obtained at the Academy.”
Oh, so it's that kind of class. As expected, the Academy is different in every way.
“We are accepting location sponsorships until next week. Students who are willing to provide a location should have their families contact the school. With that, this meeting is dismissed.”
After saying that, Teacher Oliver left the classroom.
I was a little puzzled. Providing a location for a field trip? Isn't that something the Academy decides?
“The field trip season has finally arrived.”
I could hear the conversation of Geisel and his cronies sitting behind me.
These three, despite being on bad terms with me, always sat in the seats behind me.
“Are you perhaps planning to have the Huko Ducal House provide the location?”
“Of course. We cannot miss such an honorable opportunity.”
“That is truly amazing!”
Oho, it seems providing a location for the field trip is a big deal.
“If it’s a location the Huko Ducal House would provide… could it be the Ten Thousand Year Armory?”
“That place is good too, but my father said he is also considering the Spirit Spring.”
“Wow, that is truly incredible!”
Somehow, the names all sound quite extraordinary.
I heard that the ancient families of the Empire have many secrets. Could this be one of them?
I was concentrating on the three’s conversation.
“Theodore Haksen, what are you listening to so intently?”
Oops.
It seems I was being too obvious.
When I turned around with an awkward expression, Geisel spoke with a triumphant look on his face.
“Well, you can’t help but be interested. Our Huko family’s Ten Thousand Year Armory and Spirit Spring are famous even in foreign countries.”
Um, I actually have no idea what those are, but I did not say anything.
If I did, he would obviously start teasing me again, calling me a country bumpkin or whatever.
“You can look forward to it. I’ll be sure to broaden the horizons of a country bumpkin from the Apple Kingdom like you.”
But not saying anything did not stop him from calling me a country bumpkin.
I got worked up and said to Geisel.
“What’s so great about going to a place like that that it’ll broaden my horizons? I’d be lucky if I don’t fall asleep.”
This time, Geisel got worked up.
“Ha! A country bumpkin will be a country bumpkin. A frog in a well.”
“What did you say?”
“Am I wrong? The Haksen Dukedom has great power, but its history is short. It’s obvious you don’t have any place worthy of being recommended for a field trip.”
I felt my words get caught in my throat. I could not refute him.
“You’re speechless now that I’ve hit a nerve. Just sit tight and look forward to it. I’ll take you to a place so wonderful that the likes of the Haksen Dukedom couldn’t even dream of it.”
Geisel laughed out loud and left the classroom. Left alone, I could only tremble.
***
“...and that’s what happened!”
That evening, I was talking to my uncle and told him about what had happened today.
-What, is that for real? The likes of the Huko Ducal House looked down on our family?
Uncle Damien asked back as if in disbelief. I swung my fists around and said.
“It’s true! He said our Haksen Dukedom has a short history so we probably don’t have any places to be proud of, and what not…”
-They dared to spout such nonsense.
My uncle’s eyes darkened.
Whenever my uncle made that expression, some kind of trouble was bound to happen.
Normally, I would have tried to stop my uncle beforehand, but at that moment, I was so worked up that I did not notice.
“Do you know what pisses me off even more?”
-What is it?
“It’s that I couldn’t refute his words…”
As Geisel said, the Haksen Dukedom has a short history. It has only been a little over ten years.
We have a magnificent castle and a beautiful forest, but we do not have any place so grand that we could confidently invite students to it.
-The Haksen Dukedom doesn't really have a place like that.
For once, even Uncle Damien seemed to be at a loss, just stroking his chin.
-But we can’t just stand by and be looked down on like this.
“Huh? Do you have a good idea?”
-I do. Of course, I do. I’ll take you to a place so wonderful it will turn that Geisel Huko bastard’s pride to dust.
With those words, the communication was cut off.
Where on earth is my uncle planning to take us?
“No way?”
Could he be planning to take us to the island where the elves are, or the dimension where the dragons stay?
I have been to both places, and they were truly magnificent.
If that is my uncle’s intention, he will surely be able to crush Geisel’s pride.
There is no place more mystical than those two in the world!
Thinking that, I fell asleep in a happy mood.
But the next day, my expectations were completely betrayed.
“Um… the location for the field trip has been decided.”
Teacher Oliver said with a blank expression on his face.
“We are… that is… going to Inferno.”
***
Orobos, the Lord of Inferno, opened his eyes today as well, to the sound of a gargoyle’s cry.
-Kkieeeek! Kweeeek!
There was no sound better for waking up than the cry of a gargoyle, which sounded as if it were tearing a human soul to shreds.
Orobos stretched and got out of bed.
-Keeeek! Keeeek!
The moment he stepped on the carpet, a scream could be heard.
It was the sound made by a demon who had been turned into a carpet for the crime of defying Orobos.
Orobos stepped on the carpet a few more times, enjoying the screams.
Hmm, another refreshing morning.
Every time he heard the clear cry, Orobos felt his mind and body become at ease.
Greatly satisfied, Orobos changed his clothes and headed for the dining hall.
Sitting at the table, Orobos asked his demon servant.
“What is for breakfast today?”
“It is asado made from the soul of a nouveau riche who built his fortune on usury, seasoned with the pain of sinners, and cooked over hellfire.”
Orobos nodded his head in satisfaction.
Orobos’s favorite food was the souls of humans.
Just hearing the name made his mouth water.
He finely sliced the food on the table with a fork and knife and slowly savored it.
-Kyaaak!
-Kraaak!
Every time he chewed the food, a sweet scream rang in his brain. It was a truly excellent dish.
‘Another peaceful day.’
As he savored the dish, Orobos recalled the past.
Ten years ago, an incident occurred where the high-ranking demons, including the Lords of Inferno, went up to the surface world and were annihilated.
In an instant, all the powerful figures of Inferno had vanished.
The demons vied for the empty seats.
They killed each other and took their power.
Orobos was one such demon.
He shed blood every day.
Not a day went by that he did not kill.
Sometimes, he even had to risk his own life.
In this way, Orobos seized victory.
He had risen to the position of a Lord of Inferno.
‘The hardship was worth it.’
Thanks to that, Orobos now had all of Inferno beneath his feet.
All the power and wealth of Inferno were his.
All demons bowed their heads before him.
‘The only downside is that I cannot go up to the human world.’
Inferno is a barren place.
Therefore, many demons sought to advance to the surface world.
Because the surface world was a place where they could harvest human souls on a scale incomparable to Inferno.
‘How delicious would a freshly harvested human soul be.’
Just imagining it made his mouth water.
But it was nothing more than an empty dream.
Because there was a monster on the surface world.
‘Damien Haksen.’
That man was the cause of the incident ten years ago, when the ruling class was annihilated en masse.
He had single-handedly slaughtered all the high-ranking demons, including the Lords of Inferno.
As if that were not enough, he had even annihilated all the Demon Kings who were the former rulers of Inferno.
Of course, they were not the real Demon Kings, but undead who had inherited their power.
‘It’s the same thing. Since they inherited the power completely.’
Going to the surface now meant facing Damien Haksen.
Orobos had absolutely no desire to face that monster.
‘I should just live contentedly in Inferno.’
In fact, Orobos’s position was still unstable.
There were demons who coveted his seat.
Things were a bit quiet now, but until three years ago, his life was threatened by having to constantly fight challengers who appeared.
‘I pray this peace continues.’
-Kkieeeek!
Orobos genuinely thought so as he chewed on the sinner’s soul.
***
One month later.
“You’ve heard the explanation from your homeroom teacher, right?”
Damien Haksen stood facing the students of Class 3, which included Theodore.
“We are now going to enter Inferno. Don’t worry. Not a single hair on your head will be harmed.”
Fear appeared on the faces of the Class 3 students.
What kind of place was Inferno? It was a terrifying land inhabited by demons.
The thought of going to such a place now could not help but make fear well up inside them.
Even if they were with Damien Haksen.
“There is no need to be scared. You will return safely without a single hair on your head being harmed.”
Could the words Inferno and safety even be used together?
A deep question appeared on the students' faces.
Ignoring them, Damien swung his sword into the air.
The air split open, and a dimensional portal opened. At the awe-inspiring sight, the students briefly forgot their fear.
“Shall we depart, then?”
Damien Haksen entered the dimensional portal first. The students all hesitated.
Just then, Theodore Haksen entered the dimensional portal first.
His steps showed not a hint of hesitation or fear.
At his appearance, the other students also mustered their courage and entered the dimensional portal.
It was the entry into Inferno.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: SS 22
chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 22: Field Trip (2)
“We are now going to enter Inferno. Don’t worry. Not a single hair on your head will be harmed.”
At my uncle’s confident words, I could not help but let out a deep sigh.
I mean, there are so many romantic places like the Elven Island or the Dragon’s Dimension, so why Inferno of all places?
Of course, I have never been to Inferno either, so I am curious, but it is not exactly a place for a field ‘trip,’ is it?
How did he even convince the headmaster in the first place?
Other than being the land of demons, Inferno is an unknown land with nothing revealed about it.
I do not think the headmaster would have readily given permission to take students to such a dangerous place.
“There is no need to be scared. You will return safely without a single hair on your head being harmed.”
Well, I do not like that the field trip location is Inferno, but I am not worried.
No matter how fearsome demons are, how could they possibly touch us when my uncle is here?
“Shall we depart, then?”
My uncle opened a dimensional portal and stepped inside.
As soon as my uncle disappeared, the students began to murmur.
“D-Do we really have to go to Inferno?”
“That’s where demons live, isn’t it? Isn’t it an incredibly dangerous place?”
Sigh, what a bunch of cowards.
I guess it cannot be helped. I have been watching how amazing my uncle is from right beside him, but the other students have not.
It can't be helped. I guess I have to be the first one to go.
I threw myself into the dimensional portal.
The moment I passed through the portal, the scenery changed completely.
I could see a sky as crimson as if it were smeared with blood, and a wasteland.
Not a single weed or insect could be seen in the wasteland. It was a truly barren and arid land.
“Oh, as expected, you were the first one in.”
My uncle said to me with a smile. I spoke to my uncle with a pouting face.
“Why did you decide on Inferno of all places?”
“Hm? Were you perhaps expecting somewhere else?”
“Yes, there’s the Elven Island, and the Dragon’s Dimension.”
“Why go to such a boring place? There’s nothing to see there.”
Boring! That might be from your perspective, Uncle, but the other kids would have loved it!
“And these kids are the talents who will lead the Empire in the future. Demons have been the enemies of humans since ancient times. So I’m going to show them. What kind of beings the enemies you must fight are.”
When my uncle spoke in a serious tone, I had no choice but to drop my complaint.
My uncle always said it like a habit. That he could not protect humans forever.
I think this is his way of preparing for a future where he is gone.
“And while I’m at it, I’ll teach a lesson or two.”
“Yes?”
“A demon bastard dared to touch you the other day, didn’t he.”
My uncle's eyes began to blaze.
“I decided then. That I would pay a visit soon and smash it to pieces.”
It is just my imagination that this seems to be the real reason, right?
I was seriously pondering my uncle’s intentions.
Another student popped out of the dimensional portal.
Surprisingly, the first person to muster the courage was Geisel.
“H-Hwaah! I-I really came in! I’m really in Inferno!”
Geisel was so terrified it looked like he would lose his mind at any moment.
Right, I have a debt to repay to this guy. I walked up to Geisel and said.
“How does it feel to be in Inferno? It’s a fearsome place, isn’t it?”
“Th-Theodore Haksen.”
“It’s a real shame. The Huko family’s Ten Thousand Year Armory? The Spirit Spring? I wanted to go see those places, too. Of course, they’re not as special as Inferno, I suppose.”
I do not like that my uncle chose Inferno as the field trip location, but that is a separate issue. I have to make the most of this opportunity.
At my words, Geisel Huko was speechless, like a mute who had eaten honey.
I held back the laughter that was about to burst out.
No matter how satisfying it was, I could not just laugh in his face.
Starting with Geisel, the other students also came in one by one.
Like Geisel, they were all thoroughly terrified.
“Everyone is here. I will now hand out bracelets. Everyone, put them on.”
My uncle handed out jade-colored bracelets one by one.
The students who received the bracelets were delighted, as if they had never been scared.
“T-To receive a gift from Lord Damien.”
“D-Don’t we have to return it when we’re done?”
“Those bracelets are gifts, so you don’t have to return them.”
At my uncle’s words, everyone looked deeply moved.
It seemed they were all that happy to have received a gift from my uncle.
“Instead, you must never take off this bracelet while you are in Inferno. Not when you eat, not when you change clothes, and not when you wash.”
Everyone looked curious as to why that was.
But it seemed they did not have the courage to ask my uncle, so they all just kept their mouths tightly shut.
I guess it can't be helped, I decided to ask for them.
“Uncle!”
“Oh, what is it.”
“Why can’t we take off the bracelets?”
“Ah, the air in Inferno is full of demonic energy, so if you breathe it in carelessly, your lungs will rot and you’ll die.”
At my uncle’s words, everyone’s face turned pale.
“Oh, then isn’t it dangerous for me since I’ve been in Inferno this whole time before getting the bracelet?”
“I’ve set up a barrier around this area, so it’s fine. And the bracelets also have a protective effect, so wear them at all times just in case.”
“Yes!”
If that is the reason, then I should never take it off.
I will be safe if I am next to my uncle, but you never know what might happen.
“From now on, we plan to move to the demon capital. I’ve never been to Inferno myself, so there’s the minor issue of not knowing where it is, but it’s not a big problem.”
Huh? I don't think that sounds like a minor issue.
How are we going to have a field trip if you don't even know the location in Inferno?
“It should be about time for them to show up.”
My uncle was looking around and muttering incomprehensible words.
Suddenly, with a huge roar, the ground began to shake. We lost our balance and stumbled.
“Wh-What in the world is going on?”
“D-Do they have earthquakes in Inferno, too?”
Just as everyone was terrified, the ground shot up.
And a wide shadow covered the land where we were standing.
What erupted from the ground was a giant turtle.
Strictly speaking, it was not a real turtle.
Its limbs were long and slender, and its head was shaped like a wolf’s.
“W-Woooow…”
I let out a gasp of admiration. It was so big it was like looking at a small mountain ridge.
-Khahahat! To see humans in Inferno!
The wolf-turtle demon looked down at us and let out a manic laugh.
-And not just one or two! What a windfall! I don’t know how living humans got into Inferno, but it looks like I’ll be having a feast after a long time!
The wolf-turtle demon licked its lips with its tongue.
At its gaze filled with hunger, the students’ faces turned deathly white.
“Hmm, a demon of a fairly high level.”
My uncle scanned the demon as if he were critiquing it.
At his gaze, the demon made a dumbfounded expression.
-A Death Knight? What is a toy of the city demons doing here?
Ah, so there are Death Knights in Inferno, too.
Hearing it talk, it seems that unlike on the surface, they’re nothing more than toys here.
“State your name and rank.”
-What? You, a walking corpse, dare to order me? You must have truly gone mad!
The wolf-turtle demon shouted and tried to swat my uncle with its front paw.
But before the demon could fully raise its arm, my uncle’s figure vanished without a trace.
Both we and the demon were surprised. The demon looked around in a panic.
-Wh-Where did that corpse go?
Just then, my uncle appeared above the wolf-turtle’s head and brought his fist down.
With a satisfying sound, the wolf-turtle demon’s head was smashed to pieces.
The headless body staggered a few times before falling forward.
At the terrifying sight, the students’ jaws dropped.
“The, the demon died in a single blow.”
“Is this the power of Lord Damien Haksen?”
“Truly amazing…”
Despite killing the demon in a single blow, my uncle’s expression was indifferent.
Well, a demon of that level is nothing to my uncle.
“We will now begin the first lesson. This is the most important lesson, so concentrate.”
The demon is dead, so what kind of lesson is this?
We were all wearing bewildered expressions.
“L-Lord Damien!”
Geisel shouted urgently.
The wolf-turtle demon, which we thought was dead, had shot back up.
Its smashed head was now in a state of perfect recovery.
The wolf-turtle demon opened its mouth and tried to swallow my uncle.
“Behind! Look behind you! It’s dangerous!”
Contrary to Geisel’s shout, my uncle did not turn around.
Instead, he stretched his leg upwards and kicked the wolf-turtle demon’s jaw.
The wolf-turtle demon’s mouth slammed shut, and its jaw and head were completely shattered.
-K-Keoheok!
But it immediately regenerated again.
A creature that regenerates even after having its head smashed twice?
We were all dumbfounded.
It was the first time we had seen a creature with such strong life force.
“As you can see, demons are extremely cunning and have many hidden tricks. So never let your guard down when fighting a demon.”
My uncle explained to the students.
Of course, the students were too shocked to be in a state to listen attentively to my uncle's words.
-K-Keuak… A m-monster. A monster has appeared. I-I have to run.
The wolf-turtle demon crawled on all fours, trying to get away from my uncle.
Just then, my uncle spoke briefly to the demon.
“Stop, if you don’t want to die.”
The wolf-turtle demon’s movements came to a dead stop.
The wolf-turtle demon looked back at my uncle, sweating profusely.
“You listen well.”
At my uncle’s praise, a complicated emotion appeared in the demon’s eyes.
It looked like it was seething with rage at the humiliation but was desperately suppressing it out of fear.
“Lower your eyes before I pluck them out.”
At my uncle’s warning, the demon immediately lowered its gaze.
My uncle wore a very satisfied expression.
“I have a few things to ask of you.”
-S-Speak.
“Speak?”
-P-Please speak, sir.
“Now that sounds a bit better. I am looking for the capital city where the Lord of Inferno is. Guide me there.”
The demon nodded its head up and down vigorously.
“And since we cannot walk all the way there, you will have to carry us.”
This time too, the demon nodded its head vigorously.
It seems it has completely thrown away its pride as a demon.
“Thank you for obediently following my orders.”
-I-It is nothing, sir.
The demon answered, sweating.
My uncle looked at the demon with satisfaction, then took something out of his subspace.
When we first saw the object my uncle took out, we were all bewildered.
Because the object was… a club.
It was a hexagonal club, well-oiled, with a glistening surface.
-Wh-Why are you taking that out, sir.
“The second lesson. The demon race never submits easily. Therefore, you must thoroughly secure their loyalty.”
-This crazy bastard!
The demon, sensing what was about to happen, spat out a curse and fled.
But my uncle moved faster than the demon could escape.
Moving above the demon’s head, my uncle brought the club down.
And the demon’s head was driven into the ground, shattering the earth.

chapters.content:
[Translator - Pot ]
[Proofreader - Kawaii ]
Side Story Chapter 23: Field Trip (3)
My uncle beat the turtle demon with brilliant skill.
Just when you thought he was hitting its shin, he was already striking its shoulder.
Just when you thought he hit its shoulder, he was landing a blow on its abdomen.
-Kraaak! This crazy corpse bastard! Stop, I said stop hitting me!
The sight of the mountain-ridge-sized demon getting beaten by my uncle and screaming was truly shocking.
-To play with me like this! I will kill you for sure!
Of course, the wolf-turtle demon did not just take it and fought back in its own way.
But it was a futile effort.
The wolf-turtle demon’s attacks could not even touch the hem of my uncle’s clothes.
-Kraaak! Kaaak!
Rather, every time it attempted an attack, it was beaten even more severely.
To the point where the air exploded with a boom.
“…”
My friends, who at first found it cathartic, gradually began to be filled with terror.
Anyone would be scared seeing my uncle fight for the first time.
The people of the world think of my uncle as a noble hero.
But my uncle’s actual self is completely different from what people think.
My uncle is, how should I put it… a bit wild, I suppose. Though it is true that he is a hero.
“Th-Theodore.”
Just then, Geisel spoke to me.
I was a little dumbfounded.
Are we really on terms to be having a casual conversation like this?
“I-Is Lord Damien always like that?”
“Yeah, my uncle is always like that.”
I answered vaguely. I did not particularly want to have a long conversation with Geisel.
“Lord Damien is truly… truly…”
Geisel stammered several times with a trembling voice.
Well, it is obvious what he is going to say.
That my uncle is different from the rumors, that his methods are too harsh.
He is obviously going to say my uncle is scary…
“A magnificent person!”
Huh? What did he say?
“To beat down a demon so easily! The rumors about Lord Damien were not exaggerated! He was as great as the rumors, no, far greater than the rumors said!”
Oh my, he must be completely blinded by admiration. To revere my uncle even after seeing a sight like this.
That said, I had no intention of correcting Geisel’s misconception.
Because it is not a misconception, but the truth.
My uncle is far, far, incredibly more amazing and magnificent than the rumors.
-I-I was wrong!
Just then, a desperate cry was heard.
When I turned my gaze, I saw the demon prostrated flat before my uncle, begging profusely.
-I-I was wrong! I must have been crazy for a moment! I lost my mind and dared to defy you, Lord Death Knight!
“Good. It seems you’re now in a state to have a conversation.”
My uncle nodded his head with a satisfied face.
The demon trembled, its eyes fixed only on the club my uncle was holding.
“State your name and rank.”
-My name is Garak! I hold the rank of Baron!
I heard from my uncle a long time ago that the demons of Inferno also have a five-tier peerage system.
Just having a title means that it is an extremely powerful demon.
“Did you hear that? He said he’s a Baron-rank demon.”
“I-I’ve read the records. A long time ago, a clone of a Baron-rank demon was summoned, and it annihilated two Master Class warriors and a whole order of knights before disappearing!”
“He beat down a monster like that with a wooden club?”
The students looked at my uncle with faces full of awe.
“Let me ask you one thing.”
-A-Ask me anything, sir!
“Do you know who I am?”
Garak could not answer and only looked around furtively.
It seemed he had no idea who my uncle was.
“Hmm, the demon I met last time recognized me right away.”
-I-I’m sorry! P-Please tell me, and I will engrave it upon my soul!
“No need to go that far… My name is Damien Haksen.”
At my uncle’s words, Garak’s eyes widened.
-D-Damien Haksen? The Great Demon Slayer? The Doom of Inferno?
“Hoh, it seems that is what I am called in Inferno. I quite like it.”
My uncle wore a satisfied expression. In contrast, the demon trembled like an aspen leaf.
My uncle left the demon alone for a moment and asked us.
“What did I say earlier about how to deal with a demon?”
“The demon race never submits easily. Therefore, you said we must thoroughly secure their loyalty!”
Geisel shouted loudly as if he had been waiting.
Ah, I was going to say it first. I glared at Geisel resentfully.
“You remember well. In that spirit, this one’s words cannot be trusted. Though he appears to be obedient on the outside, he may be harboring other intentions.”
-N-No, sir! I am prepared to die if it is Lord Damien’s command…
My uncle gestured in the air.
Dark mana gathered like a swarm of locusts, and massive chains were created in the sky.
The ends of all the chains were aimed at Garak.
Garak looked at the chains with trembling eyes.
“Here is the third lesson. When making a deal with a demon, always bind them with a restriction seal. Just in case of the unexpected.”
Aha, it seems these chains are all materialized restriction seals. It looks like they work by embedding them in the demon’s body.
-Y-You’re going to place this many restrictions on me?
“You don’t seem to like it?”
-O-Of course I don’t! Ah, no, of course! There’s no way I could live normally after accepting this many…
My uncle put the club back into his subspace. Instead, he took out a sword.
The moment he held the sword, the look in my uncle’s eyes changed.
He spoke to the demon with a face devoid of any smile.
“Choose. Will you accept the restrictions, or will you die here and now.”
-I will accept them!
Garak answered immediately.
It seems that even demons do not want to die.
***
We all climbed onto Garak’s shell.
It was originally lumpy and hard to sit on, but my uncle took care of it.
“I’m going to shave it down a bit.”
-Yes? But for our race, the shell is the standard of beauty…
“Is that so? Then I’ll have to shave your head.”
-Haha, my shell grows back, so you don’t have to worry! Shave off as much as you like!
“Your commendable heart moves me.”
So now it has become smooth enough for all of us to ride on.
-We will depart now!
Garak ran across the wasteland as if gliding on ice. The ride quality was surprisingly not bad.
“Woooah!”
“Waaaah!”
My friends were all delighted, feeling the wind.
When else would they get to experience racing through Inferno on the back of a demon?
I left the others and approached my uncle.
My uncle was standing with his arms crossed, silently looking ahead.
“Uncle.”
“Hm? Is something bothering you?”
“No, it’s not that, I have something to ask.”
“What is it?”
“Why are we going to the demon capital?”
I knew my uncle had come to Inferno to punish the demons, but I had not heard specifically how he planned to punish them.
“That is, you see, to bestow shock and awe upon the demons.”
“Shock and awe?”
My uncle patted my head and explained.
“Theo, the demon that tried to attack you last time not only continued to aim for the surface world despite my presence, but even incited others by calling me a fraud.”
“Yes, he did. They are very bad guys.”
“There’s no guarantee that other demons wouldn’t act the same way. Isn’t that right?”
My uncle is right. The situation on the surface is such that they cannot gather followers without resorting to such lies.
“What do you think is the reason those bastards are running rampant like that? It’s because I look like a pushover.”
My uncle’s eyes blazed.
It seems he is very, very angry.
“They committed such incitement and fabrication because they weren’t afraid of the consequences. So, to prevent this from happening again, what must be done?”
“Um, that would be…”
I recalled the things my uncle had taught me before I enrolled in the Academy.
“We have to instill fear in them so they can never do such a thing again, right?”
“As expected of my nephew. That’s right. But just beating up a few demons isn’t enough to instill that kind of fear. I have to do something truly terrible and fearsome. To the point where fear is engraved on the demons’ souls and bones.”
“So that’s why you’re going to the capital?”
Just as my uncle was about to nod his head.
Suddenly, a strong wind blew from the sky. My uncle and I stopped talking and looked up.
Then we saw two demons with black wings flying in from the sky.
-Garak! You must be tired of living! How dare you invade the territory of our Black Magpie clan!
-If you don’t get lost immediately, I will turn your body inside out and peck out your entrails!
At the threats of the bird-winged demons, Garak immediately called for my uncle.
-L-Lord Damien Haksen!
“Ignore them and run.”
-Y-Yes, sir!
Garak raced across the wasteland even faster.
-This bastard has finally lost it!
-I will take you to my father at once!
The bird-winged demons descended towards us. At their fearsome momentum, my friends all squeezed their eyes shut.
You ask if I was not scared?
What do you take me for? I am not a coward like them.
More than anything, I trusted my uncle.
“Things like annoying flies.”
Just before the bird-winged demons reached us, my uncle raised his index finger and swiped it horizontally.
At that moment, a black line was drawn in the sky and passed through the bodies of the bird-winged demons.
Blood burst out as the bird-winged demons were severed into upper and lower halves.
The two demons fell to the ground without even letting out a death cry.
“Wh-What was that just now?”
“D-Demons were cut in half in mid-air?”
I was not surprised since I had seen it often, but it seemed my friends were not the same.
They could not close their mouths.
-N-No way. Those two brothers, so easily…
“They seemed pretty strong?”
-Y-Yes, sir. They were both Count-rank demons, so they ruled this area!
“This level is Count-rank?”
My uncle said as if it were pathetic. Garak just kept swallowing dryly.
“Just watch where you’re going.”
-Y-Yes, sir!
Garak raced across the wasteland even faster.
Anyone could see that he was thoroughly disciplined.
***
After that, countless more demons came rushing at us.
-Human! It’s a human! This sweet smell! Leave your soul behind and go!
-How dare a mere Baron run rampant in my territory! I will tear off your limbs and stuff you alive!
There is no need to explain what happened to all of them, right?
-S-Save me! I-If you just let me go, I’ll give you anything! Please!
-I-I didn’t r-recognize a person of your stature. I-I’m begging you like this…
All of them lost their lives at my uncle's hands, and subsequently came to contribute to the lives that would be born after them.
What does that mean, you ask? In a word, it means they became fertilizer.
Anyway, thanks to my uncle stepping in personally, we were able to arrive at the demon capital quickly.
-This is Olobon, the capital of Inferno!
The capital of Inferno was a place more similar to the surface world than I had thought.
The only difference would be that the height of the castle walls was about ten times higher.
Why did they build the castle walls so high?
My question was answered as soon as we arrived at the gate. The demons waiting to enter were all massive.
-What is that? There are humans riding on a demon’s back.
-How did humans get into Inferno?
The demons nearby whispered amongst themselves as they saw us.
My uncle stood with his arms crossed, staring intently at the gate, then spoke to Garak.
“The line is long.”
-Yes? Ah, it is the capital, so many demons gather here.
“Do I really need to wait in this line?”
At my uncle’s question, Garak made a blank expression.
It was an expression as if he had heard something that was simply incomprehensible by common sense.
-L-Lord Damien. If you cause a disturbance here, it will be a huge problem!
“Why is that?”
-The demons guarding the capital are all high-ranking demons! And the Lord is here as well! If all of them come out…
“You, have you forgotten my name?”
-How could I! You are Damien Hak…
Garak wore an expression as if he had just realized his mistake.
-L-Lord Damien, surely you don’t mean…?
My uncle lightly jumped off Garak’s back.
He then walked past the waiting demons and approached the gatekeeper.
-What is that? It’s a Death Knight.
-Did someone lose it?
-It’s been a while since I’ve seen such a high-level Death Knight.
The waiting demons each muttered a comment as they saw my uncle.
Just then, someone jumped out and blocked my uncle’s path.
-Uhehe, what a windfall. I could sell this for a high price if I take it.
A demon made of a slimy liquid reached its hand toward my uncle.
My uncle flicked his finger at the demon as if annoyed.
At that moment, a pale blue flame enveloped the demon’s body.
-K-Kraaak! Kaaak!
The flame instantly incinerated the demon.
The demon did not even leave behind a speck of ash.
-Wh-What was that just now?
-A-A Death Knight burned a demon to death!
At the shocking sight, the demons were at a loss for words.
Even amidst this, my uncle did not stop walking and stood before the gatekeeper.
-You there! You are no ordinary Death Knight! Reveal your identity!
The gatekeeper, who resembled a bipedal elephant, aimed its spear at my uncle.
My uncle spoke to the gatekeeper as if he had no interest.
“I have no intention of wasting time on small fry. Go and bring your lord.”
The moment he mentioned the lord, the look in the gatekeeper’s eyes changed.
The gatekeeper’s eyes shone, and a blue lightning enveloped its body.
-How dare you speak of the Lord’s name so carelessly with that mouth! Your impudence pierces the heavens.
“Words don’t seem to be getting through.”
My uncle took out a sword from his subspace and gripped it.
Soon after, mana began to gather on the blade.
Flinch.
The demons, including the gatekeeper, felt my uncle’s energy and turned pale.
-H-How can a mere Death Knight possess such power…!
“Move.”
-W-What did you say?
“If you don’t move, you die too.”
As my uncle brought down his longsword, the gatekeeper turned into lightning and fled.
A massive slashing attack erupted, and the city gate was shattered.
Thanks to that, the scenery of the capital was clearly revealed.
-U-Uwaaah! What is happening!
-A m-monster! A monster has appeared!
The demons screamed and scattered in all directions.
“I will say this one last time.”
My uncle spoke to the elephant gatekeeper who was sitting collapsed on the ground.
“Go and bring your lord.”

[Translator - Pot ]

Side Story Chapter 24: Demon Lord (1)
“Begin the report.”
Demon Duke and Lord of Inferno.
Orobos spoke to the demons kneeling before him.
None of the demons were ordinary.
Not only were their appearances fearsome, but they also exuded a chilling aura.
Therefore, anyone could tell. That these were no ordinary demons.
“As per the Lord’s command, we have annihilated the Red Horn tribe, which was suddenly expanding its influence in the eastern region.”
“Kihihit, we have killed Count Barbaya, who was hiding his wealth in defiance of the Lord’s command, and hung his corpse on the castle gate!”
His subordinates competed to report their achievements.
Orobos listened to his subordinates' reports with a solemn face.
Inferno was still in a state of chaos.
The aftermath of the War of Titles still lingered.
Therefore, Orobos consistently gave orders to his subordinates to eliminate the reactionary elements.
As Orobos’s direct subordinates, their titles and skills were of a remarkable level.
Among his subordinates, there was even a demon who had competed with Orobos for the position of Lord.
“We have burned down the entire Dagda region, which refused the 87 percent tax rate decided by the Lord!”
“We have captured the band of thieves who stole the tribute goods and torn out their entrails…”
It was then.
Suddenly, with a loud roar, the entire building shook slightly.
The report was briefly interrupted by the disturbance.
“Judging by this vibration… it seems the outer wall has collapsed.”
Even though the capital was under attack, Orobos was calm.
There were still many demons in Inferno who coveted Orobos’s position.
It was surely one of them who had staged the attack.
“Who is it this time? Marquis Glamon? Or Count Zeta?”
“Either way, they are foolish beyond measure. To dare to point a sword at the Lord.”
“Kihihit, it seems we will see blood again.”
Far from being nervous, his subordinates were rather delighted.
There was no demon who did not enjoy violence and pain. To demons, war was like a festival.
Orobos and his subordinates were letting out sinister laughs.
The great doors of the hall swung open and a guard entered. It was a demon that looked like an elephant.
“I-It’s an emergency! The capital is under attack! The one who revealed his identity is Demi…”
“You are before the Lord. Do not act without dignity.”
Orobos said in a solemn voice.
At the intimidating voice, the guard could not help but shut his mouth.
“I have a rough idea of who the culprit is.”
“I-Is that really so?”
“I was getting bored, so this is good. It will be a good source of stimulation.”
The guard was greatly moved by Orobos’s utter lack of tension.
“A-As expected of our Lord! To think you would consider fighting that monster!”
Monster? Was there a high-ranking demon with such a nickname?
Orobos was momentarily puzzled but soon dismissed it.
He would be seeing his face soon enough, after all.
“Did that bastard have a message for me?”
“Y-Yes, he did! He said something about bringing the Lord before him…”
“How dare he spout such nonsense!”
It was not Orobos who was enraged.
It was one of his subordinates, a demon named Gamigin.
Gamigin could not contain his anger and shot to his feet.
The coarse fur covering his entire body stood up stiffly in response to its master’s fury.
“My Lord, please leave it to me! I will shatter every bone in his body and drag him before you!”
Orobos made a quick calculation.
To challenge him, the demon had to be at least a Marquis-rank.
In comparison, Gamigin was a Count-rank demon.
However, Gamigin was a demon known as the strongest among the Counts.
A powerhouse so strong that if the number of titles were not limited, he would have already become a Marquis-rank demon.
“Permission granted. Go and drag that bastard before me.”
Gamigin placed a fist on his chest and bowed his head.
Then, with thudding steps that shook the floor, he exited the great hall.
“I-I will go too!”
The guard also hurriedly followed Gamigin out.
“Now that Gamigin has stepped up, we can be at ease.”
“Kihihit, I’m envious. It was a rare chance to taste the blood of a high-ranking demon.”
Orobos and his subordinates laughed and enjoyed themselves, awaiting Gamigin’s triumphant return.
A short while later, another loud roar erupted from a distance. His subordinates gasped in admiration with their mouths wide open.
“It seems a rather fierce battle is about to unfold?”
“To have this much vibration from the first clash. Gamigin is quite something.”
“Kihihit, I wish I could see it with my own eyes.”
But contrary to the demons’ expectations, a second vibration was not heard.
“What? Why is it so quiet?”
“Don’t tell me Gamigin has already subdued the traitor?”
Everyone was wondering about it.
“I-It’s an emergency!”
The elephant guard who had left with Gamigin came rushing into the great hall.
The elephant guard flailed his arms and explained to the demons.
“L-Lord Gamigin is dead!”
“Hm? Gamigin?”
“That blockhead of a bastard is dead?”
The demons’ eyes went wide.
“Gamigin lost? He was only a Count, but he should have been no pushover.”
“Kihihit, even so, he was just a Count. Compared to us, he was sorely lacking.”
But the demons quickly recovered from the shock.
It was true that Gamigin was a demon with Marquis-level skill, but among Orobos’s subordinates, he was one of the weaker ones.
“Th-This is no time to be so relaxed! Th-That monster said that if the Lord does not come out this time, he will come to find you himself!”
“Silence.”
Orobos spoke again in a solemn voice.
The guard could not help but shut his mouth as if a spell had been cast on him.
“It seems a rather dangerous challenger has appeared. Who will step up this time?”
“Kihihit! I will go and take care of it!”
A demon with a pointed snout shot up and said.
Its limbs were as thin as a mosquito’s, but a hard-looking carapace covered its entire body.
It was like looking at a needle that could pierce through anything.
“If it’s Morkito, we can trust him.”
“He’s a disgusting bastard, but among the Marquis-rank demons, he’s one of the strongest.”
“There has never been a problem he couldn’t solve when he stepped up.”
His subordinates seemed to agree with Morkito’s participation. Orobos also nodded his head.
“Permission granted. Go and bring that bastard here.”
“Kihihit, leave it to me.”
Suddenly, Morkito made a gesture. A servant demon appeared and offered him a teacup.
Inside the teacup was steaming blood.
“Kihihihit, I will return before this blood cools.”
Morkito left the great hall with a confident face.
The elephant guard once again followed Morkito outside.
As soon as Morkito left, a loud explosion was heard. The sound was much louder than with Gamigin.
“As expected of Morkito. He shows no mercy to traitors.”
“His personality is rotten, but his skills are guaranteed.”
But this time too, the vibration ended with just one. His subordinates could not help but be bewildered.
“Don’t tell me…?”
Just then, the doors of the great hall burst open and the elephant guard entered.
He looked so rushed that he even tripped over his own feet and fell.
“D-Dead! He’s dead again! A-And what’s more, in a-a-a, a single slash! His body was split in half with a single slash!”
At the elephant guard’s vivid description, the faces of the subordinates turned serious.
“Morkito was killed in a single slash?”
“Morkito was a demon strong enough to once stand against the Lord.”
Just as the atmosphere among the subordinates was about to become more serious.
“He is no ordinary fellow.”
Orobos rose from his seat.
At that moment, the atmosphere changed.
Just by Orobos revealing his presence, the air became heavy.
“A worthy traitor to have appeared after so long. It’s been a while since a bastard has tensed me up like this.”
A black wind blew in from somewhere. A huge current of air swirled around Orobos.
“Th-The Lord is moving himself.”
“The Steel Storm rages again!”
The Lords of Inferno had, for generations, possessed titles that symbolized them.
In Orobos’s case, he was known by the name Steel Storm.
This was because he possessed the fearsome ability to create a typhoon with mass, grinding anything to dust without a trace.
“No one is to interfere. That one is my opponent.”
Saying so, Orobos kicked off the ground.
He became a black gale and went out through the window. He raced through the sky toward the place where the commotion had occurred.
Once outside, he could see it clearly.
The miserably collapsed outer wall and the shattered buildings around it.
‘The damage is not as great as I thought.’
He must have controlled his power. After all, he was the one who killed Morkito in a single slash.
Orobos discovered the corpses of Gamigin and Morkito.
Next to the corpses stood something small, like a human.
‘Found him.’
Though small in size, it was exuding an unusual energy. Orobos headed toward it.
The black gale gathered and reconstructed Orobos’s body.
Orobos shouted at the traitor.
“To kill two of my subordinates! You’re riding high! Worthy of aiming for my seat!”
Orobos felt his blood boil for the first time in a long while.
It had been a long time since such a traitor had appeared.
“Strange demon! State your name and title! If you do, as the Lord of Inferno, I will accept your challenge!”
This was the highest praise a Lord could give.
It meant that he was accepting him not as a mere traitor, but as a challenger.
“…”
But the traitor remained silent. Orobos tilted his head.
“Can you not hear me? State your name and tit…”
“I sent word twice for you to come out yourself, and you ignored my warning?”
At the voice that sounded as if it were desperately suppressing anger, Orobos could not help but be bewildered.
Somehow, his attitude was different from the traitors he had seen so far.
Orobos got the feeling that this challenger was treating him like a neighborhood mutt.
“Wait, you’re a Death Knight?”
Now that he was closer, he could finally see. The challenger was not a demon, but a Death Knight.
“A Death Knight killed two high-ranking demons?”
To demons, a Death Knight was nothing more than a toy for amusement to be sent into the fighting pits.
Not even a high-ranking demon, even a demon without a title could easily handle a mere Death Knight.
“This makes no sen…”
Suddenly, a certain being came to Orobos’s mind.
It is impossible for a Death Knight to kill two high-ranking demons.
But in this world, there was exactly one Death Knight capable of such a thing.
The monster who had slaughtered the previous Duke, who was known as the absolute monarch, and all his subordinates, and who had single-handedly annihilated the Demon Kings resurrected in the mortal world.
‘N-No way. Th-That can’t be.’
Orobos denied his own hypothesis and sniffed the scent and mana fragrance emanating from the Death Knight.
The next moment, Orobos’s eyes widened as if they would pop out.
The scent and mana fragrance were both identical to those of ‘that being,’ which he had barely managed to obtain by sending his clones to the surface.
“D-Don’t tell me…”
Just then, the Death Knight drew its sword. Orobos’s face was reflected on the blade.
In that instant, a chill ran through his entire body. His instincts screamed a warning.
“Lord Damien Haksen!”
Orobos immediately prostrated himself.
He slammed his head on the ground and shouted.
“Welcome to Inferno!”

Side Story Chapter 25: Demon Lord (2)
Orobos remained prostrated on the ground, cautiously observing Damien Haksen.
Fortunately, Damien did not swing his sword, but the look in his eyes remained the same.
Orobos was a warrior who had seized the position of Demon Lord through countless wars.
His sharp instincts told him that Damien Haksen was contemplating whether to kill him or not.
‘This is the crucial moment!’
Orobos threw off the clothes he was wearing.
The inside was covered in gray fur, so it was not indecent.
Originally, demons did not need to wear clothes like Orobos did.
Nevertheless, they wore them for the sake of dignity and authority.
In other words, throwing off his clothes was a declaration that he was casting away all his pride as a Demon Lord!
“Lord Damien Haksen! Please give me a chance! I will serve you with the heart of a mule silently pulling a cart!”
After today, Orobos’s reputation would hit rock bottom, but it did not matter.
He could somehow claw back that damned reputation.
But if he died? That would be the end.
“Hmm, I was going to kill you on sight because you were annoying. But you’re a bastard with his head screwed on right.”
Saying that, Damien Haksen sheathed his sword. Orobos let out a sigh of relief.
“Garak. Come in.”
Damien Haksen beckoned behind him.
The wolf-turtle demon entered through a gap in the collapsed wall.
‘What’s with that shell?’
Orobos was horrified when he saw the wolf-turtle demon’s shell. It had been shaved down to a smooth polish.
Considering that demons with scales or shells considered them their standard of beauty, it was a truly gruesome sight.
In human terms, it was no different from going bald.
Just then, Orobos noticed humans riding on the wolf-turtle demon’s shell.
And it was not just one or two.
There were well over twenty of them.
On top of that, they looked extremely young.
“D-Don’t tell me you brought human children into Inferno?”
Orobos could not contain his bewilderment and asked Damien Haksen.
What kind of place was Inferno?
It was a land so dangerous that living beings from the surface could not survive for even a moment.
And he brought human children to such a place? Just how lightly did he view demons to do something like this…
“You got a problem with it?”
“No! I do not! I absolutely do not!”
Orobos slammed his head on the ground again. And he cursed his own foolishness.
No matter how absurd it was, to think he would reveal his emotions in front of this lunatic monster.
‘No, but the more I think about it, the more ridiculous it is.’
But there was nothing Orobos could do about it. He could only quietly calm his emotions.
“The children need a place to rest, so guide us.”
“Yes! This way, please!”
Orobos shouted spiritedly and led the way.
* * *
“This is fucking huge.”
Damien Haksen said as he sat on the throne.
It was so large that it felt less like sitting on a throne and more like perching on top of a building.
This throne was originally an item that had been passed down through generations of Demon Lords.
A Death Knight was now sitting in a seat that only Demon Lords could occupy.
But no demon pointed this fact out.
“There’s no place for the kids to sit. Don’t tell me you plan to have our kids just stand there?”
“How could that be! What are you all doing! Bring out chairs for humans, now!”
This was because Orobos, the original owner of the throne, was sticking to Damien Haksen’s side and acting like a loyal subordinate.
“Lord Orobos? What is the meaning of this?”
One of his subordinates asked in bewilderment.
Orobos was always full of confidence, a strong demon who knew no defeat.
Countless demons had pledged their loyalty, captivated by that image.
For such a demon to act so subserviently?
“It seems my subordinates have not yet grasped the situation. May I go and educate them for a moment?”
“Do as you please.”
Orobos immediately rushed to his subordinates.
He lowered his voice as much as possible and explained.
“You foolish bastards! Don’t you know who that is?”
“Is he not a Death Knight?”
“Haaah… Sniff out that bastard’s scent and mana fragrance at once!”
At Orobos’s urging, his subordinates sniffed the air.
Soon, their jaws dropped as if they had been hit in the back of the head with a hammer.
“This scent, don’t tell me… D-D-D-D-D-De-De-De-De-De-De.”
“That’s right. It’s Damien Haksen.”
Despair appeared on the faces of his subordinates.
Some demons even collapsed to the ground, their legs giving out.
“Do you understand now? Why I am acting so subserviently? It is all to save you and all of Inferno!”
A Demon Lord must never miss an opportunity!
Though he was only doing this because he did not want to die, Orobos shamelessly packaged it as a great cause.
“Why is this conversation taking so long?”
“Ah, I’m coming now!”
Orobos forced a wide smile and rushed to Damien Haksen.
Damien Haksen pointed at Orobos and spoke to the students.
“If any of you need anything, ask that demon. There’s no need to hold back since I’m here.”
“Ah, Uncle! I’m thirsty!”
“You heard him? Bring something to drink. And keep this in mind, if you bring anything that could harm a human, I’ll tear your limbs off.”
Orobos immediately found and brought water so clear and pure that it would be no problem for a human to drink.
The young human took the water and gulped it down.
“Hooah, that’s refreshing. Thank you.”
“Don’t mention it. If you have any other discomfort, feel free to tell me anytime.”
Orobos said with a broad, friendly smile. But inwardly, he was seething with rage.
‘So this punk is Damien Haksen’s nephew.’
Orobos squinted his eyes and observed Damien Haksen’s nephew.
‘For his age, his soul is quite delectable.’
Among all the children gathered here, his soul was the largest and shone the brightest.
This was the finest quality among the finest. In the long history of Inferno, one would not be able to find a sacrifice of this caliber.
Gulp.
Orobos unknowingly gulped down his saliva.
Even knowing that Damien Haksen was right next to him, the desire was that strong.
“Orobos.”
Just then, Damien Haksen called him.
Orobos was startled and quickly knelt before Damien Haksen.
“Yes, your command, sir!”
“Why do you think I came to Inferno?”
“Was it not for the sake of the young humans’ field trip?”
“That was just a side trip.”
At Damien Haksen’s words, rage welled up inside Orobos.
Bringing young children to this dangerous Inferno was just a side trip?
Just how lightly did he view demons to do such a thing…
“Orobos.”
“Oh my, please speak, sir. I am listening to every word.”
Orobos said, rubbing his palms together profusely. Damien crossed his legs on the throne and spoke.
“Some time ago, a Marquis-rank demon was summoned to the surface and was annihilated by my hand. Did you know?”
Orobos searched his memory. No such case came to mind.
“My sincerest apologies! It has not been long since I ascended to the position of Lord, so there are still many demons who do not yet fall under my rule!”
“So you can’t even properly manage the demons. You’re a worthless bastard.”
Orobos felt a surge of anger.
How dare a mere human whose lifespan was not even a speck of dust compared to his own…
“It is due to my shortcomings that I have failed to meet Lord Damien Haksen’s expectations. I am deeply ashamed.”
His words came out the complete opposite of his thoughts.
But Orobos was not ashamed at all.
A Lord of Inferno must never easily reveal his emotions!
“That demon incited his followers by calling me a fraud. And using those followers, he harvested human souls.”
Hiccup.
Orobos hiccuped without realizing it.
This was because Orobos had also been using similar methods to obtain human souls.
It could not be helped.
The surface world was currently under Damien Haksen’s protection.
Humans would not pledge their loyalty to demons who were far weaker than Damien Haksen.
‘Dammit, I don’t know who it is but… why did he have to get caught by Damien Haksen of all people!’
Orobos rained down all sorts of curses on the nameless Marquis-rank demon.
If you’re going to die, just die quietly, why the hell did you have to get caught by Damien Haksen!
“It’s a really pissing me off. Not only did he slander me, but he even incited others by calling me a fraud.”
Gulp.
Orobos swallowed dryly.
It felt as if Damien Haksen’s red eyes were piercing right through his innermost thoughts.
“That’s why I have personally descended to Inferno. I didn’t think there would be just one or two demons doing such things.”
“N-No, sir! As far as I know, there is not a single demon who would do such a despicable thing! Even if there were, I would not have tolerated it!”
“Hmm.”
“It’s true! If they did that, they would incur the wrath of Lord Damien Haksen, so do you think I would be crazy enough to allow it?”
“Hmmm.”
Damien Haksen did not seem to believe Orobos’s excuses.
“What should I do about this.”
Damien Haksen stroked his chin and fell into thought.
Orobos felt a cold sweat run down his back.
His instincts as a Lord told him. That this was a truly dangerous moment.
“I could kill all of you here on the spot, but.”
Orobos felt the fur all over his body stand on end. His legs began to tremble.
“That would be too easy. And it’s not a suitable method for engraving fear deep into the souls of your race as I desire.”
Orobos was relieved. He sensed that Damien Haksen had no intention of killing him right now.
‘Huh? But he said he would engrave fear deep into our souls?’
It felt like he had heard something terrible. Orobos was just trying to recall if he had heard correctly.
“I will spare you.”
“Thank you! Thank you so much!”
Orobos spread his arms and bowed several times.
The words he had just heard were very concerning, but this was not the time for that.
In any case, he said he would spare him, didn't he?
“And while I’m at it, I’ll give you a chance to prove your innocence.”
Damien Haksen snapped his fingers.
Black mana gathered, and chains were created.
A quick count revealed there were over several hundred. Orobos, as well as his subordinate demons, stared at the chains with horrified faces.
These were not ordinary chains, but materialized restriction seals.
If even one of those were to be embedded in their bodies, the restriction would surely bind their body and soul.
“From now on, I will embed these into your bodies. Then I will believe in your innocence.”
The faces of Orobos and his subordinates turned pale.
These were restriction seals made by ‘the’ Damien Haksen. It was not hard to imagine how vile they would be.
They would probably have to suffer for the rest of their lives without ever being able to remove them.
And there were not just one, but hundreds of them.
“N-No matter how you look at it, we are the rulers of Inferno…”
“Ah, right. You were high-ranking demons. I forgot to be respectful.”
Orobos let out a sigh of relief.
It seemed Damien was planning to withdraw the restriction seals…
Damien Haksen snapped his fingers again. The number of chains tripled.
“Powerful demons must be bound even more thoroughly. Now, step forward one by one.”
For a moment, a heavy silence fell between Orobos and his subordinates.
Just then, one of his subordinates stepped forward and shouted.
“Kraaak! I can’t take it anymore! Damien Haksen! No matter how strong you are, this kind of tyranny…”
Damien Haksen pointed his index finger at the demon. With a pop, the demon’s head exploded.
The headless body fell backward. Everyone just swallowed dryly.
“From now on, only the demons who receive the bindings will be spared. The ones who are late will be killed.”
Damien Haksen said, beckoning with his index finger.
Immediately, the demons scrambled over each other.
“P-Put the restriction on me first!”
“No, me first!”
“How dare you bastards push past me, your lord, to go first?”
The great hall instantly turned into a chaotic brawl.
There were even demons who used force to be the first to receive the bindings.
“…Wow.”
“…Waaah.”
The students could only let out gasps of admiration as they watched the scene.
The students had eyes and ears, so they could guess how powerful those demons were.
If even one of them were to appear on the surface, it would be nothing short of a catastrophe.
And yet, such fearsome demons were throwing away their dignity and begging for their lives in front of Damien Haksen.
“Theodore, Lord Damien Haksen is a truly scary person.”
Geisel said to Theodore Haksen.
“My uncle is a bit scary.”
Theodore Haksen nodded his head in agreement. Soon, he said with shining eyes.
“But isn’t he just as cool?”
It was the look of someone who had completely fallen for Damien Haksen.

Side Story Chapter 26: Demon Lord (3)
And so, the demons all accepted my uncle’s restriction seals.
It seemed it did not particularly hurt.
No wounds appeared, and they did not scream.
“Ugh, I feel nauseous.”
“It feels like there are foreign objects moving around in my blood.”
That said, they were not completely fine either.
They were all pale.
The kids and I watched the scene from a distance.
Everyone watched with great interest.
The sight of high-ranking demons receiving restriction seals, even fighting each other for them, is not something you get to see easily, is it?
“Orobos.”
“Yes, Lord Damien!”
At my uncle’s call, Orobos stopped dry-heaving and quickly ran over.
It may be rude to say this about a Lord of Inferno, but he was like a… loyal dog.
“The kids must have been bored from waiting, so from now on, give them a tour of the castle and the capital.”
“I understand. I will call the soldiers…”
“No, you will do it yourselves.”
Orobos looked as if he had misheard something.
“You want us to guide them… personally?”
“You ask the obvious. How can I trust demon bastards and entrust the children to them.”
“We are demons too, though…?”
“You all have restriction seals on you. You won’t be able to touch the kids, so I can at least trust you.”
Orobos and his subordinates did not seem to like it very much.
Well, being high-ranking demons and being told to act as nannies, it is understandable that they would be dumbfounded.
“You don’t want to?”
When my uncle asked while taking out a sword from his subspace, Orobos quickly shouted at his subordinates.
“Did you all hear that? Each of you will be in charge of one child! Grant them everything they need! Anything and everything!”
“Now that’s a proper attitude. I like it.”
My uncle wore a satisfied expression.
But unlike my uncle, the kids’ faces were dark.
They must be scared.
No matter if they have restriction seals on them, they still have to entrust their safety to demons.
“I know what you are all thinking. But there is nothing to worry about.”
My uncle beckoned with his finger and called one of the demons.
“You, come closer.”
The demon approached my uncle with a clueless expression.
“Stand in front of the kids, not me.”
“Ah, yes.”
As the demon came closer, the kids’ faces froze stiff.
The demon, on the other hand, was about to look down at the children with a greedy gaze…
“Kkeuaak!”
Suddenly, the demon’s body burst into flames. A blue flame engulfed the demon’s entire body.
“Fire! Put out the fire! Kkeuaaaak!”
The blue flame quickly subsided. The demon did not die, but its entire body was charred black.
“As you can see, the moment the demons harbor even the slightest ill will, the restriction seal will activate immediately.”
At my uncle’s words, the demons were all horrified.
It seemed they had no idea the restriction would activate in this way.
“L-Lord Damien… no matter how you look at it, a restriction like this…”
Orobos protested in a low voice, but it did not work on my uncle at all.
“You’re high-ranking demons, aren’t you? I need to have at least this level of restriction on you to feel at ease.”
“B-But…”
“You don’t want to?”
The moment my uncle made a motion to open his subspace, Orobos and the demons shouted in one voice.
“We have no complaints whatsoever!”
“You should have just said so from the start. Well then, go and give the kids a tour.”
It seemed my uncle showing them the effectiveness of the restriction seals worked, as the kids obediently followed the demons out of the great hall.
Orobos also tried to follow them.
“You stay here.”
“Yes?”
“Right, I have something to talk to you about.”
“Yeees?”
Orobos shouted in surprise.
Seeing him like that, it seems he wanted to escape from my uncle’s side as soon as possible.
“Theo, why are you still here?”
“I’ll just wait for you here, Uncle. It’s only fun when I go around with you.”
“It’ll be boring if you just stay here.”
My uncle only said that, but he did not send me away. It seems he was inwardly pleased that I stayed.
While looking around the great hall, I eavesdropped on their conversation.
“Orobos, do you know why I had only you remain?”
“I do not know, sir.”
“You dim-witted bastard. I wasn’t expecting much anyway.”
Oh, that sounds offensive even to me, I wonder how the person himself feels.
As expected, Orobos wore an offended expression.
“Are you going to take a swing at me?”
“How could I possibly harbor such an irreverent thought! Absolutely not!”
Of course, he changed his expression the moment my uncle glared at him.
“From now on, spread what happened today throughout all of Inferno.”
“Y-Yes?”
“Don’t pretend you didn’t hear me. Announce that you have submitted to me.”
At my uncle’s command, Orobos’s eyes trembled greatly.
It seemed this, at least, was difficult for him to obey.
If what happened today spreads throughout Inferno, he would not be able to save face as a lord, would he?
“That way, the demon bastards will fear my existence.”
“Th-They already fear you now!”
“And yet those bastards are running around inciting people, calling me a fraud?”
Orobos kept his mouth shut.
It seems even he thought it was a ridiculous excuse.
“I know what you’re worried about. You’re worried your authority as a lord will fall.”
“N-No, sir. That is not the reason I am trying to refuse Lord Damien’s command…”
“So you were trying to refuse.”
“Huk!”
Orobos hastily covered his mouth with both hands.
But that could not put the words that had already come out of his mouth back in.
“Even if you follow my command, your authority will not fall. Rather, it will become even more solid.”
“S-Solid, what do you mean by that…”
“I will eliminate all the demons who do not follow you.”
My uncle uttered these fearsome words as if they were nothing.
Well, he is someone with the ability to do so.
“In the end, I will place all of Inferno under your feet.”
“I-Is that really true?”
My uncle nodded his head without a moment’s hesitation.
“Then the demons of Inferno will remember you not as a loser who submitted to a human, but as the second-in-command who stands at Damien Haksen’s right hand.”
Orobos’s expression went slightly blank.
It seemed he was imagining the future my uncle had promised.
“Now, what are you going to do? Will you follow my command?”
At my uncle’s question, Orobos immediately knelt and shouted.
“I pledge my loyalty until the moment I die!”
“Yes, that’s the spirit. I like it very much.”
“But Lord Damien, why are you going to the trouble of conquering Inferno?”
Orobos asked as if he were genuinely curious.
To be honest, I was curious too.
My uncle does not usually use such troublesome methods.
If the demons were the problem, he could have just wiped them out, so why go to the trouble of making them submit?
“Demons are quite persistent. Even if I were to get serious, it would probably be difficult to exterminate them. They would surely survive somehow and build up their forces again.”
Hmm, now that I hear it, he has a point.
If they survived in a barren and dangerous place like Inferno, their adaptability and life force must be incredible, right?
“If I can’t get rid of them all, it’s much better for me to control them. And while I’m at it, I plan to manage the dark mages through you all as well.”
“Yes? The dark mages?”
“Dark mages inevitably have to deal with demons. If they contact you to make a deal, inform me immediately.”
Oh, using this method, he could manage two dangerous elements at the same time.
It seems I was not the only one who was impressed. Orobos also exclaimed in admiration.
“T-To think of such a demonic idea…”
“Why, you got a problem? Should I kill you and put another bastard in charge?”
“Hehe, how could I possibly have a problem.”
Orobos quickly bowed his head and said.
It is a thought I have been having for a while now, but this demon who calls himself the Lord of Inferno acts so weaselly.
* * *
My uncle kept the promise he made to Orobos.
He went around Inferno, punishing the demons who did not follow Orobos.
“What? If I don’t pledge loyalty to the likes of Orobos, you’ll kill me!”
“Has this corpse bastard gone mad! Did your brain rot after being abandoned by your master?”
“Khahat! This is so absurd I can’t help but laugh!”
Of course, the demons did not obediently follow my uncle’s words.
They were bastards who ignored the words of the Demon Lord, so their rebellious spirit must have been quite strong, right?
“Kraaak! He’s a madman! A crazy Death Knight!”
“N-No way. A corpse bastard is this strong?”
“I’m sorry please save me I was the crazy one I didn’t recognize Lord Damien Haksen and acted arrogantly from now on I will be your loyal dog so…”
Of course, the resisting demons did not see a good end.
They either died or were beaten to death.
“From now on, you are Orobos’s loyal subordinate. Understood?”
“O-Of course! I will do so!”
My uncle forcibly placed all the demons he did not kill under Orobos’s command.
How did he force the demons to obey? Well, of course, he just slapped a whole bunch of restriction seals on them.
“Hahahat! You foolish bastards! Do you understand now? Just how great Lord Damien Haksen is!”
Orobos, who had followed my uncle, was greatly delighted watching the demons get beaten.
Watching him, I was a little dumbfounded.
Even if they were the opposition, is it okay to be so happy when your own kind is getting beaten up? A person who is, for all intents and purposes, the Lord of Inferno?
And what about us?
We did not think much of it. We were just having fun sightseeing in Inferno and eating delicious food.
“Today, we’re going to this place. I heard there’s a famous lava waterfall in Inferno.”
“A lava waterfall?”
“Yes, they say lava endlessly falls from a huge cliff.”
“Ooh.”
The sleeping arrangements were also comfortable.
My uncle did not just let us sleep anywhere.
He only let us sleep in the castles of high-ranking demons that were nearby.
Did the owner of the castle willingly give it up? Of course not. But what could they do when my uncle was with us?
Today too, we were to spend the night at the castle of a high-ranking demon that my uncle had obtained consent from, half-coercively.
“Uuuumm.”
Strangely, I tossed and turned a lot that night.
In the end, I dozed off for a bit but eventually got up from the bed.
I definitely did not sleep well, but my mind was wide awake.
It felt like I would not be able to fall back asleep even if I lay down on the bed again.
“Should I go to the bathroom.”
I got out of bed and went outside.
It was the middle of the night, so the corridor was dark. Nothing could be seen outside the window.
“Where was the bathroom…”
I had definitely heard the explanation from the demon servants before going to sleep, but I could not remember well.
“Huh, I don’t think this is the right way.”
As I wandered the corridor, I ended up forgetting the way back to my room as well.
What a predicament. A fork in the road appeared before my panicked self.
“Which way should I go?”
I was just standing at the fork, deliberating.
Knock, knock.
I raised my head at the sound of knocking on the window. Then I saw a black ghost outside the window.
Strangely, it was not scary. I did not even find it strange.
I was accepting it as if it were a matter of course.
The ghost came in through a crack in the window and stood before me. It then raised its hand and pointed to the left.
“You want me to go that way?”
The ghost nodded its head and walked ahead. I hesitated for a moment, then followed the ghost.
It was not like I would find an answer by deliberating on my own anyway.
The ghost glided through the corridor.
Then it stopped in front of a certain door.
“This place is…”
If my memory is correct, this is the room my uncle was supposed to use.
The door was so luxurious that I could recall it easily.
“Are you telling me to ask my uncle for directions?”
The ghost did not say anything. I let out a short sigh.
If this was the case, it should have just guided me back to my room. What a strange ghost.
“But who on earth are you… Ah.”
The ghost slipped through the crack in the door. Having no choice, I opened the door as well.
As I entered, I saw my uncle right away.
My uncle was not in bed, but sitting with his back against one of the walls.
He was clutching a longsword tightly.
I approached my uncle. My uncle was letting out low moans.
“I’m sorry… it’s my fault… that day… I shouldn’t have… it’s all my fault…”
My uncle was still in agony. Cold sweat was continuously pouring from his forehead.
I rummaged through my pocket and took out a handkerchief.
I went closer to my uncle and wiped the sweat from his forehead.
-As expected, I was right.
I heard the ghost’s voice from behind me. I turned around and asked.
“Right about what…”
And I almost screamed.
The ghost had come right up to my face and was shoving it in mine.
-You were the answer.
Grin.
The ghost’s lips curled up in a smile. Sharp teeth were revealed within its long, split mouth.
-It’s you! You were the key! If I have you, I can do it again!
The ghost began to laugh in ecstasy.
The chilling laughter continuously scraped at my eardrums.
“Uwaaak!”
In the end, I could not take it anymore and screamed as I shot up.
Huh?
When I came to my senses, the ghost was nowhere to be seen.
No, forget the ghost, I was not even in the castle. It was not the middle of the night either.
I was riding on the turtle demon’s back. The other kids were around me as well.
“Why are you suddenly screaming and making a fuss?”
Geisel asked me as if he were dumbfounded.
Could it all have been a dream? For a dream, it was overly vivid.
I pondered for a long time, then said.
“Uh… it’s nothing.”
It seems that even if my uncle is by my side, Inferno is still Inferno.
Seeing how unsettling my dreams are.
