Side Story Chapter 27: Dorothea
Recently, there was a question that Imperial Princess Dorothea Adelard was being asked with particular frequency.
“Your Highness, why have you been meeting with Theodore Haksen so often?”
Today was no different.
As she was sitting leisurely on a garden bench, a group of female students swarmed her and posed the question.
Although it was a sudden situation, Dorothea was not flustered.
t was thanks to the imperial etiquette that had been ingrained in her since birth.
“Please, answer us without holding anything back!”
“Lady Dorothea, could it be, as the rumors say, that you and Theodore Haksen are… e-engaged?”
The female students’ attitudes were very earnest.
As if they truly hoped the rumors were false.
It was not an incomprehensible attitude.
It was awkward to say it herself, but Dorothea Adelard was the idol of the Academy.
Her looks stood out even within the Adelard Imperial Family, which was famous for its many beauties.
Her academic achievements were outstanding enough that she never missed the top spot in her grade each year.
On top of this, there was her lofty attitude of having rejected the advances of countless men.
For such a Dorothea to be meeting so frequently with Theodore Haksen in particular, it was only natural that the female students who idolized her would become anxious.
“It seems that lately, many people have been misinterpreting my relationship with Theo.”
Dorothea rested her cheek on her palm and let out a sigh.
“As I have said repeatedly, Theo and I are not in that kind of relationship. He is simply a cute younger brother, and I am only trying to take good care of him. The Adelard Imperial Family and the Haksen Ducal House have a special relationship, you know.”
“R-Right? That’s what it is, right?”
Upon hearing the answer, the female students were greatly relieved.
They each left a word of apology and departed.
Dorothea saw the female students off with a smile on her face.
The moment they were all gone, she wiped the smile from her face.
“They’re so annoying it’s actually pissing me off.”
If even a single Academy student had been present, they would have been overcome with shock and horror.
For Dorothea, who was so lofty as to be saintly, was speaking like a thug from a back alley.
“What’s the big deal about me being a little friendly with that little brat that they have to pry into it like this.”
Dorothea truly hated bothersome things.
That was the reason she did not get close to male students and had rejected many proposals.
“Dad, no, His Majesty, why did you have to make such a request and put me in this difficult position.”
Dorothea leaned her back against the bench and crossed her legs.
She rested her arm on the bench and recalled the events before the start of the school term.
***
With the new school term approaching, Dorothea Adelard was spending a leisurely time in her room.
She was lying on her stomach on the bed, reading the pulp novel ‘Madame de Pompadour’s Secret Shadow’ and munching on cookies.
“Damien’s nephew will be enrolling in the Academy this time.”
Her father, who had suddenly visited her room, said so.
Dorothea answered without taking her eyes off the book.
“Ah, is that so?”
“His name is Theodore Haksen. He’s younger than you.”
“Ah, is that so?”
“His friend is enrolling with him, too. Her name is Hazel Ryan Bloom.”
“Ah, is that so?”
A vein popped on Howard’s forehead at Dorothea’s replies.
But Dorothea’s gaze still would not leave ‘Madame de Pompadour’s Secret Shadow.’
This was the most important part, after all.
The part where Madame de Pompadour finally gives in to the passionate courtship of Gorbal, a knight twelve years her junior…
“You will have to help Theo adjust to the Academy.”
“…Yes?”
But at the words that followed, Dorothea finally had to tear her eyes away from the book.
“Why do I have to do such a bothersome thing.”
“Theo is Damien’s nephew. You are well aware of how important a position Damien holds on the continent, are you not?”
Dorothea was at a loss for words.
There was no one in this world who did not know how great a being Damien Haksen was.
As a princess, Dorothea knew this even better.
That is why the moment she heard her father’s words, she had found herself convinced.
“If we use this well, our relationship with the Haksen Ducal House will become even stronger. Then we can get even closer to Damien.”
It was a natural decision for the Emperor of the Empire.
But Dorothea knew well.
The fact that her father was not making this decision purely as an emperor.
“Then I can increase the number of times I visit Damien. Perhaps I might even be invited on special occasions. Who knows? Damien might even call me for a private matter!”
In the first place, her father was a very famous follower of Damien Haksen.
Dorothea made a disgusted expression.
It was not a pleasant sight to see her middle-aged father’s eyes sparkle while talking about another man.
“If you like him that much, why don’t you just make him your son-in-law?”
“What kind of out-of-the-blue nonsense is that.”
At her father’s question, Dorothea twirled the end of her hair with her finger and said.
“I’m just saying this pretty daughter of yours is willing to put in some effort.”
Dorothea did not have any particular feelings for Damien Haksen.
But if it was her father’s request, it was not impossible for them to become lovers.
His face was quite handsome, and he was strong enough to be called a Transcendent, after all.
“You?”
It was not a question filled with surprise, asking, ‘You would really do that for me?’
It was a question filled with the mocking meaning of, ‘The likes of you?’
For a father to say to his daughter, it was an overly cynical remark.
Even Dorothea could not help but get worked up.
“Have you forgotten, Dad? Just how popular I am.”
The number of men who had courted Dorothea and been rejected, both inside and outside the Academy, easily exceeded a hundred.
This included many big names like the handsome stage actor Galric Forward, who was hailed as the future of the Imperial theater, and the playboy Kylis Older, who was said to have lovers in the double digits.
But Howard’s thoughts were completely different.
“Dorothea, I admit your looks are decent, but compared to the four women known as Damien Haksen’s women, you’re a bit lacking…”
“Excuse me, what did you say?”
At her father’s cold assessment, Dorothea got worked up again.
In truth, Dorothea was somewhat conscious of those four women.
Even excluding the fact that they were Damien Haksen’s women, all four of them were formidable.
The Sword Empress of the Empire, ‘Rachel Lichteawer.’
The Five Great Elders of the Church, ‘Agnes.’
The second Mercenary King of the Fafnir Mercenary Group, ‘Athena Hopper.’
The insane ‘Veronica Sanchez.’
Not only were all four of them powerhouses who had reached the level of Grandmaster, but they were also famous for their outstanding looks.
They were always mentioned when counting the most beautiful women on the continent.
And Dorothea? In truth, she had never even been a candidate.
‘It’s because I lack fame. Fame.’
Just as no one would know of a nation-toppling beauty if she were cooped up in the countryside.
Dorothea protected her pride in this way. In reality, it was not entirely wrong either.
“My looks don’t fall short anywhere I go, you know?”
“Uuuuhhmm.”
Despite Dorothea’s protest, Howard’s expression did not change.
“No matter how I think about it, comparing you to those four is a bit…”
“Are you really my dad?”
Dorothea was dumbfounded.
When it came to matters related to Damien Haksen, Howard would become this cold, even to his own family.
“But what if things go wrong and our relationship with Damien gets twisted.”
“The Empire would suffer a huge loss. So I understand your caution, but…”
“My relationship with Damien would become awkward. This father of yours cannot tolerate such a thing.”
“…”
Dorothea looked at her father with a dumbfounded expression.
“Just trust me on this!”
“Hmm, hmmmmmm.”
Howard looked at his daughter’s face with a serious expression, then said.
“No.”
“Ah, seriously!”
“I’ll be honest with you. At your level, you won’t even be able to beat Rachel.”
Sword Empress Rachel Lichteawer.
She was a famous figure, the third in line after the Imperial Supreme Sword and the Sword Saint.
“The reason I can’t beat her is…”
And she was also the only one of Damien Haksen’s women that Dorothea had met.
Dorothea recalled the image of Rachel she had met recently at a social gathering.
All the men at the gathering had stared at Rachel with a captivated gaze.
Even the men who had lovers.
“…It does seem a bit tough.”
“Don’t have any pointless empty dreams and just treat Theodore well.”
“It’s bothersome…”
Dorothea grumbled but ultimately decided to accept her father’s request.
She was aware that just as she enjoyed the rights of a princess, she also had many responsibilities to bear.
And so, on the day of the entrance ceremony, Dorothea headed to where Theodore was.
To be honest, she did not have high expectations before meeting him.
The great one was Damien Haksen, not his nephew, after all.
Even a great father can have a worthless son, so a nephew was even less of a guarantee.
But when she actually met Theodore Haksen, Dorothea could not help but change her mind.
‘He’s really handsome, isn’t he?’
For a young kid, he had looks that made her eyes pop.
If he looked like this now, she could only look forward to how he would change when he became an adult.
“Uh, hello.”
His shy greeting was so cute she wanted to bite him.
What she liked even more was the girl who had come to the Academy with Theodore.
“Who are you to be hitting on Theo-oppa!”
Though she had questioned her relationship with Theo out of the blue, Dorothea was not the least bit angry.
‘She’s cute too, isn’t she?’
This was because of Hazel’s adorable appearance, which was like a moving doll.
“T-To not recognize Your Highness the Princess… I have committed a crime worthy of death!”
When she was at a loss for what to do as soon as the misunderstanding was cleared up, Dorothea could not help but clutch her chest.
“Theo-oppa! I’ve never seen a princess before! What do I do!”
“That’s for you to figure out… Hey, hey, don’t cling to me.”
The way the two of them bickered was like watching a kitten and a puppy playing together.
At this moment, Dorothea had a premonition.
That taking care of Theodore would be more fun than she had thought.
After that, Dorothea continued to meet with the two, guiding them around the Academy, helping them with their studies, and providing various other forms of assistance.
“Oppa, you can’t interpret it like that here.”
Today, too, Dorothea was watching over the two as they studied.
In truth, there was not much for Dorothea to do.
Thanks to Hazel being so smart, she was taking care of all of Theodore’s studies.
‘Should I pop out and get some snacks?’
Dorothea slipped out without the two of them noticing.
She went to her room and returned with the snacks she had hidden.
But when she came back, only Theodore was in the study room.
“Theo? Where did Hazel go?”
“Ah, Dora-noona.”
At the word ‘noona,’ Dorothea’s expression loosened into a silly grin.
How could she dislike it when a cute kid called her noona.
“I was just looking at this.”
Theodore pointed to a painting hanging on one of the walls of the study room.
In the painting, Damien Haksen was holding his sword high.
And at his feet, the corpses of demons were piled up like a mountain.
“Ah, you were looking at this.”
Paintings depicting Damien Haksen’s achievements were not hard to find.
It was because they were the best-selling subject matter.
“Every time I see something like this, it really hits me. Just how amazing my uncle is.”
Theodore looked at the painting with shining eyes.
Dorothea watched him with a pleased expression.
It was then.
Something black seemed to overlap with Theodore.
Its shape was blurry and not clear, but it definitely had a form similar to a person.
The black figure blinked its red eyes and looked at the painting.
Then it slightly turned its head to look at Dorothea. And it grinned.
In that instant, Dorothea felt a shiver run down her entire body.
She hastily rubbed her eyes with the back of her hand. When she looked at Theodore again, the black figure was gone.
“Noona?”
Theodore asked with a bewildered expression.
“Ah, it’s nothing.”
Dorothea said, forcing a smile.
She convinced herself that she had seen something wrong because she had stayed up too late last night reading Madame de Pompadour’s Secret Shadow.

Side Story Chapter 28: Death Knight (1)
How long had it been since he had seen his family’s faces?
Damien thought to himself as he looked up at the setting sun.
Lately, the fragments of the Demon Kings had suddenly started popping up one after another, preventing him from returning home for a while.
“Theo should be on his summer vacation by now.”
A smile broke out on his face as he remembered Theo’s face, pestering him to take him to the Elven Island this summer.
-Damien… Damien Haksen…!
But his cheerful mood was completely shattered by the voice coming from below.
Damien’s expression crumpled as he looked down.
There, a human with severed limbs was dying.
The body was human, but the mind was not.
This being’s soul had already been devoured by a fragment of a Demon King.
-I won’t… forgive you… because of you… Theta… Theta…!
The remnants are most strongly influenced by the emotions they recalled just before death.
The Demon King controlling this man’s body was Iota.
He was a bastard who had been in love with another Demon King named Theta.
-Lord… Damien…
Just then, another voice was heard.
Right next to him, a young woman was dying with her heart pierced.
-Please… look upon… me… again… I am…
This woman’s soul had also been devoured by a fragment of a Demon King.
It was none other than the fragment of the Demon King named Theta.
-Damien… I will kill you… for sure…
-I… am always… watching you…
Funnily enough, the two fragments did not recognize each other.
Like broken machines, they were only emitting their emotions toward Damien.
“This is why a fragment is just a fragment.”
The remnant left behind when a powerful being dies possesses high intelligence.
But it is only intelligent; it is not alive.
And upon closer inspection, there were many broken parts.
Just like these two.
“Annoying things.”
Of course, compared to the main body, the power of a fragment was but a speck of dust.
But even that speck of dust was too dangerous for humans.
It was impossible for humans to eliminate the fragments of the Demon Kings with their own power.
Damien had to step in.
Thanks to that, Damien had to move personally every time a fragment of a Demon King appeared.
“Who in the world is it. Who is controlling you all.”
Recently, the number of crimes committed by the fragments of the Demon Kings had been increasing.
It meant there was someone spreading the fragments of the Demon Kings.
“What on earth are they aiming for?”
Even though they knew they could not win against Damien in the end, they kept making the fragments of the Demon Kings appear.
It was a foolish act, no different from hitting a rock with an egg.
But the opponent was continuously repeating that foolish act.
It meant there was some kind of intention.
“What are they plotting while diverting my attention?”
Damien asked the fragments of Iota and Theta.
But the two fragments still only expressed their emotions toward Damien.
“I was a fool to ask you.”
Damien swung his sword and cut off the two’s necks.
The fragments were cut down along with the bodies.
As the fragments were annihilated, black smoke billowed out.
Damien silently watched the smoke scatter, then muttered.
“By the way, I wonder if that kid Theo is doing well.”
* * *
Hello. It’s Theo.
It’s been a really long time since I’ve greeted you all after coming back from Hell.
How have you all been these past few months? I’ve been busy studying for exams.
The Academy holds exams periodically. And I heard that if your score is below the standard, you have to take supplementary classes.
The terrifying thing is that if you have to take supplementary classes, you have to give up your summer vacation!
No matter how you look at it, giving up my vacation!
How could I possibly accept such a terrible thing?
I immediately asked Hazel and the Princess for help and immersed myself in studying for the exams!
“Oppa, I told you. That’s not the right answer.”
“Theo, you have a good memory, but your application skills are poor.”
The two of them taught me really harshly. I almost cried several times in the middle of it, but I held it in.
Because my uncle had promised to take me to the Elven Island this summer.
The Elven Island is a truly beautiful place.
The World Tree growing in the center of the island, in particular, is so awe-inspiring to look at.
Anyway, so I studied really hard. Really hard.
Thanks to that, I got a score of 60! And a score of 60 is just barely enough to be exempt from supplementary classes!
“We taught him, and he got a 60…”
“Not everyone can be good at studying.”
The two of them were somewhat dumbfounded, but I did not care at all.
My goal from the beginning was to get out of supplementary classes!
And the long-awaited summer vacation began.
“Uncle, I’m here!”
I quickly returned home and looked for my uncle first. But my uncle was nowhere to be seen.
“Mister Victor, where did my uncle go?”
“Ah, he hasn’t been coming home at all lately. It seems he’s busy with outside work.”
Hmm, if he’s busy, it can’t be helped.
I decided to wait patiently until my uncle returned.
In the middle of it, Hazel came over to ask me to hang out, but I refused.
Because I was supposed to go to the Elven Island with my uncle.
But a day passed, two days passed, and almost a week went by, but my uncle did not appear.
“When is uncle coming back.”
Grumbling in my uncle’s basement every day became my routine.
Not being able to go to the Elven Island is one thing, but how can he not show his face for over a week!
I cannot just let this slide. I’m not going to say a word even when my uncle comes back.
For at least a day, that is!
As it was nearing two weeks, something strange started happening to me.
“Ugh, uuh, uwaaak!”
I started having nightmares every night.
Strangely, I could not remember what kind of nightmare I had.
It was definitely incredibly scary, and my body was drenched in a cold sweat.
“Theo, have you not been sleeping well lately?”
“Your face is so gaunt.”
My mom and dad were worried every time they saw me.
I said I was fine, but in truth, I was not at all.
I was having a hard time because I could not sleep every day.
“I wish uncle were here at a time like this.”
I have had nightmares like this every day in the past. It was so bad that I was afraid to fall asleep.
Then, by chance, I happened to sleep next to my uncle once, and wouldn't you know it, the nightmares completely disappeared.
I guess it’s because I feel safe when I’m next to my uncle.
“I miss uncle…”
Did my earnest wish reach the heavens?
“Theo, your uncle is coming back today.”
My mom delivered some very happy news! I smiled genuinely for the first time in a while.
“Really? When is he coming?”
“He said he’d be late in the evening, but he didn’t give an exact time.”
“He’s coming late in the evening, you say.”
While eating, I made a firm resolution. Today, I would absolutely not go to sleep until I saw my uncle’s face!
But contrary to my resolution, drowsiness washed over me as the sun set.
I was so sleepy that I was nodding off without even realizing it.
It’s so strange. I’ve never been this sleepy before.
“Theo? Go inside and sleep.”
“Look at this kid. It seems he can’t even hear his mom properly.”
“You should carry him on your back.”
In a half-asleep daze, I heard their conversation.
I was about to close my eyes just like that…
“Huh?”
Then I suddenly snapped to my senses.
When I came to, it was the middle of the night. I was lying in my bed.
“Uncle? Is he back?”
I got out of bed and went outside. I was planning to grab anyone and ask.
But since it was already the middle of the night, there was no one in the corridor.
Having no choice, I decided to go to the basement.
At this hour, that was the only place my uncle would be.
I walked through the forest path and arrived at my uncle’s basement.
The moment I went inside, I felt a great sense of relief.
“Uncle…!”
Seeing my uncle’s face after two weeks, a small tear trickled out.
I walked over in one stride and crouched down in front of my uncle.
“Ehehe, it’s Uncle Damien.”
My uncle was still sleeping, clutching his sword.
“Don’t… don’t look at me like that…”
And he was still in agony.
I brought a blanket and laid it out next to my uncle.
I was planning to sleep here tonight…
-As expected, with you here, I can get close.
My body stiffened at the voice that suddenly came from behind.
I put down the blanket and slowly looked to my side.
A black ghost that had appeared at some point was standing next to me, looking at my uncle.
-Damien Haksen’s senses have already reached the realm of a Transcendent. As a mere fragment, there was no way for me to approach him.
What in the world is this ghost? No, how can it be here without my uncle knowing?
-Let alone approaching him, it was not easy to even build up strength inside you. Thanks to that, I could only gather my strength little by little. For a very long time.
The ghost looked at me.
-But there is just one being who can break down Damien Haksen’s guard. And that is you, Theodore Haksen.
“…Who are you?”
I asked, swallowing dryly. The ghost grinned.
-Theo, thank you. Thanks to you, I was able to get this close to Damien Haksen.
“Don’t… shorten my name as you please.”
-Has Damien Haksen ever told you about the past?
The ghost did not answer my question.
It was not an intentional disregard, but rather as if it were only saying what it wanted to say.
-He probably hasn’t. That cowardly bastard.
“I’m not particularly curious.”
-I will now show you. What Damien Haksen is hiding.
In that moment, an instinctive fear washed over me. I immediately called for my uncle.
“Unc…”
But before I could, the black ghost reached out and touched my forehead.
In that moment, the whole world spun around.
A dizzying sense of floating dominated all my senses.
And when I came to, I was standing on a green field.
“Wh-Where am I?”
I was just looking around in a panic.
On the horizon far away, I could see soldiers in formation, marching.
There were so many of them that the ground shook every time they stamped their feet.
“Sons of the Tarak region!”
A knight in the center raised his longsword high and shouted.
“Today, we will execute the vile dark mage! Our valor will be remembered for ages to come!”
The soldiers answered the knight’s cry with a cheer.
The air of the field rang out thunderously.
-Where are you looking.
Just then, I heard the ghost’s voice.
I reflexively looked toward the direction of the sound.
But the ghost was not there.
Instead, a knight was standing there motionlessly.
A build far larger than a human’s.
Black, thick-looking armor.
A large greatsword hanging on its back.
“…A Death Knight?”
It was not my first time seeing a Death Knight.
My uncle, for one, is a Death Knight.
But for some reason.
Why, unlike with my uncle, do I feel so scared, so terrified of this one?
At the fear that was slowly creeping up on me, I took a step back without realizing it.
<Move!>
Just then, a voice was heard.
<Why aren’t you moving! It’s my body! Listen to me!>
The voice was coming from inside the Death Knight’s body.
<Please, I’m begging you! Listen to me! Do as I say!>
At the very familiar voice, I muttered with a dazed expression.
“…Uncle?”

Side Story Chapter 29: Death Knight (2)
I could not see his face because of the helmet, but I was certain. This voice was my uncle’s.
<Move! Why aren’t you moving! It’s my body!>
It was not a voice coming from the mouth.
It came from deep within the body.
My uncle’s voice was filled with pain.
I realized that something unusual had happened to my uncle.
“Uncle! It’s me! It’s Theo!”
I ran towards my uncle.
But my body just passed through him like an illusion.
I turned back to my uncle with a surprised face.
My uncle was screaming, not even noticing my existence.
<It’s suffocating! I can’t breathe! Someone, please help me!>
W-What should I do? How can I help my uncle?
I was just panicking and running around in confusion.
“Huhuhut, the prey is walking right to me.”
A voice I had never heard before rang out.
It was a voice that seemed to be a mix of a woman’s and a man’s.
A skeleton in a black robe had appeared behind my uncle at some point.
“Damien. Today is your first sortie. We can’t let this monumental day pass by boringly, can we?”
The skeleton gripped my uncle’s shoulder and pointed at the soldiers.
“Kill them. Leave not a single one alive.”
The moment the command was given, a red light gleamed from within the helmet.
My uncle gripped the greatsword on his back and began to run across the field.
<What? Why is it moving? What is it trying to do?>
My uncle was greatly flustered. Even so, his body continued to run.
<What are you trying to doooo!>
When my uncle started moving, the soldiers’ faces froze stiff.
But not a single person broke formation.
“Dammit! The undead is coming!”
“Everyone, hold the line! Don’t be scared!”
As soon as the distance to the soldiers closed, my uncle immediately swung his greatsword.
Blood splattered as the upper bodies of the soldiers in the front rank were sent flying all at once.
Despite wearing armor and blocking with shields, the soldiers could not hold on for even a moment.
“They can’t get through! Block them!”
“Heavy shield soldiers! Forward! Forward!”
The soldiers reacted quickly.
The problem was that my uncle was far stronger than they had anticipated.
Every time my uncle swung his greatsword, three or four men died.
Their bodies were split in half, sent flying diagonally, their waists severed.
“Aaargh! Kkeuaaaak!”
“My arm! Find my arm!”
The green field was instantly stained with blood.
It was covered with the dead and the dying.
Even so, my uncle did not stop.
<N-No! Stop! Don’t kill! I said stop!>
To be precise, he could not stop.
My uncle’s body was moving against the will of its master.
“You baaaastard!”
Just then, a thunderous roar was heard.
The knight who had been leading the soldiers from the center kicked off the ground and swung his sword at my uncle.
My uncle immediately stopped killing the soldiers and blocked the knight’s attack.
With a tremendous sound, my uncle’s body was pushed back.
The knight, on the other hand, was not pushed back and stood his ground.
“A mere walking corpse dares to harm the living! Know your place!”
The knight’s face was filled with rage. It meant he was that furious about the deaths of his soldiers.
“I am Zenice Wingcut! A High Class of the Glacia Kingdom! I will give you the opportunity to state your name as well!”
Despite the knight’s cry, my uncle said nothing. To be precise, he could not speak.
“Have you forgotten even your pride as a knight!”
When no answer came, the knight immediately swung his sword.
The knight was strong.
He cornered my uncle with fast and powerful attacks.
My uncle could not even counterattack.
In the blink of an eye, his body was cut in various places.
His armor split open, and black, sticky blood flowed out.
“Huuuumm.”
The skeleton next to me was watching the scene with a dissatisfied look.
“Strange. With that one’s talent, he should be able to catch up to a High Class in no time.”
High Class refers to the stage right before Sword Master.
They are not called superhumans like Sword Masters, but they are very strong.
But he is no match for my uncle. Because my uncle is incomparably stronger than him.
But right now, my uncle was being beaten helplessly by a High Class.
Only now could I understand. Where I am now. What I am seeing.
I am seeing my uncle’s past.
My uncle before he became a Transcendent, in his weaker days.
If that is the case, then it is obvious who the skeleton next to me is.
Dorugo.
The demon who ruined my uncle’s life.
The arch-nemesis my uncle has hated her entire life.
“Haaap!”
My train of thought was cut off by the knight’s war cry.
I hastily looked at my uncle.
My uncle was being pushed back, his left arm severed.
“I’ll end it with this!”
The knight did not stop. Riding the momentum, he tried to cut off my uncle’s neck as well.
In that moment, I could hear it.
<I don’t want to…>
My uncle’s desperate cry.
<I don’t want to die! I want to live!>
The light in my uncle’s eyes grew even stronger.
Immediately after, his movements changed.
He raised his shoulder to block the knight’s sword.
Moving forward, he rotated his body.
He swung his greatsword and struck the knight’s shoulder.
“K-Keueuk!”
The knight clutched his shoulder and collapsed.
Blood poured from his severed shoulder.
“You bastard… how did you read my movements…!”
The knight looked up at my uncle with bloodshot eyes.
My uncle was raising his greatsword high to finish the knight off.
“Dammit… I’ll be waiting for you in Hell.”
My uncle brought his greatsword down.
The descending greatsword split the knight’s body in half.
And so, the High Class knight ended up no different from the other soldiers.
<Uh…?>
Looking down at the knight, my uncle muttered blankly.
<No… I… I…>
My uncle muttered incomprehensible words in a daze.
Dorugo approached my uncle and laughed out loud.
“Huhuhut! As expected of the Death Knight I created! To kill a High Class so easily!”
Dorugo kicked the knight’s corpse with the tip of her foot, rolling it over.
It was an act that showed not a shred of respect for the dead.
“But you must not be satisfied with this. You must become stronger. Because you must bring down the Empire.”
Dorugo spread her arms and said.
“Don’t worry. There is plenty of prey. After you kill them all, no one will be able to stop you! No one!”
Dorugo chuckled and turned her body. She then pointed at the fleeing soldiers and said.
“But before that, we must clean up, right? Go after them and kill them all.”
My uncle moved again.
He ran toward the soldiers, greatsword in hand.
<No… stop… please…!>
My uncle’s weeping continued for a long time.
But it was buried by the screams of the soldiers.
After that, Dorugo took my uncle around and started numerous wars.
Dorugo did not discriminate in who she killed.
She killed not only soldiers, but also women, the elderly, and even children.
All using my uncle.
“Kyaaaak! Save me! Aaaak!”
“Daddy! Daddyyyyy!”
Screams were incessant wherever my uncle went.
“Damien Haksen… you demon-like bastard!”
“You will never die in peace! You filthy bastard!”
People hated and cursed my uncle.
Even so, my uncle did not stop.
No, he could not stop.
<I said stop! Stop killing! Why, why won’t you listen to me!>
In the beginning, my uncle tried to control his body somehow.
<Like this… I’ll beg you like this… just stop… stop it… please…>
Soon after, he began to beg earnestly.
<Stop… please… don’t…>
In the end, he gave up. He had even lost the will to resist.
<It’s all because of me…>
From this point on, my uncle only suffered.
<I should have… died back then… I shouldn’t have thought I wanted to live…>
He endlessly blamed himself and agonized.
<If I had died, no one would have died…>
I could only continue to watch that scene.
I could do nothing but watch my uncle break down.
“…Uncle.”
My voice did not reach my uncle. I could not offer him any words of comfort.
-Did you see?
I reflexively looked back.
The black ghost that had dragged me here was standing there.
-This is the past that Damien Haksen tried to hide from you.
The black ghost glided across the ground and approached my uncle.
-Have you never thought it strange? Why is Damien Haksen so concerned about the events of his past life? There are no longer any people who died or suffered because of him. Why does he feel so much guilt over something that has passed?
The black ghost slowly began to caress my uncle’s face.
-Damien Haksen was completed as a Death Knight, but because his soul and body were separated, he could not fully display his talent. Originally, it was his fate to die fighting the High Class that day.
The black ghost slowly continued.
-But the moment Damien Haksen earnestly wished to live, that connection was restored. It was thanks to that that he was able to overwhelm the High Class.
The black ghost looked at me. I looked at the black ghost as well.
“…I know who you are now.”
Someone who knows my uncle’s past in such detail, and who can drag me into the past.
There could be no other such being.
“You’re Dorugo, aren’t you?”
As if confirming the answer, the black ghost smiled faintly.
* * *
-The world praises Damien Haksen as a hero.
The moment I called her name, Dorugo’s form changed.
She changed from a black ghost to a skeleton. A robe covered her.
-Isn’t it funny? A bastard who killed everyone while saying he wanted to live is a hero.
Her voice also became clear. A distinct personality could be felt.
-You’ve seen it and you know. Everyone hated Damien Haksen. They resented and cursed him.
That’s right. They did.
My uncle was that terrifying a being. Many people died at his hands.
Anyone would have resented my uncle.
-Theodore Haksen! This is the true nature of the uncle you respected so much!
Dorugo’s voice was filled with glee.
As if she were immensely pleased to have shown me the truth.
-Now, tell me your thoughts! How do you feel, having realized the true nature of your uncle, so ugly and filthy! What do you want to say to your uncle!
“You’re a coward.”
-Yes! A perfect word! Damien Haksen is a coward! He only blamed me for what he himself brought about! In the first place, if he had just died that day, this would never have…
“I was talking to you.”
Dorugo shut her mouth and glared at me. I glared back at Dorugo and said.
“Dorugo, you are a true coward.”

Side Story Chapter 30: Death Knight (3)
-You little brat, speaking so thoughtlessly.
Dorugo sneered at me.
Unlike her, I could not smile at all. I was very angry.
“It’s only natural that people blame my uncle. Because they suffered on his account.”
Many people lost their families because of my uncle. It is a situation where they have no choice but to hate him.
Even if the truth that he was being controlled by Dorugo was revealed, not much would have changed.
“It’s also natural that my uncle feels guilt. Because he killed people with his own hands.”
He may have been dominated by Dorugo, but in the end, it was my uncle who killed those people.
My uncle must have thought this way. That he, too, bears responsibility.
But even so, even if that is natural.
“For you, of all people, to criticize my uncle is absurd.”
It was Dorugo who modified my uncle into a Death Knight, and it was Dorugo who gave the order to kill people.
And yet, how can you blame my uncle? How can you mock my uncle’s choice?
“Dorugo, you are a coward.”
No, that is the wrong word. This is not cowardice.
It is shameless, selfish, rude, and deceptive.
To summarize it in one word.
“You are ugly.”
After saying it, I felt a little relieved.
Dorugo was silent, as if in shock. Then, she erupted in anger.
-No, those are not the words that should be coming out of your mouth!
“No, these are exactly the words I should be saying.”
-Why do you think I went through all this trouble! Spreading the fragments to divert Damien Haksen’s attention! Barely managing to build up strength inside you! Why do you think I endured all that hardship!
Dorugo’s body, which had turned into a skeleton, collapsed again.
Darkness flowed like a torrent and covered the entire world.
-It was all for this moment! To see you be disappointed in Damien Haksen, to see you criticize him!
“Why should I do that to my uncle?”
-Because that is how Damien Haksen will be hurt! Because his soul will lose its strength! Because that is how I can make Damien Haksen submit!
The darkness wrapped around my entire body.
I could feel a physical force.
It felt as if my whole body would be crushed if Dorugo applied even a little more pressure.
But I was not scared. There was no reason to be scared in the first place.
“My uncle will be really angry if you touch me.”
-Ha! Do you think Damien Haksen can come here?
Dorugo snorted at my words.
-This place is the deepest part of Damien Haksen’s unconsciousness! It is the place where the secret he wants to hide the most is trapped!
“Is that so?”
-Damien Haksen can absolutely not come here! He probably hasn’t even realized that you are here!
She is probably right.
From what I had vaguely heard from my uncle, Dorugo was a very smart and talented person.
But it seems she has completely forgotten.
That my uncle is a far greater person than that.
“Uncle, I am here.”
-Nonsense! Damien Haksen can absolutely not co…
With the sound of tearing cloth, the darkness split apart.
A brilliant light poured in.
My uncle was standing in the gap.
Contrary to my expectation that he would be furious, he was emotionless.
“…Grrrrr.”
Ah, correction.
He was so angry that his emotions were not showing.
My uncle slowly walked inside.
I could see Dorugo’s face stiffen in real time.
-Theodore Haksen! Come over here!
Dorugo belatedly came to her senses and tried to grab me.
But my uncle was faster.
My uncle blocked Dorugo’s path and grabbed her neck.
-Kraaak! Let go! I said let go!
Dorugo’s body turned into tentacles and wrapped around my uncle.
It tried to crush my uncle’s body.
But my uncle did not even bat an eye.
“I thought it was suspicious that only your fragment was nowhere to be seen… don’t tell me you were living as a parasite inside Theo?”
My uncle glared at Dorugo, growling like a beast.
“I see. You ground up a part of your own soul. That’s why you were able to act a little more rationally than the other fragments.”
-Let go! I said let go!
“But in the end, a fragment is just a fragment. You’re shortsighted. Even the original couldn’t do anything to me. Did you really think your little tricks would work?”
When my uncle put strength into his arm, Dorugo’s body swelled up.
-Aak! Kkeuaaaak!
“Get lost now. You thing that smells worse than the stench of garbage.”
With a final scream, Dorugo’s body exploded. At the same time, all the darkness was lifted.
“Uncle!”
I ran to my uncle. My uncle gently pulled me into a hug…
“You punk! You should have called me right away when a suspicious entity appeared! We were almost in big trouble!”
…he did not, and instead pinched my cheek.
“Uwaah, I’m sorry.”
My uncle did not forgive me easily. He only let go of my cheek after shaking it several times.
“Hing, that hurts.”
“I pinched it to make it hurt, so it should hurt.”
My uncle touched his forehead with his hand as if he had a headache and said.
“From now on, if even a slightly suspicious entity appears, you must call me first. Got it?”
“Hing, okay.”
“Now, let’s go back.”
My uncle showed me his back. I obediently got on his back.
My uncle started walking with me on his back.
Every time he walked, the surrounding scenery changed in real time.
I stared at the scene blankly.
Then a thought suddenly occurred to me.
That it had been a long time since I had spent time with just my uncle like this.
“…”
In truth, my uncle’s past had remained in my mind since a while ago, not being erased.
I hesitated for a long time, then spoke to my uncle.
“Uncle.”
“What.”
“Did you regret not being able to die that day that much?”
My uncle did not say anything to my question.
I realized that was the answer.
“I think it’s a good thing you didn’t die that day, Uncle.”
“Is that so.”
“If you had, I wouldn’t have been able to meet you.”
Is it because my uncle’s back is so warm? Drowsiness slowly started to wash over me.
“I like you, Uncle.”
“I feel the same.”
“So I want you to be happy.”
My uncle fell silent again.
I felt like I knew, to some extent, what my uncle was thinking.
He is probably thinking that he does not deserve to be happy.
“I want you to forgive yourself.”
“Theo, I…”
“I know. You killed a lot of people. With your own hands, no less.”
I hugged my uncle’s neck tightly.
“But it wasn’t your fault, Uncle. It was because of Dorugo.”
“No, it wasn’t. I…”
My uncle could not bring himself to say the rest.
He is probably blaming himself for thinking he wanted to live.
“It’s okay if you call me selfish. You’re more important to me than anyone else, Uncle. I want to see you be happy.”
The drowsiness grew a little stronger.
I resisted the sleepiness.
I wanted to say this before I fell asleep.
“Please forgive yourself, if only for my sake, for me who wants to see you be happy.”
The drowsiness grew stronger and stronger.
I started to nod off.
In a half-asleep daze, I heard the sound of a water drop falling from the edge of the eaves.
As I focused on that sound, I fell completely asleep.
When I opened my eyes, I was back in the basement.
But my uncle was nowhere to be seen.
Instead, I saw the faces of my family.
“Mom?”
“Theo, did you sleep well?”
“Where’s Uncle?”
My mom pointed to a corner of the basement.
There was something like a pure white cocoon there.
I shot up and touched the cocoon.
Unlike its appearance, it was very smooth and warm.
“He said he would be back soon.”
When the news about my uncle spread, many guests came to visit.
Not only my four aunts, but also His Majesty, Mister Mercenary King, the Holy Empress of the Church, and the Five Great Elders came.
“This is Damien Haksen…?”
“What is happening inside?”
Everyone was shocked when they saw the cocoon.
They were worried about my uncle’s well-being.
“Regeneration is occurring inside.”
The only person who recognized my uncle’s state was Mister Imperial Supreme Sword.
Mister Imperial Supreme Sword placed his head against the cocoon for a long time, then spoke to us.
“Damien Haksen is now returning to being a human.”
“Then when will my uncle be back?”
Mister Imperial Supreme Sword shook his head at my question.
“That, I do not know. He may not be able to return at all. Because his body must be created anew from the very beginning.”
My mom squeezed my hand tightly.
I hugged my mom tightly.
Unlike his words that he would be back soon, my uncle remained as a cocoon for a long time.
I visited the basement throughout the vacation.
Because I wanted to be the first one to greet my uncle when he woke up.
The vacation ended, and I had to return to the Academy.
Even at the Academy, I contacted my mom every day to ask about my uncle’s well-being.
“He’s still in the same state.”
My uncle had still not awakened from the cocoon.
The semester ended, and winter vacation came.
I visited my uncle every day again.
As expected, my uncle had not woken up.
Winter vacation ended, and I returned to the Academy again.
Even after that, I continued to contact my mom to ask about my uncle’s well-being.
Time continued to flow, and I became a second year, a third year, a fourth year, and finally, the day of graduation arrived.
Still, my uncle had not woken up.
He was still in the same cocoon state.
In the meantime, I had grown a lot.
I was now two hand spans taller than Hazel.
“Now you really look like an Oppa.”
“What? So you were just calling me Oppa for the sake of it until now?”
Hazel really liked the way I looked now.
Just as I had grown taller, Hazel had become really beautiful.
To the point where my heart would pound sometimes when Hazel smiled.
I consulted Geisel, wondering if I had caught some kind of disease, and wouldn’t you know it, he treated me like a fool.
“You idiot, that’s love.”
“You’re talking bullshit.”
“This bastard, I go to the trouble of giving you advice and what do you say?”
I’m getting along quite well with Geisel.
We fight once every two days, but considering the past, it feels like a different era.
After the graduation ceremony, I returned home with my family.
I headed straight for the basement.
“Uncle, I’m here!”
My uncle was still in the cocoon state.
I soaked the towel I had brought in water and started to wipe the cocoon.
No matter how great my uncle was, he could not stop dust from settling on the cocoon.
“I graduated today.”
Life at the Academy was not easy.
There was a lot to learn, and a lot to know.
At first, it was hard just to keep up with the classes.
It was the same even when I became a second year.
“It seems I have no talent for studying at all. For all four years, I barely avoided failing grades.”
If Hazel and the Princess had not been there, I might have really failed.
I cannot thank those two enough.
“I heard my aunts visited often while I was away. Those four are still the same.”
Even though my uncle had become a cocoon, there were people who did not forget and came to visit.
My aunts were like that, His Majesty was like that, and Grandpa Cheongyeum was like that.
“Oh, right, His Majesty asked me what I thought about working as an official in the Imperial Palace.”
If I go to the Imperial Palace, I would be able to gain a lot of experience.
But I am a bit hesitant.
“Then the time I get to see you would be reduced, wouldn’t it.”
“That would be a problem.”
My body stiffened.
I slowly raised my head.
Like an egg cracking, the cocoon began to split from the very center.
As the cocoon opened to the left and right, someone revealed themselves.
His build was ordinary, and his skin was not gray.
His eyes were not red either.
Not a trace of his former appearance remained.
But I could recognize him in a single glance.
“You’ve grown a lot.”
I held back the tears that were about to burst out and shouted.
“Welcome back!”
(The End of the Return of the Calamity-Class Death Knight’s Side Story)
